audit_require_recovery_postcommit_contract() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_contract_runtime="$1"
  audit_contract_function="$2"
  audit_contract_launch="$3"
  audit_contract_dispatch_function="${audit_contract_function}.dispatcher"
  audit_extract_runtime_dispatch_function "$audit_contract_runtime" \
    "$audit_contract_dispatch_function" || return 1
  audit_expect_command_output "$audit_runtime_dispatch_function_sha" \
    audit_sha256 "$audit_contract_dispatch_function" || return 1
  audit_expect_command_output "$audit_runtime_dispatch_function_lines" \
    audit_line_count "$audit_contract_dispatch_function" || return 1
  audit_expect_command_output "$audit_runtime_dispatch_function_bytes" \
    audit_byte_count "$audit_contract_dispatch_function" || return 1
  audit_extract_recovery_postcommit_function "$audit_contract_runtime" \
    "$audit_contract_function" || return 1
  audit_expect_command_output "$audit_recovery_postcommit_function_sha" \
    audit_sha256 "$audit_contract_function" || return 1
  audit_expect_command_output "$audit_recovery_postcommit_function_lines" \
    audit_line_count "$audit_contract_function" || return 1
  audit_expect_command_output "$audit_recovery_postcommit_function_bytes" \
    audit_byte_count "$audit_contract_function" || return 1
  audit_contract_function_token_count="$(audit_shell_lexical_token_count \
    task5_run_recovery_postcommit "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_function_token_count" = 2 || return 1
  audit_contract_signature_count="$(audit_fixed_line_count \
    'task5_run_recovery_postcommit() (' \
    "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_signature_count" = 1 || return 1
  audit_contract_call_count="$(audit_fixed_line_count \
    '      task5_run_recovery_postcommit \' \
    "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_call_count" = 1 || return 1
  audit_contract_auditor_token_count="$(audit_shell_lexical_token_count \
    TASK5_PLAN_AUDITOR_PATH "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_auditor_token_count" = 3 || return 1
  audit_contract_substitution_prefix='  test "$'
  audit_contract_auditor_sha_line="${audit_contract_substitution_prefix}(task5_sha256 \"\$TASK5_PLAN_AUDITOR_PATH\")\" = \\"
  for audit_contract_auditor_line in \
      '  task5_require_owned_regular "${TASK5_PLAN_AUDITOR_PATH-}" 400' \
      "$audit_contract_auditor_sha_line" \
      '  readonly TASK5_PLAN_AUDITOR_PATH TASK5_PLAN_AUDITOR_SHA'; do
    audit_contract_auditor_line_count="$(audit_fixed_line_count \
      "$audit_contract_auditor_line" "$audit_contract_runtime")" || \
      return 1
    test "$audit_contract_auditor_line_count" = 1 || return 1
  done
  audit_contract_bash_token_count="$(audit_shell_lexical_token_count \
    /bin/bash "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_bash_token_count" = 4 || return 1
  audit_contract_bash_assertion_count="$(audit_fixed_line_count \
    '    test "${1-}" = /bin/bash || return 1' \
    "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_bash_assertion_count" = 3 || return 1
  audit_contract_global_launch_count="$(audit_fixed_line_count \
    '    /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "$TASK5_PRELAUNCH_VERIFIER_PATH" committed \' \
    "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_global_launch_count" = 1 || return 1
  audit_contract_direct_auditor_launch_count="$(audit_fixed_line_count \
    '    /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "$TASK5_PLAN_AUDITOR_PATH" committed \' \
    "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_direct_auditor_launch_count" = 0 || return 1
  while IFS='|' read -r audit_contract_prelaunch_token \
      audit_contract_prelaunch_count; do
    audit_contract_prelaunch_actual="$(audit_shell_lexical_token_count \
      "$audit_contract_prelaunch_token" "$audit_contract_runtime")" || \
      return 1
    test "$audit_contract_prelaunch_actual" = \
      "$audit_contract_prelaunch_count" || return 1
  done <<'TASK5_RECOVERY_POSTCOMMIT_PRELAUNCH_TOKEN_COUNTS'
TASK5_PRELAUNCH_VERIFIER_PATH|7
TASK5_PRELAUNCH_VERIFIER_SHA256|5
TASK5_PRELAUNCH_COMMITTED_BUNDLE_ROOT|10
TASK5_PRELAUNCH_COMMITTED_ROOT_RECEIPT_SHA256|6
TASK5_RECOVERY_POSTCOMMIT_PRELAUNCH_TOKEN_COUNTS
  for audit_contract_prelaunch_line in \
      '      "$TASK5_PRELAUNCH_COMMITTED_BUNDLE_ROOT" \' \
      '      "$TASK5_PRELAUNCH_COMMITTED_ROOT_RECEIPT_SHA256") \' \
      '  readonly TASK5_PRELAUNCH_VERIFIER_PATH TASK5_PRELAUNCH_VERIFIER_SHA256' \
      '  readonly TASK5_PRELAUNCH_COMMITTED_BUNDLE_ROOT' \
      '  readonly TASK5_PRELAUNCH_COMMITTED_ROOT_RECEIPT_SHA256' \
      '  test "$authority_receipt_lines" = 32 || return 1'; do
    audit_contract_prelaunch_line_count="$(audit_fixed_line_count \
      "$audit_contract_prelaunch_line" "$audit_contract_runtime")" || \
      return 1
    test "$audit_contract_prelaunch_line_count" = 1 || return 1
  done
  audit_contract_eval_count="$(audit_shell_lexical_token_count \
    eval "$audit_contract_runtime" word)" || return 1
  audit_contract_indirect_count="$(audit_shell_lexical_token_count \
    '${!' "$audit_contract_runtime")" || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_eval_count" = 0 || return 1
  test "$audit_contract_indirect_count" = 0 || return 1
  for audit_contract_evidence_line in \
      '  audit_stdout="$TASK5_ACTION_DIR/recovery-postcommit.stdout"' \
      '  test "$audit_status" = 0' \
      '  test ! -s "$audit_stderr"' \
      '  cat "$audit_stdout"'; do
    audit_contract_evidence_count="$(audit_fixed_line_count \
      "$audit_contract_evidence_line" "$audit_contract_function")" || \
      return 1
    test "$audit_contract_evidence_count" = 1 || return 1
  done
  audit_write_recovery_postcommit_launch "$audit_contract_function" \
    "$audit_contract_launch" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_fixed_line_count() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_fixed_line="$1"
  audit_fixed_line_file="$2"
  if audit_fixed_line_value="$(grep -Fxc -- \
      "$audit_fixed_line" "$audit_fixed_line_file")"; then
    audit_fixed_line_status=0
  else
    audit_fixed_line_status=$?
  fi
  case "$audit_fixed_line_status" in
    0|1) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  case "$audit_fixed_line_value" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' "$audit_fixed_line_value"
}

audit_fixed_token_count() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_fixed_token="$1"
  audit_fixed_token_file="$2"
  test -n "$audit_fixed_token" || return 1
  audit_fixed_token_value="$(awk -v token="$audit_fixed_token" '
    {
      remainder = $0
      while ((position = index(remainder, token)) != 0) {
        count++
        remainder = substr(remainder, position + length(token))
      }
    }
    END {print count + 0}
  ' "$audit_fixed_token_file")" || return 1
  case "$audit_fixed_token_value" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' "$audit_fixed_token_value" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_shell_lexical_token_count() {
  test "$#" = 2 || test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_lexical_token="$1"
  audit_lexical_source="$2"
  audit_lexical_mode=${3-substring}
  test -n "$audit_lexical_token" || return 1
  case "$audit_lexical_mode" in
    substring|word) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_lexical_source" || return 1
  audit_lexical_count="$(awk -v token="$audit_lexical_token" \
      -v mode="$audit_lexical_mode" '
    function count_token(value, position, before, after) {
      while ((position = index(value, token)) != 0) {
        before = position > 1 ? substr(value, position - 1, 1) : ""
        after = substr(value, position + length(token), 1)
        if (mode != "word" ||
            (before !~ /[0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_]/ &&
             after !~ /[0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_]/))
          count++
        value = substr(value, position + length(token))
      }
    }
    function continuation(value, count_value, character_value) {
      count_value = 0
      for (character_value = length(value); character_value > 0 &&
          substr(value, character_value, 1) == "\\"; character_value--)
        count_value++
      return count_value % 2
    }
    function process(raw, normalized, single_quote, double_quote,
        escaped, character, current, prior) {
      normalized = ""
      single_quote = 0
      double_quote = 0
      escaped = 0
      for (character = 1; character <= length(raw); character++) {
        current = substr(raw, character, 1)
        if (escaped) {
          normalized = normalized current
          escaped = 0
          continue
        }
        if (single_quote) {
          if (current == "'\''") single_quote = 0
          else normalized = normalized current
          continue
        }
        if (double_quote) {
          if (current == "\\") {
            escaped = 1
            continue
          }
          if (current == "\"") double_quote = 0
          else normalized = normalized current
          continue
        }
        if (current == "\\") {
          escaped = 1
          continue
        }
        if (current == "'\''") {
          single_quote = 1
          continue
        }
        if (current == "\"") {
          double_quote = 1
          continue
        }
        prior = length(normalized) ? substr(normalized, length(normalized), 1) : ""
        if (current == "#" &&
            (normalized == "" || prior ~ /[[:space:];|&(){}]/)) break
        normalized = normalized current
      }
      count_token(normalized)
      if (match(normalized,
          /<<-?[0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_]+/)) {
        heredoc = substr(normalized, RSTART, RLENGTH)
        sub(/^<<-?/, "", heredoc)
      }
    }
    {
      raw = $0
      if (heredoc != "") {
        if (raw == heredoc) heredoc = ""
        next
      }
      if (continuation(raw)) {
        sub(/\\$/, "", raw)
        logical = logical raw
        next
      }
      logical = logical raw
      process(logical)
      logical = ""
    }
    END {
      if (logical != "") process(logical)
      if (heredoc != "") exit 1
      print count + 0
    }
  ' "$audit_lexical_source")" || return 1
  case "$audit_lexical_count" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' "$audit_lexical_count" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_write_direct_command_substitution_report() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_substitution_source="$1"
  audit_substitution_label="$2"
  audit_substitution_output="$3"
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_substitution_source" || return 1
  audit_require_absent_path "$audit_substitution_output" || return 1
  awk -v label="$audit_substitution_label" '
    function scan_reset_word() {
      scan_word = ""
      scan_word_active = 0
      scan_word_has_substitution = 0
    }
    function scan_reset_simple_command() {
      scan_expect_command = 1
      scan_command_prefix = 0
      scan_in_test = 0
      scan_simple_has_substitution = 0
      scan_reset_word()
    }
    function scan_finish_word(assignment) {
      if (!scan_word_active) return
      if (scan_word_has_substitution) scan_simple_has_substitution = 1
      if (scan_expect_command) {
        assignment = scan_word
        if (assignment ~ /^[ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_][0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_]*=/) {
          scan_reset_word()
          return
        }
        if (scan_word == "if" || scan_word == "then" ||
            scan_word == "elif" || scan_word == "else" ||
            scan_word == "while" || scan_word == "until" ||
            scan_word == "do" || scan_word == "!" ||
            scan_word == "time") {
          scan_reset_word()
          return
        }
        if (scan_word == "command" || scan_word == "builtin" ||
            scan_word == "exec" || scan_word == "env") {
          scan_command_prefix = 1
          scan_reset_word()
          return
        }
        if (scan_command_prefix && scan_word ~ /^-/) {
          scan_reset_word()
          return
        }
        scan_in_test = (scan_word == "test" || scan_word == "[")
        scan_expect_command = 0
        if (scan_in_test && scan_simple_has_substitution)
          scan_found = 1
      } else if (scan_in_test && scan_word_has_substitution) {
        scan_found = 1
      }
      scan_reset_word()
    }
    function scan_mark_substitution() {
      scan_word_active = 1
      scan_word_has_substitution = 1
      scan_simple_has_substitution = 1
      if (scan_in_test) scan_found = 1
      scan_word = scan_word "SUBSTITUTION"
    }
    function scan_has_direct_test_substitution(text,
        length_value, character, current, following, after_following,
        single_quote, double_quote, escaped, substitution_depth,
        substitution_single_quote, substitution_double_quote,
        substitution_escaped, backtick) {
      scan_found = 0
      scan_reset_simple_command()
      single_quote = 0
      double_quote = 0
      escaped = 0
      substitution_depth = 0
      backtick = 0
      length_value = length(text)
      for (character = 1; character <= length_value; character++) {
        current = substr(text, character, 1)
        following = substr(text, character + 1, 1)
        after_following = substr(text, character + 2, 1)
        if (substitution_depth > 0) {
          if (substitution_escaped[substitution_depth]) {
            substitution_escaped[substitution_depth] = 0
            continue
          }
          if (!substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth] &&
              current == "\\") {
            substitution_escaped[substitution_depth] = 1
            continue
          }
          if (!substitution_double_quote[substitution_depth] &&
              current == "'\''") {
            substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth] = !substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth]
            continue
          }
          if (!substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth] &&
              current == "\"") {
            substitution_double_quote[substitution_depth] = !substitution_double_quote[substitution_depth]
            continue
          }
          if (!substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth] &&
              current == sprintf("%c", 36) && following == "(" &&
              after_following != "(") {
            substitution_depth++
            substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth] = 0
            substitution_double_quote[substitution_depth] = 0
            substitution_escaped[substitution_depth] = 0
            character++
            continue
          }
          if (!substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth] &&
              !substitution_double_quote[substitution_depth] &&
              current == "(") {
            substitution_depth++
            substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth] = 0
            substitution_double_quote[substitution_depth] = 0
            substitution_escaped[substitution_depth] = 0
            continue
          }
          if (!substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth] &&
              !substitution_double_quote[substitution_depth] &&
              current == ")") {
            delete substitution_single_quote[substitution_depth]
            delete substitution_double_quote[substitution_depth]
            delete substitution_escaped[substitution_depth]
            substitution_depth--
          }
          continue
        }
        if (backtick) {
          if (escaped) {
            escaped = 0
            continue
          }
          if (current == "\\") {
            escaped = 1
            continue
          }
          if (current == "`") backtick = 0
          continue
        }
        if (escaped) {
          scan_word = scan_word current
          scan_word_active = 1
          escaped = 0
          continue
        }
        if (single_quote) {
          if (current == "'\''") single_quote = 0
          else {
            scan_word = scan_word current
            scan_word_active = 1
          }
          continue
        }
        if (double_quote) {
          if (current == "\"") {
            double_quote = 0
            continue
          }
          if (current == "\\") {
            escaped = 1
            continue
          }
          if (current == sprintf("%c", 36) && following == "(" &&
              after_following != "(") {
            scan_mark_substitution()
            substitution_depth = 1
            substitution_single_quote[1] = 0
            substitution_double_quote[1] = 0
            substitution_escaped[1] = 0
            character++
            continue
          }
          if (current == "`") {
            scan_mark_substitution()
            backtick = 1
            continue
          }
          scan_word = scan_word current
          scan_word_active = 1
          continue
        }
        if (current == "\\") {
          escaped = 1
          scan_word_active = 1
          continue
        }
        if (current == "'\''") {
          single_quote = 1
          scan_word_active = 1
          continue
        }
        if (current == "\"") {
          double_quote = 1
          scan_word_active = 1
          continue
        }
        if (current == sprintf("%c", 36) && following == "(" &&
            after_following != "(") {
          scan_mark_substitution()
          substitution_depth = 1
          substitution_single_quote[1] = 0
          substitution_double_quote[1] = 0
          substitution_escaped[1] = 0
          character++
          continue
        }
        if (current == "`") {
          scan_mark_substitution()
          backtick = 1
          continue
        }
        if (current ~ /[[:space:]]/) {
          scan_finish_word()
          continue
        }
        if (current == ";" || current == "|" || current == "&" ||
            current == "(" || current == ")" || current == "{" ||
            current == "}") {
          scan_finish_word()
          scan_reset_simple_command()
          continue
        }
        if (current == "#" && !scan_word_active) break
        scan_word = scan_word current
        scan_word_active = 1
      }
      scan_finish_word()
      return scan_found
    }
    function reset_logical_command() {
      logical = ""
      single_quote = 0
      double_quote = 0
      substitution_depth = 0
    }
    function report_logical_command(flat) {
      flat = logical
      gsub(/[[:space:]]+/, " ", flat)
      sub(/^ /, "", flat)
      sub(/ $/, "", flat)
      if (scan_has_direct_test_substitution(logical)) print label "|" flat
      reset_logical_command()
    }
    BEGIN {
      reset_logical_command()
    }
    {
      raw = $0
      piece = raw
      sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", piece)
      continued = 0
      escaped = 0
      for (character = 1; character <= length(raw); character++) {
        current = substr(raw, character, 1)
        following = substr(raw, character + 1, 1)
        if (escaped) {
          escaped = 0
          continue
        }
        if (!single_quote && current == "\\") {
          escaped = 1
          if (character == length(raw)) continued = 1
          continue
        }
        if (!double_quote && current == "'\''") {
          single_quote = !single_quote
          continue
        }
        if (!single_quote && current == "\"") {
          double_quote = !double_quote
          continue
        }
        if (!single_quote && current == sprintf("%c", 36) &&
            following == "(") {
          substitution_depth++
          character++
          continue
        }
        if (!single_quote && current == ")" && substitution_depth > 0) {
          substitution_depth--
        }
      }
      if (continued) sub(/\\[[:space:]]*$/, "", piece)
      gsub(/[[:space:]]+/, " ", piece)
      if (logical == "") logical = piece
      else logical = logical " " piece
      if (!continued && !single_quote && !double_quote &&
          substitution_depth == 0) report_logical_command()
    }
    END {
      if (logical != "") report_logical_command()
    }
  ' "$audit_substitution_source" > "$audit_substitution_output" || return 1
  audit_require_owned_regular "$audit_substitution_output" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_receipt_value() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_require_no_nul_file "$1" || return 1
  audit_receipt_key_count="$(awk -F= -v key="$2" \
    '$1 == key {n++} END {print n + 0}' "$1")" || return 1
  case "$audit_receipt_key_count" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  test "$audit_receipt_key_count" = 1 || return 1
  audit_receipt_result="$(awk -F= -v key="$2" \
    '$1 == key {sub(/^[^=]*=/, ""); print}' "$1")" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$audit_receipt_result" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_require_prelaunch_schema() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_schema_file="$1"
  audit_prelaunch_schema_expected_lines="$2"
  audit_prelaunch_schema_keys="$3"
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_prelaunch_schema_file" || return 1
  case "$audit_prelaunch_schema_expected_lines" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  audit_prelaunch_schema_state="$(awk \
      -v expected="$audit_prelaunch_schema_keys" \
      -v expected_lines="$audit_prelaunch_schema_expected_lines" '
    BEGIN {key_count = split(expected, keys, "[|]")}
    {
      separator = index($0, "=")
      if (separator < 2) bad = 1
      key = substr($0, 1, separator - 1)
      if (NR > key_count || key != keys[NR] || seen[key]++) bad = 1
    }
    END {
      if (NR != expected_lines || key_count != expected_lines) bad = 1
      print bad ? "INVALID" : "VALID"
    }
  ' "$audit_prelaunch_schema_file")" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_schema_state" = VALID || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_require_prelaunch_value() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_actual_value="$(audit_receipt_value "$1" "$2")" || \
    return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_actual_value" = "$3" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_prelaunch_manifest_digest() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_digest_value="$(awk -v path="$2" '
    length($0) >= 67 && substr($0, 67) == path {
      print substr($0, 1, 64)
      rows++
    }
    END {if (rows != 1) exit 1}
  ' "$1")" || return 1
  audit_require_sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_digest_value" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$audit_prelaunch_digest_value" || return 1
}

audit_require_prelaunch_review_lane() {
  test "$#" = 6 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_review_bundle="$1"
  audit_prelaunch_review_receipt="$2"
  audit_prelaunch_review_lane="$3"
  audit_prelaunch_review_reference="$4"
  audit_prelaunch_review_source_sha="$5"
  audit_prelaunch_review_verifier_sha="$6"
  audit_prelaunch_review_assignment="$audit_prelaunch_review_bundle/reviews/$audit_prelaunch_review_lane.assignment"
  audit_prelaunch_review_response="$audit_prelaunch_review_bundle/reviews/$audit_prelaunch_review_lane.response"
  audit_prelaunch_review_identity="$audit_prelaunch_review_bundle/reviews/$audit_prelaunch_review_lane.response.identity"
  audit_prelaunch_assignment_keys='format|lane|reviewer-reference|D5R1|source-manifest-sha256|verifier-command-sha256|scope|constraint|question'
  audit_prelaunch_response_keys='format|lane|assignment-sha256|reviewer-reference|source-manifest-sha256|verifier-command-sha256|source-bytes|checker-preauthentication-effects|verifier-preexec-effects|forbidden-preapproval-effects|verdict|critical|important|minor'
  audit_prelaunch_identity_keys='format|lane|assignment-sha256|reviewer-reference|source-manifest-sha256|response-sha256|response-lines|response-bytes|verdict'
  audit_require_prelaunch_schema "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" 9 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_assignment_keys" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_schema "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" 14 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_response_keys" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_schema "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" 9 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_identity_keys" || return 1
  audit_require_coordination_reference "$audit_prelaunch_review_reference" || \
    return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" format \
    task5r1-prelaunch-source-assignment-v1 || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" lane \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_lane" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" \
    reviewer-reference "$audit_prelaunch_review_reference" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" D5R1 \
    bdecba6ece4a47db46f7398add21aa09c22e1057 || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" \
    source-manifest-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_review_source_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" \
    verifier-command-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_review_verifier_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" scope \
    all-nine-source-files-and-predecessor-verifier || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" \
    constraint read-only-no-source-execution || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment" question \
    prelaunch-source-safe || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_review_assignment_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment")" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_receipt" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_lane-assignment-sha256" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" format \
    task5r1-prelaunch-source-response-v1 || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" lane \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_lane" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
    assignment-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
    reviewer-reference "$audit_prelaunch_review_reference" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
    source-manifest-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_review_source_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
    verifier-command-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_review_verifier_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
    source-bytes EXACT || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
    checker-preauthentication-effects READ-ONLY-ONLY || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
    verifier-preexec-effects READ-ONLY-THEN-EXACT-CHECKER-EXEC || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
    forbidden-preapproval-effects ABSENT || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" verdict \
    APPROVE || return 1
  for audit_prelaunch_review_count in critical important minor; do
    audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_response" \
      "$audit_prelaunch_review_count" 0 || return 1
  done
  audit_prelaunch_review_response_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_response")" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_receipt" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_lane-response-sha256" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_response_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" format \
    task5r1-prelaunch-source-response-identity-v1 || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" lane \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_lane" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" \
    assignment-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_review_assignment_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" \
    reviewer-reference "$audit_prelaunch_review_reference" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" \
    source-manifest-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_review_source_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" \
    response-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_review_response_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" \
    response-lines 14 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_review_response_bytes="$(audit_byte_count \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_response")" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" \
    response-bytes "$audit_prelaunch_review_response_bytes" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity" verdict \
    APPROVE || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_review_identity_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity")" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_review_receipt" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_lane-response-identity-sha256" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_review_identity_sha" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_require_prelaunch_raw_commit_binding() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_root="$1"
  audit_prelaunch_raw_receipt="$2"
  audit_prelaunch_raw_target="$3"
  audit_require_oid "$audit_prelaunch_raw_target" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_tree="$(audit_receipt_value \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_receipt" P5R1-tree)" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_blob="$(audit_receipt_value \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_receipt" P5R1-plan-blob)" || return 1
  audit_require_oid "$audit_prelaunch_raw_tree" || return 1
  audit_require_oid "$audit_prelaunch_raw_blob" || return 1

  audit_prelaunch_raw_binding="$audit_prelaunch_raw_root/binding/P5R1"
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_prelaunch_raw_binding" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_binding_lines="$(audit_line_count \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_binding")" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_binding_lines" = 1 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_binding_value="$(/bin/cat \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_binding")" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_binding_value" = \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_target" || return 1

  audit_prelaunch_raw_shallow="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
    -C "$audit_expected_root" rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_shallow" = false || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_common_token="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
    -C "$audit_expected_root" rev-parse --git-common-dir)" || return 1
  case "$audit_prelaunch_raw_common_token" in
    /*) audit_prelaunch_raw_common="$audit_prelaunch_raw_common_token" ;;
    *) audit_prelaunch_raw_common="$(cd "$audit_expected_root" && \
        cd "$audit_prelaunch_raw_common_token" && pwd -P)" || return 1 ;;
  esac
  test ! -e "$audit_prelaunch_raw_common/info/grafts" || return 1
  test ! -L "$audit_prelaunch_raw_common/info/grafts" || return 1
  test ! -e "$audit_prelaunch_raw_common/shallow" || return 1
  test ! -L "$audit_prelaunch_raw_common/shallow" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_replace_refs="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
    -C "$audit_expected_root" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' \
    refs/replace)" || return 1
  test -z "$audit_prelaunch_raw_replace_refs" || return 1

  audit_prelaunch_raw_type="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
    -C "$audit_expected_root" cat-file -t \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_target")" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_type" = commit || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_commit_hash="$({
    set -o pipefail
    /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$audit_expected_root" \
      cat-file commit "$audit_prelaunch_raw_target" | \
    /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$audit_expected_root" \
      hash-object -t commit --stdin
  })" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_commit_hash" = \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_target" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_actual_tree="$({
    set -o pipefail
    /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$audit_expected_root" \
      cat-file commit "$audit_prelaunch_raw_target" | \
    /usr/bin/awk -v expected_parent="$audit_expected_parent" '
      !body && index($0, "tree ") == 1 {
        tree_count++
        candidate_tree = substr($0, 6)
        if (length(candidate_tree) != 40 ||
            candidate_tree ~ /[^0-9a-f]/) malformed = 1
        else tree = candidate_tree
        next
      }
      !body && index($0, "parent ") == 1 {
        parent_count++
        candidate_parent = substr($0, 8)
        if (length(candidate_parent) != 40 ||
            candidate_parent ~ /[^0-9a-f]/) malformed = 1
        else parent = candidate_parent
        next
      }
      !body && $0 == "" {body = 1; next}
      END {
        if (malformed || length(tree) != 40 || tree ~ /[^0-9a-f]/ ||
            tree_count != 1 || parent_count != 1 ||
            parent != expected_parent) exit 1
        print tree
      }
    '
  })" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_actual_tree" = \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_tree" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_tree_hash="$({
    set -o pipefail
    /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$audit_expected_root" \
      cat-file tree "$audit_prelaunch_raw_tree" | \
    /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$audit_expected_root" \
      hash-object -t tree --stdin
  })" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_tree_hash" = \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_tree" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_tree_row="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
    -C "$audit_expected_root" ls-tree "$audit_prelaunch_raw_tree" -- \
    "$audit_plan_path")" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_actual_blob="$({
    set -o pipefail
    printf '%s\n' "$audit_prelaunch_raw_tree_row" | \
    /usr/bin/awk -v path="$audit_plan_path" '
      $1 == "100644" && $2 == "blob" && length($3) == 40 &&
      $3 !~ /[^0-9a-f]/ && $4 == path {print $3; rows++}
      END {if (rows != 1) exit 1}
    '
  })" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_actual_blob" = \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_blob" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_raw_blob_hash="$({
    set -o pipefail
    /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$audit_expected_root" \
      cat-file blob "$audit_prelaunch_raw_blob" | \
    /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$audit_expected_root" \
      hash-object -t blob --stdin
  })" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_raw_blob_hash" = \
    "$audit_prelaunch_raw_blob" || return 1
  (set -o pipefail; /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
    -C "$audit_expected_root" cat-file blob "$audit_prelaunch_raw_blob" | \
    /usr/bin/cmp -s - "$audit_prelaunch_raw_root/source/plan.md") || \
    return 1
  return 0
}

audit_require_prelaunch_candidate_bindings() {
  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_bind_root="$1"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt="$2"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_source_sha="$3"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_verifier_sha="$4"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_root_receipt="$audit_prelaunch_bind_root/binding/candidate-root.receipt.sha256"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_bundle_manifest="$audit_prelaunch_bind_root/binding/candidate-bundle.manifest.sha256"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_launch="$audit_prelaunch_bind_root/binding/candidate-launch.identity"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_audit="$audit_prelaunch_bind_root/binding/candidate-audit.identity"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_core="$audit_prelaunch_bind_root/binding/candidate-core.manifest"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_manifest_paths='prelaunch.receipt|reviews/protocol.assignment|reviews/protocol.response|reviews/protocol.response.identity|reviews/shell.assignment|reviews/shell.response|reviews/shell.response.identity|source.manifest.sha256|verifier.command'
  audit_prelaunch_bind_launch_keys='format|mode|root-receipt-file-sha256|bundle-manifest-sha256|source-manifest-sha256|verifier-command-sha256|checker-sha256|checker-audit-identity-sha256|checker-output-sha256|checker-output-bytes|exit-status'
  audit_prelaunch_bind_audit_keys='format|mode|P0|D5R1|P5R1|plan-sha256|checker-sha256|bootstrap-sha256|runtime-sha256|derivation-manifest-sha256|core-manifest-sha256|original-authority-manifest-sha256|failure-package-manifest-sha256|amendment|launch|controller-invocations|sequence-pre-final|sequence-pre-report|sequence-post-report'
  audit_require_prelaunch_manifest_rows \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root_receipt" bundle.manifest.sha256 || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_manifest_rows \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_bundle_manifest" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_manifest_paths" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_schema "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" 11 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch_keys" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_schema "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit" 19 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit_keys" || return 1
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_prelaunch_bind_core" || return 1

  audit_prelaunch_bind_bundle_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_bundle_manifest")" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_bind_root_expected="$audit_prelaunch_bind_bundle_sha  bundle.manifest.sha256"
  audit_prelaunch_bind_root_actual="$(/bin/cat \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root_receipt")" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root_actual" = \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root_expected" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_bind_root_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root_receipt")" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt" \
    candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt" \
    candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_bundle_sha" || return 1
  for audit_prelaunch_bind_relative in \
      reviews/protocol.assignment reviews/protocol.response \
      reviews/protocol.response.identity reviews/shell.assignment \
      reviews/shell.response reviews/shell.response.identity \
      source.manifest.sha256 verifier.command; do
    audit_prelaunch_bind_expected_digest="$(audit_prelaunch_manifest_digest \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_bundle_manifest" \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_relative")" || return 1
    audit_prelaunch_bind_actual_digest="$(audit_sha256 \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root/$audit_prelaunch_bind_relative")" || \
      return 1
    test "$audit_prelaunch_bind_expected_digest" = \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_actual_digest" || return 1
  done

  audit_prelaunch_bind_launch_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch")" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_bind_audit_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit")" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_bind_core_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_core")" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt" \
    candidate-launch-identity-sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt" \
    candidate-audit-identity-sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt" \
    candidate-core-manifest-sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_core_sha" || return 1

  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" format \
    task5r1-prelaunch-checker-launch-v1 || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" mode \
    candidate || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" \
    root-receipt-file-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" \
    bundle-manifest-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_bundle_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" \
    source-manifest-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_source_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" \
    verifier-command-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_verifier_sha" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_bind_checker_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_root/source/checker.sh")" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" \
    checker-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_checker_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" \
    checker-audit-identity-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit_sha" || \
    return 1
  audit_prelaunch_bind_output_sha="$(audit_receipt_value \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" checker-output-sha256)" || return 1
  audit_require_sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_output_sha" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_bind_output_bytes="$(audit_receipt_value \
    "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" checker-output-bytes)" || return 1
  case "$audit_prelaunch_bind_output_bytes" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_launch" exit-status \
    0 || return 1

  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit" format \
    task5-recovery-plan-audit-v1 || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit" mode \
    candidate || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit" D5R1 \
    "$audit_expected_parent" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit" P5R1 \
    UNRESOLVED || return 1
  for audit_prelaunch_bind_hash_key in plan-sha256 checker-sha256 \
      bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 derivation-manifest-sha256 \
      core-manifest-sha256 original-authority-manifest-sha256 \
      failure-package-manifest-sha256; do
    audit_prelaunch_bind_hash_value="$(audit_receipt_value \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit" \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_hash_key")" || return 1
    audit_require_sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_hash_value" || return 1
  done
  for audit_prelaunch_bind_source_key in plan-sha256 checker-sha256 \
      bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 derivation-manifest-sha256; do
    audit_prelaunch_bind_audit_value="$(audit_receipt_value \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit" \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_source_key")" || return 1
    audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt_value="$(audit_receipt_value \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt" \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_source_key")" || return 1
    test "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit_value" = \
      "$audit_prelaunch_bind_receipt_value" || return 1
  done
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_bind_audit" \
    core-manifest-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_bind_core_sha" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_require_prelaunch_bundle_contract() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_contract_mode="$1"
  audit_prelaunch_contract_root="$2"
  audit_prelaunch_contract_target="$3"
  audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt="$audit_prelaunch_contract_root/prelaunch.receipt"
  audit_prelaunch_candidate_receipt_keys='format|mode|D5R1|P5R1|plan-path|source-manifest-sha256|plan-sha256|checker-sha256|bootstrap-sha256|runtime-sha256|launcher-sha256|checker-delta-sha256|bootstrap-delta-sha256|runtime-delta-sha256|derivation-manifest-sha256|verifier-command-sha256|protocol-reviewer-reference|protocol-assignment-sha256|protocol-response-sha256|protocol-response-identity-sha256|shell-reviewer-reference|shell-assignment-sha256|shell-response-sha256|shell-response-identity-sha256|decision'
  audit_prelaunch_committed_receipt_keys='format|mode|D5R1|P5R1|P5R1-tree|P5R1-plan-blob|plan-path|source-manifest-sha256|plan-sha256|checker-sha256|bootstrap-sha256|runtime-sha256|launcher-sha256|checker-delta-sha256|bootstrap-delta-sha256|runtime-delta-sha256|derivation-manifest-sha256|verifier-command-sha256|protocol-reviewer-reference|protocol-assignment-sha256|protocol-response-sha256|protocol-response-identity-sha256|shell-reviewer-reference|shell-assignment-sha256|shell-response-sha256|shell-response-identity-sha256|candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256|candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256|candidate-launch-identity-sha256|candidate-audit-identity-sha256|candidate-core-manifest-sha256|source-bytes-vs-candidate|decision'
  case "$audit_prelaunch_contract_mode" in
    candidate)
      audit_require_prelaunch_schema "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" 25 \
        "$audit_prelaunch_candidate_receipt_keys" || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" format \
        task5r1-prelaunch-candidate-receipt-v1 || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" mode \
        candidate || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" P5R1 \
        UNRESOLVED || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" \
        decision APPROVE-CANDIDATE-CHECKER-ONLY || return 1
      ;;
    committed)
      audit_require_prelaunch_schema "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" 33 \
        "$audit_prelaunch_committed_receipt_keys" || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" format \
        task5r1-prelaunch-committed-receipt-v1 || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" mode \
        committed || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" P5R1 \
        "$audit_prelaunch_contract_target" || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_raw_commit_binding \
        "$audit_prelaunch_contract_root" \
        "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" \
        "$audit_prelaunch_contract_target" || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" \
        source-bytes-vs-candidate IDENTICAL || return 1
      audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" \
        decision APPROVE-COMMITTED-CHECKER-ONLY || return 1
      ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" D5R1 \
    bdecba6ece4a47db46f7398add21aa09c22e1057 || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" plan-path \
    docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-10-task-5-bootstrap-recovery.md || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_contract_source_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_root/source.manifest.sha256")" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_contract_verifier_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_root/verifier.command")" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" \
    source-manifest-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_contract_source_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" \
    verifier-command-sha256 "$audit_prelaunch_contract_verifier_sha" || \
    return 1
  while IFS='|' read -r audit_prelaunch_contract_key \
      audit_prelaunch_contract_relative; do
    audit_prelaunch_contract_file_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
      "$audit_prelaunch_contract_root/source/$audit_prelaunch_contract_relative")" || \
      return 1
    audit_require_prelaunch_value "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" \
      "$audit_prelaunch_contract_key" "$audit_prelaunch_contract_file_sha" || \
      return 1
  done <<'TASK5R1_PRELAUNCH_CHECKER_SOURCE_ROWS'
plan-sha256|plan.md
checker-sha256|checker.sh
bootstrap-sha256|bootstrap.sh
runtime-sha256|runtime.sh
launcher-sha256|launcher.sh
checker-delta-sha256|checker.delta
bootstrap-delta-sha256|bootstrap.delta
runtime-delta-sha256|runtime.delta
derivation-manifest-sha256|derivation.manifest
TASK5R1_PRELAUNCH_CHECKER_SOURCE_ROWS
  audit_prelaunch_contract_protocol_reference="$(audit_receipt_value \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" protocol-reviewer-reference)" || \
    return 1
  audit_prelaunch_contract_shell_reference="$(audit_receipt_value \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" shell-reviewer-reference)" || return 1
  audit_require_coordination_reference \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_protocol_reference" || return 1
  audit_require_coordination_reference \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_shell_reference" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_contract_protocol_folded="$(printf '%s\n' \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_protocol_reference" | \
    tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" || return 1
  audit_prelaunch_contract_shell_folded="$(printf '%s\n' \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_shell_reference" | \
    tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" || return 1
  test "$audit_prelaunch_contract_protocol_folded" != \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_shell_folded" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_review_lane "$audit_prelaunch_contract_root" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" protocol \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_protocol_reference" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_source_sha" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_verifier_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_prelaunch_review_lane "$audit_prelaunch_contract_root" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" shell \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_shell_reference" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_source_sha" \
    "$audit_prelaunch_contract_verifier_sha" || return 1
  case "$audit_prelaunch_contract_mode" in
    candidate) ;;
    committed)
      audit_require_prelaunch_candidate_bindings \
        "$audit_prelaunch_contract_root" \
        "$audit_prelaunch_contract_receipt" \
        "$audit_prelaunch_contract_source_sha" \
        "$audit_prelaunch_contract_verifier_sha" || return 1
      ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

audit_verify_manifest_root() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_verify_root="$1"
  audit_verify_manifest="$2"
  audit_verify_expected_sha="$3"
  audit_require_owned_directory "$audit_verify_root" 500 || return 1
  audit_require_owned_regular "$audit_verify_manifest" || return 1
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_verify_manifest" || return 1
  audit_verify_manifest_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
    "$audit_verify_manifest")" || return 1
  audit_verify_manifest_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
    "$audit_verify_manifest")" || return 1
  test "$audit_verify_manifest_mode" = 400 || return 1
  test "$audit_verify_manifest_links" = 1 || return 1
  audit_require_sha256 "$audit_verify_expected_sha" || return 1
  audit_verify_manifest_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_verify_manifest")" || return 1
  test "$audit_verify_manifest_sha" = "$audit_verify_expected_sha" || \
    return 1
  case "$audit_verify_manifest" in
    "$audit_verify_root"/*)
      audit_verify_manifest_relative="${audit_verify_manifest#"$audit_verify_root/"}" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  audit_verify_manifest_state="$(awk '
    {
      separator = index($0, "  ")
      if (!separator) {bad = 1; next}
      digest = substr($0, 1, separator - 1)
      relative = substr($0, separator + 2)
      if (length(digest) != 64 || digest !~ /^[0-9a-f]+$/) {bad = 1; next}
      if (relative == "" || relative ~ /^\// || relative ~ /^\.\// ||
          relative == "." || relative == ".." || relative ~ /^\.\.\// ||
          relative ~ /\/\.\// || relative ~ /\/\.$/ ||
          relative ~ /\/\.\.\// || relative ~ /\/\.\.$/ ||
          relative ~ /\/\// || relative ~ /\/$/ ||
          relative ~ /[^0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._\/-]/) {
        bad = 1
        next
      }
      folded = tolower(relative)
      if (seen[folded]++) bad = 1
    }
    END {print bad ? "INVALID" : "VALID"}
  ' "$audit_verify_manifest")" || return 1
  test "$audit_verify_manifest_state" = VALID || return 1
  audit_verify_link_count="$(find "$audit_verify_root" -type l -print | \
    awk 'END {print NR + 0}')" || return 1
  audit_verify_special_count="$(find "$audit_verify_root" \
    ! -type d ! -type f -print | awk 'END {print NR + 0}')" || return 1
  test "$audit_verify_link_count" = 0 || return 1
  test "$audit_verify_special_count" = 0 || return 1
  audit_verify_entries=0
  while IFS='  ' read -r audit_verify_sha audit_verify_relative; do
    audit_require_sha256 "$audit_verify_sha" || return 1
    test -n "$audit_verify_relative" || return 1
    test "$audit_verify_relative" != \
      "$audit_verify_manifest_relative" || return 1
    case "$audit_verify_relative" in
      /*|..|../*|*/..|*/../*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    audit_verify_path="$audit_verify_root/$audit_verify_relative"
    audit_require_owned_regular "$audit_verify_path" || return 1
    audit_verify_path_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$audit_verify_path")" || \
      return 1
    audit_verify_path_links="$(stat -f '%l' "$audit_verify_path")" || \
      return 1
    audit_verify_path_sha="$(audit_sha256 "$audit_verify_path")" || return 1
    test "$audit_verify_path_mode" = 400 || return 1
    test "$audit_verify_path_links" = 1 || return 1
    test "$audit_verify_path_sha" = "$audit_verify_sha" || return 1
    audit_verify_entries=$((audit_verify_entries + 1))
  done < "$audit_verify_manifest"
  test "$audit_verify_entries" -gt 0 || return 1
  audit_verify_file_count="$(find "$audit_verify_root" -type f | \
    wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
  test "$audit_verify_file_count" = "$((audit_verify_entries + 1))" || \
    return 1
  find "$audit_verify_root" -type d -print | while IFS= read -r audit_verify_dir; do
    audit_require_owned_directory "$audit_verify_dir" 500 || exit 1
  done || return 1
  find "$audit_verify_root" -mindepth 1 -type d -print | \
    while IFS= read -r audit_verify_dir; do
      audit_verify_dir_relative="${audit_verify_dir#"$audit_verify_root/"}"
      case "$audit_verify_dir_relative" in
        ''|/*|..|../*|*/..|*/../*|*//*|*/|\
        *[!0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._/-]*)
          exit 1 ;;
      esac
      awk -v prefix="$audit_verify_dir_relative/" '
        {
          separator = index($0, "  ")
          relative = substr($0, separator + 2)
          if (separator && index(relative, prefix) == 1) found = 1
        }
        END {exit(found ? 0 : 1)}
      ' "$audit_verify_manifest" || exit 1
    done || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_extract_fence() {
  test "$#" = 6 || return 1
  audit_extract_source="$1"
  audit_extract_begin="$2"
  audit_extract_end="$3"
  audit_extract_open="$4"
  audit_extract_close="$5"
  audit_extract_output="$6"
  audit_require_absent_path "$audit_extract_output" || return 1
  audit_extract_begin_count="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_extract_begin" \
    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
    "$audit_extract_source")" || return 1
  audit_extract_end_count="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_extract_end" \
    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
    "$audit_extract_source")" || return 1
  test "$audit_extract_begin_count" = 1 || return 1
  test "$audit_extract_end_count" = 1 || return 1
  audit_extract_first="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_extract_begin" \
    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$audit_extract_source")" || return 1
  audit_extract_last="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_extract_end" \
    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$audit_extract_source")" || return 1
  case "$audit_extract_first:$audit_extract_last" in
    *[!0123456789:]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  test "$audit_extract_first" -lt "$audit_extract_last" || return 1
  audit_extract_actual_open="$(sed -n "$((audit_extract_first + 1))p" \
    "$audit_extract_source")" || return 1
  audit_extract_actual_close="$(sed -n "$((audit_extract_last - 1))p" \
    "$audit_extract_source")" || return 1
  test "$audit_extract_actual_open" = "$audit_extract_open" || return 1
  test "$audit_extract_actual_close" = "$audit_extract_close" || return 1
  awk -v first="$((audit_extract_first + 1))" \
    -v last="$((audit_extract_last - 1))" \
    'NR > first && NR < last {print}' "$audit_extract_source" \
    > "$audit_extract_output" || return 1
  audit_require_owned_regular "$audit_extract_output" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_extract_marker_body() {
  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
  audit_marker_source="$1"
  audit_marker_begin="$2"
  audit_marker_end="$3"
  audit_marker_output="$4"
  audit_require_absent_path "$audit_marker_output" || return 1
  audit_marker_begin_count="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_marker_begin" \
    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
    "$audit_marker_source")" || return 1
  audit_marker_end_count="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_marker_end" \
    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
    "$audit_marker_source")" || return 1
  test "$audit_marker_begin_count" = 1 || return 1
  test "$audit_marker_end_count" = 1 || return 1
  audit_marker_first="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_marker_begin" \
    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$audit_marker_source")" || return 1
  audit_marker_last="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_marker_end" \
    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$audit_marker_source")" || return 1
  case "$audit_marker_first:$audit_marker_last" in
    *[!0123456789:]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  test "$audit_marker_first" -lt "$audit_marker_last" || return 1
  awk -v first="$audit_marker_first" -v last="$audit_marker_last" \
    'NR > first && NR < last {print}' "$audit_marker_source" \
    > "$audit_marker_output" || return 1
  audit_require_owned_regular "$audit_marker_output" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_derivation_row() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  awk -F '|' -v wanted="$1" \
    '$1 == wanted {n++; row=$0} END {if (n != 1) exit 1; print row}' \
    "$audit_derivation_manifest"
}

audit_validate_delta() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_delta_path="$1"
  audit_delta_name="$2"
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_delta_path" || return 1
  audit_delta_diff_header_count="$(grep -Fxc \
    "diff --git a/$audit_delta_name b/$audit_delta_name" \
    "$audit_delta_path")" || return 1
  audit_delta_old_header_count="$(grep -Fxc -- \
    "--- a/$audit_delta_name" "$audit_delta_path")" || return 1
  audit_delta_new_header_count="$(grep -Fxc \
    "+++ b/$audit_delta_name" "$audit_delta_path")" || return 1
  audit_delta_total_header_count="$(grep -Ec \
    '^diff --git |^--- |^\+\+\+ ' "$audit_delta_path")" || return 1
  test "$audit_delta_diff_header_count" = 1 || return 1
  test "$audit_delta_old_header_count" = 1 || return 1
  test "$audit_delta_new_header_count" = 1 || return 1
  test "$audit_delta_total_header_count" = 3 || return 1
  if grep -E '^(new file mode|deleted file mode|old mode|new mode|rename from|rename to|copy from|copy to|GIT binary patch|Binary files )' \
      "$audit_delta_path" >/dev/null; then
    return 1
  else
    audit_delta_grep_status=$?
  fi
  test "$audit_delta_grep_status" = 1 || return 1
  audit_delta_numstat_name="$(git apply --numstat \
    "$audit_delta_path" | awk '{print $3}')" || return 1
  audit_delta_numstat_lines="$(git apply --numstat \
    "$audit_delta_path" | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
  test "$audit_delta_numstat_name" = "$audit_delta_name" || return 1
  test "$audit_delta_numstat_lines" = 1 || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_apply_derivation() {
  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
  audit_derive_kind="$1"
  audit_derive_source="$2"
  audit_derive_delta="$3"
  audit_derive_result="$4"
  audit_derive_row="$(audit_derivation_row "$audit_derive_kind")" || return 1
  audit_derive_row_fields="$(printf '%s\n' "$audit_derive_row" | \
    awk -F '|' '{print NF}')" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_row_fields" = 10 || return 1
  audit_derive_saved_ifs=$IFS
  IFS='|' read -r audit_derive_row_kind audit_derive_source_sha \
    audit_derive_source_lines audit_derive_source_bytes \
    audit_derive_delta_sha audit_derive_delta_lines \
    audit_derive_delta_bytes audit_derive_result_sha \
    audit_derive_result_lines audit_derive_result_bytes <<AUDIT_DERIVATION_ROW
$audit_derive_row
AUDIT_DERIVATION_ROW
  audit_derive_read_status=$?
  IFS=$audit_derive_saved_ifs
  test "$audit_derive_read_status" = 0 || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_row_kind" = "$audit_derive_kind" || return 1
  audit_require_sha256 "$audit_derive_source_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_sha256 "$audit_derive_delta_sha" || return 1
  audit_require_sha256 "$audit_derive_result_sha" || return 1
  for audit_derive_count in "$audit_derive_source_lines" \
      "$audit_derive_source_bytes" "$audit_derive_delta_lines" \
      "$audit_derive_delta_bytes" "$audit_derive_result_lines" \
      "$audit_derive_result_bytes"; do
    case "$audit_derive_count" in ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;; esac
  done
  audit_derive_actual_source_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_derive_source")" || return 1
  audit_derive_actual_source_lines="$(wc -l < \
    "$audit_derive_source" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
  audit_derive_actual_source_bytes="$(wc -c < \
    "$audit_derive_source" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
  audit_derive_actual_delta_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_derive_delta")" || return 1
  audit_derive_actual_delta_lines="$(wc -l < \
    "$audit_derive_delta" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
  audit_derive_actual_delta_bytes="$(wc -c < \
    "$audit_derive_delta" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_source_sha" = \
    "$audit_derive_source_sha" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_source_lines" = \
    "$audit_derive_source_lines" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_source_bytes" = \
    "$audit_derive_source_bytes" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_delta_sha" = \
    "$audit_derive_delta_sha" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_delta_lines" = \
    "$audit_derive_delta_lines" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_delta_bytes" = \
    "$audit_derive_delta_bytes" || return 1
  audit_derive_name="$audit_derive_kind.sh"
  audit_validate_delta "$audit_derive_delta" "$audit_derive_name" || return 1
  audit_derive_root="$audit_root/derive-$audit_derive_kind"
  audit_require_absent_path "$audit_derive_root" || return 1
  mkdir -m 700 "$audit_derive_root" || return 1
  cp "$audit_derive_source" \
    "$audit_derive_root/$audit_derive_name" || return 1
  chmod 600 "$audit_derive_root/$audit_derive_name" || return 1
  (
    cd "$audit_derive_root" || exit 1
    git apply --no-index --check --whitespace=error-all \
      "$audit_derive_delta" || exit 1
    git apply --no-index --whitespace=error-all \
      "$audit_derive_delta" || exit 1
  ) || return 1
  audit_require_absent_path "$audit_derive_result" || return 1
  cp "$audit_derive_root/$audit_derive_name" \
    "$audit_derive_result" || return 1
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_derive_result" || return 1
  audit_derive_actual_result_sha="$(audit_sha256 \
    "$audit_derive_result")" || return 1
  audit_derive_actual_result_lines="$(wc -l < \
    "$audit_derive_result" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
  audit_derive_actual_result_bytes="$(wc -c < \
    "$audit_derive_result" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_result_sha" = \
    "$audit_derive_result_sha" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_result_lines" = \
    "$audit_derive_result_lines" || return 1
  test "$audit_derive_actual_result_bytes" = \
    "$audit_derive_result_bytes" || return 1
  (
    cd "$audit_derive_root" || exit 1
    git apply --no-index --reverse --check --whitespace=error-all \
      "$audit_derive_delta" || exit 1
    git apply --no-index --reverse --whitespace=error-all \
      "$audit_derive_delta" || exit 1
  ) || return 1
  cmp -s "$audit_derive_source" \
    "$audit_derive_root/$audit_derive_name" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_extract_bootstrap_environment_names() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_env_bootstrap="$1"
  audit_env_output="$2"
  audit_require_absent_path "$audit_env_output" || return 1
  awk '
    $0 == "\047GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL" {
      starts++
      inside = 1
      print substr($0, 2)
      next
    }
    inside && $0 == "_\047" {
      ends++
      print "_"
      inside = 0
      next
    }
    inside {print}
    END {if (starts != 1 || ends != 1 || inside) exit 1}
  ' "$audit_env_bootstrap" > "$audit_env_output" || return 1
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_env_output" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_environment_names_accept() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_env_actual="$1"
  audit_env_expected="$2"
  audit_env_shape_state="$(awk '
    $0 !~ /^[ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_][ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_]*$/ {bad=1}
    seen[$0]++ {bad=1}
    END {print bad + 0}
  ' "$audit_env_actual")" || return 1
  test "$audit_env_shape_state" = 0 || return 1
  cmp -s "$audit_env_actual" "$audit_env_expected" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_environment_name_position_delta() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_env_position_file="$1"
  audit_env_position_first="$2"
  audit_env_position_second="$3"
  audit_env_position_delta="$(awk -v first="$audit_env_position_first" \
    -v second="$audit_env_position_second" '
      $0 == first {first_line=NR}
      $0 == second {second_line=NR}
      END {print second_line - first_line}
    ' "$audit_env_position_file")" || return 1
  case "$audit_env_position_delta" in
    ''|-[0123456789]*|*[!0123456789-]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' "$audit_env_position_delta" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_environment_order_difference() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_env_order_old="$1"
  audit_env_order_new="$2"
  audit_env_order_difference="$({ set -o pipefail; \
    paste -d '|' "$audit_env_order_old" "$audit_env_order_new" | \
      awk -F '|' '
        $1 != $2 {
          differences++
          if (differences == 1 && !($1 == "HOME" && $2 == "HISTFILE")) bad=1
          if (differences == 2 && !($1 == "HISTFILE" && $2 == "HOME")) bad=1
        }
        END {print (differences == 2 && !bad) ? 0 : 1}
      '; })" || return 1
  case "$audit_env_order_difference" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' "$audit_env_order_difference" || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_compare_checker_fence_file() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_preauth_plan="$1"
  audit_preauth_running="$2"
  audit_require_text_file "$audit_preauth_plan" || return 1
  audit_require_running_executable "$audit_preauth_running" || return 1
  audit_preauth_header="$(sed -n '1p' \
    "$audit_preauth_plan")" || return 1
  test "$audit_preauth_header" = "$audit_expected_header" || return 1
  audit_preauth_begin_count="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_checker_begin" \
    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
    "$audit_preauth_plan")" || return 1
  audit_preauth_end_count="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_checker_end" \
    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
    "$audit_preauth_plan")" || return 1
  test "$audit_preauth_begin_count" = 1 || return 1
  test "$audit_preauth_end_count" = 1 || return 1
  audit_preauth_first="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_checker_begin" \
    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$audit_preauth_plan")" || return 1
  audit_preauth_last="$(awk -v wanted="$audit_checker_end" \
    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$audit_preauth_plan")" || return 1
  case "$audit_preauth_first:$audit_preauth_last" in
    *[!0123456789:]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  test "$audit_preauth_first" -lt "$audit_preauth_last" || return 1
  audit_preauth_open="$(sed -n \
    "$((audit_preauth_first + 1))p" "$audit_preauth_plan")" || return 1
  audit_preauth_close="$(sed -n \
    "$((audit_preauth_last - 1))p" "$audit_preauth_plan")" || return 1
  test "$audit_preauth_open" = '```bash' || return 1
  test "$audit_preauth_close" = '```' || return 1
  set +e
  awk -v first="$audit_preauth_first" -v last="$audit_preauth_last" \
    'NR > first + 1 && NR < last - 1 {print}' "$audit_preauth_plan" | \
    cmp -s - "$audit_preauth_running"
  audit_preauth_pipeline_status=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
  set -e
  test "${#audit_preauth_pipeline_status[@]}" = 2 || return 1
  test "${audit_preauth_pipeline_status[0]}" = 0 || return 1
  test "${audit_preauth_pipeline_status[1]}" = 0 || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_compare_checker_fence_commit() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  audit_preauth_root="$1"
  audit_preauth_commit="$2"
  audit_preauth_running="$3"
  audit_require_running_executable "$audit_preauth_running" || return 1
  set +e
  git -C "$audit_preauth_root" show \
    "$audit_preauth_commit:$audit_plan_path" | \
    awk -v header="$audit_expected_header" \
      -v begin="$audit_checker_begin" -v end="$audit_checker_end" '
      {
        line[NR] = $0
        if (NR == 1 && $0 == header) header_ok = 1
        if ($0 == begin) {begin_count++; first = NR}
        if ($0 == end) {end_count++; last = NR}
      }
      END {
        if (!header_ok || begin_count != 1 || end_count != 1 ||
            first >= last || line[first + 1] != "```bash" ||
            line[last - 1] != "```") exit 1
        for (number = first + 2; number < last - 1; number++)
          print line[number]
      }
    ' | cmp -s - "$audit_preauth_running"
  audit_preauth_pipeline_status=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
  set -e
  test "${#audit_preauth_pipeline_status[@]}" = 3 || return 1
  test "${audit_preauth_pipeline_status[0]}" = 0 || return 1
  test "${audit_preauth_pipeline_status[1]}" = 0 || return 1
  test "${audit_preauth_pipeline_status[2]}" = 0 || return 1
  return 0
}

audit_preallocate_self_authenticate() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  audit_preauth_mode="$1"
  audit_preauth_target="$2"
  audit_require_prelaunch_bundle_latch "$audit_preauth_mode" \
    "$audit_preauth_target" "$0" "$audit_candidate_core" \
    "$audit_candidate_core_sha" || return 1
  audit_preauth_root_token="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || return 1
  test -n "$audit_preauth_root_token" || return 1
  audit_preauth_root="$(cd "$audit_preauth_root_token" && \
    pwd -P)" || return 1
  test "$audit_preauth_root" = "$audit_expected_root" || return 1
  audit_preauth_branch="$(git -C "$audit_preauth_root" \
    symbolic-ref -q HEAD)" || return 1
  test "$audit_preauth_branch" = "$audit_expected_branch" || return 1
  audit_preauth_head="$(git -C "$audit_preauth_root" \
    rev-parse HEAD)" || return 1
  case "$audit_preauth_mode" in
    candidate)
      test "$audit_preauth_head" = "$audit_expected_parent" || return 1
      test "$audit_preauth_target" = \
        "$audit_expected_root/$audit_plan_path" || return 1
      audit_preauth_parent="$(cd "${audit_preauth_target%/*}" && \
        pwd -P)" || return 1
      test "$audit_preauth_parent" = \
        "$audit_expected_root/docs/superpowers/plans" || return 1
      audit_compare_checker_fence_file \
        "$audit_preauth_target" "$0" || return 1
      ;;
    committed)
      case "$audit_preauth_target" in
        ????????????????????????????????????????) ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
      esac
      case "$audit_preauth_target" in
        *[!0123456789abcdef]*) return 1 ;;
      esac
      audit_preauth_verified_commit="$(git -C "$audit_preauth_root" \
        rev-parse --verify "$audit_preauth_target^{commit}")" || return 1
      test "$audit_preauth_verified_commit" = \
        "$audit_preauth_target" || return 1
      test "$audit_preauth_head" = "$audit_preauth_target" || return 1
      audit_compare_checker_fence_commit "$audit_preauth_root" \
        "$audit_preauth_target" "$0" || return 1
      ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}
