case "$git_dir_token" in
  /*) git_dir="$(cd "$git_dir_token" && pwd -P)" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1 ;;
  *) git_dir="$(cd "$execution_root/$git_dir_token" && pwd -P)" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1 ;;
esac
common_dir_token="$(git -C "$execution_root" rev-parse --git-common-dir)" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
case "$common_dir_token" in
  /*) common_dir="$(cd "$common_dir_token" && pwd -P)" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1 ;;
  *) common_dir="$(cd "$execution_root/$common_dir_token" && pwd -P)" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1 ;;
esac
test "$git_dir" != "$common_dir" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
worktree_record="$({ set -o pipefail; \
  git -C "$execution_root" worktree list --porcelain | \
  awk -v wanted="worktree $execution_root" '
    $1 == "worktree" { selected = ($0 == wanted) }
    selected { print }
  '; })" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(printf '%s\n' "$worktree_record" | awk -v wanted="worktree $execution_root" \
  '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(printf '%s\n' "$worktree_record" | awk -v wanted="HEAD $plan_commit" \
  '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(printf '%s\n' "$worktree_record" | awk -v wanted="branch $TASK5_EXPECTED_BRANCH" \
  '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_worktree_forbidden_count="$({ set -o pipefail; \
  printf '%s\n' "$worktree_record" | \
  awk '/^(detached|locked|prunable)([[:space:]]|$)/ {n++} \
    END {print n + 0}'; })" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
case "$task5_worktree_forbidden_count" in
  ''|*[!0123456789]*) task5_bootstrap_abort 1 ;;
esac
test "$task5_worktree_forbidden_count" = 0 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1

plan_path="$TASK5_EXPECTED_PLAN_PATH"
source_plan_path="$TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_PATH"
task5_bootstrap_validate_recovery_authority "$task5_authority_source" \
  "$task5_authority_expected_sha" "$plan_commit" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_evidence_root="$(mktemp -d /private/tmp/ssr-task5-recovery-evidence.XXXXXXXX)" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
retired_path="$task5_evidence_root/retired.identity"
retired_manifest_path="$task5_evidence_root/retired.manifest.sha256"
retired_directories_path="$task5_evidence_root/retired.directories"
chmod 700 "$task5_evidence_root" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$task5_evidence_root" 700 || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
controller_home="$task5_evidence_root/controller-home"
commands_root="$task5_evidence_root/commands"
task5_ledger_chain_root="$task5_evidence_root/ledger-chain"
aliases_root="$task5_evidence_root/aliases"
review_packages_root="$task5_evidence_root/review-packages"
review_inbox_root="$task5_evidence_root/review-inbox"
review_responses_root="$task5_evidence_root/review-responses"
state_root="$task5_evidence_root/state"
report_gates_root="$task5_evidence_root/report-gates"
finalized_path="$task5_evidence_root/finalized"
finalized_pending_path="$task5_evidence_root/finalized.pending"
for task5_bootstrap_dir in "$controller_home" "$commands_root" \
    "$task5_ledger_chain_root" \
    "$aliases_root" "$review_packages_root" "$review_inbox_root" \
    "$review_responses_root" "$state_root" "$report_gates_root"; do
  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_bootstrap_dir" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  mkdir -m 700 "$task5_bootstrap_dir" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$task5_bootstrap_dir" 700 || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(cd "$task5_bootstrap_dir/.." && pwd -P)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_evidence_root" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
done
authority_bundle_root="$task5_evidence_root/authority-bundle"
task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$authority_bundle_root" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cp -R -p "$task5_authority_source" "$authority_bundle_root" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$authority_bundle_root" \
  "$authority_bundle_root/manifest.sha256" "$task5_authority_expected_sha" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_validate_recovery_authority "$authority_bundle_root" \
  "$task5_authority_expected_sha" "$plan_commit" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
authority_bundle_sha="$task5_authority_expected_sha"
authority_receipt="$authority_bundle_root/authority.receipt"
approval_text="$authority_bundle_root/implementation-approval.txt"
approval_reference="$authority_bundle_root/implementation-approval.reference"
recovery_review_package="$authority_bundle_root/P5R1-review-package"
recovery_review_manifest="$recovery_review_package/manifest.sha256"
recovery_review_identity="$recovery_review_package/package.identity"
recovery_review_design="$recovery_review_package/design.md"
recovery_review_plan="$recovery_review_package/plan.md"
recovery_review_checker="$recovery_review_package/checker.sh"
recovery_review_bootstrap="$recovery_review_package/bootstrap.sh"
recovery_review_runtime="$recovery_review_package/runtime.sh"
recovery_review_launcher="$recovery_review_package/launcher.sh"
recovery_checker_delta="$recovery_review_package/checker.delta"
recovery_bootstrap_delta="$recovery_review_package/bootstrap.delta"
recovery_runtime_delta="$recovery_review_package/runtime.delta"
derivation_manifest="$recovery_review_package/derivation.manifest"
recovery_core_manifest="$recovery_review_package/core.manifest"
candidate_audit_identity="$recovery_review_package/candidate-audit.identity"
committed_audit_identity="$recovery_review_package/committed-audit.identity"
p0_provenance_identity="$recovery_review_package/P0-provenance.identity"
p0_authority_root="$recovery_review_package/P0-authority"
failure_package_root="$recovery_review_package/failed-attempt"
prelaunch_verifier_path="$authority_bundle_root/prelaunch-verifier.command"
prelaunch_committed_bundle_root="$authority_bundle_root/prelaunch-committed"
prelaunch_verifier_sha256="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" prelaunch-verifier-command-sha256)" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
prelaunch_committed_root_receipt_sha256="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" committed-root-receipt-file-sha256)" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$prelaunch_verifier_sha256" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
  "$prelaunch_committed_root_receipt_sha256" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$prelaunch_verifier_path" \
  "$authority_receipt" prelaunch-verifier-command-sha256 || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt \
  "$prelaunch_committed_bundle_root/root.receipt.sha256" \
  "$authority_receipt" committed-root-receipt-file-sha256 || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
for task5_authority_file in "$authority_receipt" "$approval_text" \
    "$approval_reference" "$recovery_review_manifest" \
    "$recovery_review_identity" "$recovery_review_design" \
    "$recovery_review_plan" "$recovery_review_checker" \
    "$recovery_review_bootstrap" "$recovery_review_runtime" \
    "$recovery_review_launcher" \
    "$recovery_checker_delta" "$recovery_bootstrap_delta" \
    "$recovery_runtime_delta" "$derivation_manifest" \
    "$recovery_core_manifest" "$candidate_audit_identity" \
    "$committed_audit_identity" "$p0_provenance_identity" \
    "$authority_bundle_root/P5R1.spec.response.md" \
    "$authority_bundle_root/P5R1.spec.identity" \
    "$authority_bundle_root/P5R1.quality.response.md" \
    "$authority_bundle_root/P5R1.quality.identity"; do
  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_authority_file" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_authority_file")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 400 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
done
task5_bootstrap_require_recovery_authority_receipt_schema \
  "$authority_receipt" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" version)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  task5-recovery-authority-v1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" P0)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$source_plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" D5R1)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" P5R1)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
  source-plan-path)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = "$source_plan_path" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" plan-path)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$plan_path" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" amendment)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
for task5_authority_sha_field in source-plan-sha256 plan-sha256 \
    checker-sha256 bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 \
    derivation-manifest-sha256 core-manifest-sha256 \
    canonical-mutation-manifest-sha256 \
    failure-package-manifest-sha256 \
    original-authority-manifest-sha256 review-package-sha256 \
    spec-response-sha256 quality-response-sha256 approval-text-sha256 \
    approval-reference-sha256 prelaunch-verifier-command-sha256 \
    candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256 \
    candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256 candidate-launch-identity-sha256 \
    committed-root-receipt-file-sha256 \
    committed-bundle-manifest-sha256 \
    committed-launch-identity-sha256; do
  task5_authority_sha_value="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
    "$authority_receipt" "$task5_authority_sha_field")" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_authority_sha_value" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
done
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
  source-plan-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  af1b536f268f11bfe9abaf2a30fe49fcfe06bbc225df774c49a6b443515650a3 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
  canonical-mutation-manifest-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  b9c740421824b9cdd0e482ee63ad2baf1da9f83d8c43e89dbb37094699342b92 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
  failure-package-manifest-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_FAILURE_PACKAGE_SHA256" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
  original-authority-manifest-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_implementation_actor_reference="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" implementation-actor-reference)" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_p5r1_spec_reviewer_reference="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" spec-reviewer-reference)" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_p5r1_quality_reviewer_reference="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" quality-reviewer-reference)" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_independent_reviewer_references \
  "$task5_implementation_actor_reference" \
  "$task5_p5r1_spec_reviewer_reference" \
  "$task5_p5r1_quality_reviewer_reference" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1

recovery_review_package_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" review-package-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$recovery_review_package" \
  "$recovery_review_manifest" "$recovery_review_package_sha" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$p0_authority_root" \
  "$p0_authority_root/manifest.sha256" "$TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$failure_package_root" \
  "$failure_package_root/manifest.sha256" "$TASK5_FAILURE_PACKAGE_SHA256" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$recovery_review_identity" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = 20 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$recovery_review_identity" \
  format)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = task5-recovery-plan-review-v1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
for task5_recovery_identity_field in P0 D5R1 P5R1 source-plan-path \
    plan-path source-plan-sha256 plan-sha256 checker-sha256 \
    bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 derivation-manifest-sha256 \
    core-manifest-sha256 canonical-mutation-manifest-sha256 \
    failure-package-manifest-sha256 \
    original-authority-manifest-sha256 amendment \
    implementation-actor-reference spec-reviewer-reference \
    quality-reviewer-reference; do
  task5_bootstrap_require_matching_receipt_value \
    "$recovery_review_identity" "$authority_receipt" \
    "$task5_recovery_identity_field" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
done

task5_recovery_design_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
  "$recovery_review_design" | awk '{print $1}')" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_recovery_design_sha" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_recovery_design_sha" = \
  3e515e505187d5c6f1eae613455df2d552c6373afd48f74771bdb8fdfd1445e6 || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$recovery_review_plan" \
  "$authority_receipt" plan-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$recovery_review_checker" \
  "$authority_receipt" checker-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$recovery_review_bootstrap" \
  "$authority_receipt" bootstrap-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$recovery_review_runtime" \
  "$authority_receipt" runtime-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_recovery_launch_sha256="${TASK5_RECOVERY_LAUNCH_IDENTITY%%|*}"
task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_recovery_launch_sha256" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_recovery_packaged_launch_sha256="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
  "$recovery_review_launcher")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_recovery_packaged_launch_sha256" = \
  "$task5_recovery_launch_sha256" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$derivation_manifest" \
  "$authority_receipt" derivation-manifest-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$recovery_core_manifest" \
  "$authority_receipt" core-manifest-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$task5_bootstrap_path" \
  "$authority_receipt" bootstrap-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$task5_bootstrap_path" "$recovery_review_bootstrap" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1

for task5_audit_mode in candidate committed; do
  if test "$task5_audit_mode" = candidate; then
    task5_audit_identity="$candidate_audit_identity"
    task5_audit_p5r1=UNRESOLVED
  else
    task5_audit_identity="$committed_audit_identity"
    task5_audit_p5r1="$plan_commit"
  fi
  task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_audit_identity" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 19 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" \
    format)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = task5-recovery-plan-audit-v1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" mode)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "$task5_audit_mode" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" P0)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "$source_plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" D5R1)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" P5R1)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "$task5_audit_p5r1" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  for task5_audit_sha_field in plan-sha256 checker-sha256 bootstrap-sha256 \
      runtime-sha256 derivation-manifest-sha256 core-manifest-sha256 \
      original-authority-manifest-sha256 \
      failure-package-manifest-sha256; do
    task5_bootstrap_require_matching_receipt_value \
      "$task5_audit_identity" "$authority_receipt" \
      "$task5_audit_sha_field" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  done
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" \
    amendment)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" launch)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "$TASK5_RECOVERY_LAUNCH_IDENTITY" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" \
    controller-invocations)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_INVOCATIONS_IDENTITY" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" \
    sequence-pre-final)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_PRE_FINAL_IDENTITY" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" \
    sequence-pre-report)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_PRE_REPORT_IDENTITY" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_audit_identity" \
    sequence-post-report)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_POST_REPORT_IDENTITY" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
done

task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$p0_provenance_identity" format)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  task5-recovery-P0-provenance-v1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$p0_provenance_identity" P0)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$source_plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$p0_provenance_identity" \
  original-authority-manifest-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$p0_authority_root/authority.receipt" P)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = "$source_plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$failure_package_root/failure.identity" P0)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = "$source_plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$failure_package_root/failure.identity" namespace)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = UNALLOCATED || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$failure_package_root/failure.identity" retired-manifest)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = ABSENT || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$failure_package_root/failure.identity" prelaunch-inventory)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = UNAVAILABLE || task5_bootstrap_abort 1

task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$approval_text" \
  "$authority_receipt" approval-text-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$approval_reference" \
  "$authority_receipt" approval-reference-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$approval_text" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$approval_text" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
approval_cr_count="$(awk \
  'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
  "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
case "$approval_cr_count" in
  ''|*[!0123456789]*) task5_bootstrap_abort 1 ;;
esac
test "$approval_cr_count" = 0 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(tail -c 1 "$approval_text" | od -An -tu1 | \
  tr -d '[:space:]')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
approval_plan_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
  plan-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
approval_spec_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
  spec-response-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
approval_quality_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
  quality-response-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '1p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  format=task5r1-implementation-approval-v1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '2p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = "P5R1=$plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '3p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "P5R1-PLAN-SHA256=$approval_plan_sha" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '4p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "P5R1-REVIEW-PACKAGE-SHA256=$recovery_review_package_sha" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '5p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "P5R1-SPEC-RESPONSE-SHA256=$approval_spec_sha" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '6p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "P5R1-QUALITY-RESPONSE-SHA256=$approval_quality_sha" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '7p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "IMPLEMENTATION-ACTOR-REFERENCE=$task5_implementation_actor_reference" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '8p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "USER-APPROVAL-VERBATIM=APPROVE P5R1 $plan_commit PLAN $approval_plan_sha PACKAGE $recovery_review_package_sha SPEC $approval_spec_sha QUALITY $approval_quality_sha AMENDMENT $TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '9p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "AMENDMENT=$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(sed -n '10p' "$approval_text")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = DECISION=APPROVE || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_approval_reference="$(task5_bootstrap_read_coordination_reference_file \
  "$approval_reference")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
for task5_review_lane in spec quality; do
  task5_review_response="$authority_bundle_root/P5R1.$task5_review_lane.response.md"
  task5_review_identity="$authority_bundle_root/P5R1.$task5_review_lane.identity"
  task5_response_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_review_response" | \
    awk '{print $1}')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_response_sha" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_expected_response_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
    "$authority_receipt" "$task5_review_lane-response-sha256")" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_response_sha" = "$task5_expected_response_sha" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  if test "$task5_review_lane" = spec; then
    task5_expected_reviewer_reference="$task5_p5r1_spec_reviewer_reference"
  else
    task5_expected_reviewer_reference="$task5_p5r1_quality_reviewer_reference"
  fi
  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_review_response" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_response_cr_count="$(awk \
    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
    "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  case "$task5_response_cr_count" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) task5_bootstrap_abort 1 ;;
  esac
  test "$task5_response_cr_count" = 0 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_review_response" | od -An -tu1 | \
    tr -d '[:space:]')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec '^PACKAGE-SHA256:' "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec '^REVIEWER-REFERENCE:' "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec '^IMPLEMENTATION-ACTOR-REFERENCE:' \
    "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec '^VERDICT:' "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(grep -Fxc "PACKAGE-SHA256: $recovery_review_package_sha" \
    "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(grep -Fxc "REVIEWER-REFERENCE: $task5_expected_reviewer_reference" \
    "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(grep -Fxc \
    "IMPLEMENTATION-ACTOR-REFERENCE: $task5_implementation_actor_reference" \
    "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec \
    '^VERDICT: APPROVE CRITICAL=0 IMPORTANT=0 MINOR=[0-9]+$' \
    "$task5_review_response")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_bootstrap_require_minor_dispositions "$task5_review_response" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_review_identity" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 6 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_review_identity" || \
    task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_identity_cr_count="$(awk \
    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
    "$task5_review_identity")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  case "$task5_identity_cr_count" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) task5_bootstrap_abort 1 ;;
  esac
  test "$task5_identity_cr_count" = 0 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_review_identity" | od -An -tu1 | \
    tr -d '[:space:]')" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '1p' "$task5_review_identity")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = checkpoint=P5R1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '2p' "$task5_review_identity")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "lane=$task5_review_lane" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '3p' "$task5_review_identity")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "package-sha256=$recovery_review_package_sha" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '4p' "$task5_review_identity")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "response-sha256=$task5_response_sha" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '5p' "$task5_review_identity")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "reviewer-reference=$task5_expected_reviewer_reference" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '6p' "$task5_review_identity")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "implementation-actor-reference=$task5_implementation_actor_reference" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_review_identity" \
    checkpoint)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = P5R1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_review_identity" lane)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = \
    "$task5_review_lane" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_review_identity" \
    package-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$recovery_review_package_sha" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_review_identity" \
    response-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_response_sha" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_review_identity" \
    reviewer-reference)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_expected_reviewer_reference" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_review_identity" \
    implementation-actor-reference)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_implementation_actor_reference" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
done

task5_bootstrap_write_ledger_genesis || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_audit_ledger 0 "$task5_ledger_head_sha256" \
  "$task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1

p0_alias="$task5_evidence_root/P0.alias"

for task5_plan_alias in "$p0_alias" "$p5r1_alias"; do

printf '%s\n' "$source_plan_commit" > "$p0_alias" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
printf '%s\n' "$plan_commit" > "$p5r1_alias" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
chmod 600 "$p0_alias" "$p5r1_alias" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(cat "$p0_alias")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = "$source_plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(cat "$p5r1_alias")" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = "$plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1

source_plan_blob="$task5_evidence_root/P0-plan.md"
plan_blob="$task5_evidence_root/P5R1-plan.md"
git -C "$execution_root" show \

  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
git -C "$execution_root" show "$plan_commit:$plan_path" > "$plan_blob" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$source_plan_blob" \

cmp -s "$plan_blob" "$recovery_review_plan" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$source_plan_blob" \
  "$authority_receipt" source-plan-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$plan_blob" \
  "$authority_receipt" plan-sha256 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1

source_checker="$task5_evidence_root/P0-checker.sh"
source_bootstrap="$task5_evidence_root/P0-bootstrap.sh"
source_runtime="$task5_evidence_root/P0-runtime.sh"
task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$source_plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5-PLAN-AUDIT-BEGIN -->' '<!-- TASK5-PLAN-AUDIT-END -->' \
  '```bash' '```' "$source_checker" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$source_plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5-BOOTSTRAP-BEGIN -->' '<!-- TASK5-BOOTSTRAP-END -->' \
  '```bash' '```' "$source_bootstrap" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$source_plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5-RUNTIME-BEGIN -->' '<!-- TASK5-RUNTIME-END -->' \
  '```bash' '```' "$source_runtime" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$source_checker" "$p0_authority_root/P-review-package/checker.sh" || \

cmp -s "$source_bootstrap" "$p0_authority_root/P-review-package/bootstrap.sh" || \

cmp -s "$source_runtime" "$p0_authority_root/P-review-package/runtime.sh" || \

embedded_checker="$task5_evidence_root/P5R1-checker.embedded.sh"

extracted_checker_delta="$task5_evidence_root/checker.delta"
extracted_bootstrap_delta="$task5_evidence_root/bootstrap.delta"
extracted_runtime_delta="$task5_evidence_root/runtime.delta"

task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-PLAN-AUDIT-BEGIN -->' \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-PLAN-AUDIT-END -->' '```bash' '```' "$embedded_checker" || \

task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-BOOTSTRAP-BEGIN -->' '<!-- TASK5R1-BOOTSTRAP-END -->' \

task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-CHECKER-DELTA-BEGIN -->' \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-CHECKER-DELTA-END -->' '~~~diff' '~~~' \
  "$extracted_checker_delta" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-BOOTSTRAP-DELTA-BEGIN -->' \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-BOOTSTRAP-DELTA-END -->' '~~~diff' '~~~' \
  "$extracted_bootstrap_delta" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-RUNTIME-DELTA-BEGIN -->' \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-RUNTIME-DELTA-END -->' '~~~diff' '~~~' \
  "$extracted_runtime_delta" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_extract_fence "$plan_blob" \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-DERIVATION-MANIFEST-BEGIN -->' \
  '<!-- TASK5R1-DERIVATION-MANIFEST-END -->' '```text' '```' \
  "$extracted_derivation_manifest" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$embedded_checker" "$recovery_review_checker" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$embedded_bootstrap" "$recovery_review_bootstrap" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$extracted_checker_delta" "$recovery_checker_delta" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$extracted_bootstrap_delta" "$recovery_bootstrap_delta" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$extracted_runtime_delta" "$recovery_runtime_delta" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$extracted_derivation_manifest" "$derivation_manifest" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$derivation_manifest" format)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  task5-recovery-derivation-v1 || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$derivation_manifest" P0)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$source_plan_commit" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$derivation_manifest" D5R1)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_command_output" = \
  "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1

plan_auditor="$task5_evidence_root/task5-recovery-plan-audit.sh"
derived_bootstrap="$task5_evidence_root/task5-recovery-bootstrap.derived.sh"
task5_driver="$task5_evidence_root/task5-recovery-controller.sh"
task5_bootstrap_apply_derivation checker "$source_checker" \
  "$extracted_checker_delta" "$plan_auditor" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_apply_derivation bootstrap "$source_bootstrap" \
  "$extracted_bootstrap_delta" "$derived_bootstrap" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_bootstrap_apply_derivation runtime "$source_runtime" \
  "$extracted_runtime_delta" "$task5_driver" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$plan_auditor" "$embedded_checker" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$derived_bootstrap" "$embedded_bootstrap" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$derived_bootstrap" "$task5_bootstrap_path" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
cmp -s "$task5_driver" "$recovery_review_runtime" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -n "$plan_auditor" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -n "$derived_bootstrap" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -n "$task5_driver" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
plan_auditor_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$plan_auditor" | awk '{print $1}')" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_driver_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_driver" | awk '{print $1}')" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_expected_checker_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" checker-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$plan_auditor_sha" = "$task5_expected_checker_sha" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
task5_expected_runtime_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" runtime-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
test "$task5_driver_sha" = "$task5_expected_runtime_sha" || \

canonical_mutation_manifest_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" canonical-mutation-manifest-sha256)" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1
derivation_manifest_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
  "$authority_receipt" derivation-manifest-sha256)" || task5_bootstrap_abort 1
original_authority_sha="$TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256"
failure_package_sha="$TASK5_FAILURE_PACKAGE_SHA256"
chmod 400 "$plan_auditor" "$derived_bootstrap" "$task5_driver" \
  "$source_plan_blob" "$plan_blob" "$source_checker" "$source_bootstrap" \
  "$source_runtime" "$embedded_checker" "$embedded_bootstrap" \
  "$extracted_checker_delta" "$extracted_bootstrap_delta" \
  "$extracted_runtime_delta" "$extracted_derivation_manifest" || \
  task5_bootstrap_abort 1

task5_bootstrap_clean_call_body() {
  task5_finalized_guard_reported=0
  task5_bootstrap_set_abort_context "$#" "${1-}" || return 1
  test "$#" -ge 1 || return 1
  if test -e "$retired_path" || test -L "$retired_path"; then
    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$retired_path" || return 1
    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$retired_manifest_path" || return 1
    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$retired_directories_path" || return 1
    task5_command_output="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$retired_path")" || return 1
    test "$task5_command_output" = 400 || return 1
    task5_command_output="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$retired_manifest_path")" || return 1
    test "$task5_command_output" = 400 || return 1
    task5_command_output="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$retired_directories_path")" || return 1
    test "$task5_command_output" = 400 || return 1
    task5_retired_guard_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$retired_manifest_path" | \
      awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_retired_guard_sha" || return 1
    task5_bootstrap_verify_retired_namespace "$task5_evidence_root" \
      "$retired_manifest_path" "$task5_retired_guard_sha" \
      "$retired_directories_path" || return 1
    printf 'Task 5 evidence namespace is retired; no later action is authorized.\n' \
      >&2 || return 1
    return 1
  fi
  if test -e "$finalized_path" || test -L "$finalized_path"; then
    task5_finalized_guard_status=0
    task5_bootstrap_verify_finalized_receipt "$finalized_path" || \
      task5_finalized_guard_status=$?
    if test "$task5_finalized_guard_status" = 0 && \
        test "${task5_finalized_externalized-0}" = 1; then
      task5_finalized_guard_reported=1
      printf 'Task 5 evidence namespace is finalized; no later action is authorized; preserve namespace %s unchanged.\n' \
        "$task5_evidence_root" >&2 || return 1
      return 1
    fi
    return 1
  fi
  task5_bootstrap_audit_ledger "$task5_ledger_entry_count" \
    "$task5_ledger_head_sha256" \
    "$task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256" || return 1
  task5_action="$task5_abort_context_action"
  task5_ordinal=$((task5_ledger_entry_count + 1))
  task5_bootstrap_require_action_ordinal "$task5_action" "$task5_ordinal" \
    "$task5_ledger_entry_count" "$#" || return 1
  task5_ordinal_name="$task5_abort_context_ordinal"
  task5_entry="$commands_root/$task5_ordinal_name"
  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_entry" || return 1
  mkdir -m 700 "$task5_entry" || return 1
  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$task5_entry" 700 || return 1
  task5_command_output="$(cd "$task5_entry/.." && pwd -P)" || return 1
  test "$task5_command_output" = "$commands_root" || return 1
  task5_entry_chain_before="$task5_ledger_head_sha256"
  task5_entry_previous_manifest_sha="$task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256"
  task5_action_dir="$task5_entry/artifacts"
  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_action_dir" || return 1
  mkdir -m 700 "$task5_action_dir" || return 1
  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$task5_action_dir" 700 || return 1
  task5_artifacts_closure="$task5_action_dir/.directory-closure"
  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_artifacts_closure" || return 1
  printf 'format=task5-action-artifacts-directory-v1\n' \
    > "$task5_artifacts_closure" || return 1
  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_artifacts_closure" || return 1

  task5_argv_path="$task5_entry/argv.q"
  task5_stdout_path="$task5_entry/stdout"
  task5_stderr_path="$task5_entry/stderr"
  task5_exit_path="$task5_entry/exit"
  task5_controller_identity="$task5_entry/controller.identity"
  task5_manifest_path="$task5_entry/manifest.sha256"
  for task5_output_path in "$task5_argv_path" "$task5_stdout_path" \
      "$task5_stderr_path" "$task5_exit_path" "$task5_controller_identity" \
      "$task5_manifest_path"; do
    task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_output_path" || return 1
  done
  printf '%q ' /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "$task5_driver" \
    > "$task5_argv_path" || return 1
  for task5_argv in "$@"; do
    printf '%q ' "$task5_argv" >> "$task5_argv_path" || return 1
  done
  printf '\n' >> "$task5_argv_path" || return 1
  task5_bootstrap_capture_repo_state "$execution_root" \
    "$task5_entry/before" || return 1
  printf 'controller-sha256=%s\nplan-auditor-sha256=%s\nbootstrap-sha256=%s\ncanonical-mutation-manifest-sha256=%s\nderivation-manifest-sha256=%s\noriginal-authority-manifest-sha256=%s\nfailure-package-manifest-sha256=%s\nauthority-bundle-manifest-sha256=%s\nimplementation-actor-reference=%s\nP0=%s\nD5R1=%s\nP5R1=%s\nsource-plan-path=%s\nplan-path=%s\namendment=%s\nledger-chain-before=%s\nprevious-entry-manifest-sha256=%s\n' \
    "$task5_driver_sha" "$plan_auditor_sha" "$task5_bootstrap_sha" \
    "$canonical_mutation_manifest_sha" "$derivation_manifest_sha" \
    "$original_authority_sha" "$failure_package_sha" \
    "$authority_bundle_sha" "$task5_implementation_actor_reference" \
    "$source_plan_commit" "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" "$plan_commit" \
    "$source_plan_path" "$plan_path" "$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" \
    "$task5_entry_chain_before" "$task5_entry_previous_manifest_sha" \
    > "$task5_controller_identity" || return 1

  if /usr/bin/env -i \
    PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/Cellar/dotnet/10.0.300/bin \
    LC_ALL=C LANG=C \
    HOME="$controller_home" TMPDIR=/private/tmp \
    GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 \
    DOTNET_CLI_HOME="$controller_home" DOTNET_CLI_UI_LANGUAGE=en \
    DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_CLI_WORKLOAD_UPDATE_NOTIFY_DISABLE=true \
    DOTNET_SDK_VULNERABILITY_CHECK_DISABLE=true DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 \
    DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE=1 NUGET_XMLDOC_MODE=skip \
    PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PIP_NO_INDEX=1 UV_OFFLINE=1 \
    TASK5_CLEAN_CONTROLLER=1 \
    TASK5_EXECUTION_ROOT="$execution_root" \
    TASK5_EVIDENCE_ROOT="$task5_evidence_root" \
    TASK5_COMMANDS_ROOT="$commands_root" \
    TASK5_LEDGER_CHAIN_ROOT="$task5_ledger_chain_root" \
    TASK5_LEDGER_CHAIN_BEFORE="$task5_entry_chain_before" \
    TASK5_LEDGER_PREVIOUS_MANIFEST_SHA256="$task5_entry_previous_manifest_sha" \
    TASK5_ACCEPTED_REVIEW_CHECKPOINT="$task5_accepted_review_checkpoint" \
    TASK5_ACCEPTED_REVIEW_PACKAGE_SHA256="$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" \
    TASK5_ACCEPTED_SPEC_RESPONSE_SHA256="$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" \
    TASK5_ACCEPTED_QUALITY_RESPONSE_SHA256="$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" \
    TASK5_ACTION_DIR="$task5_action_dir" \
    TASK5_PLAN_COMMIT="$plan_commit" \
    TASK5_PLAN_PATH="$plan_path" \
    TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_COMMIT="$source_plan_commit" \
    TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_PATH="$source_plan_path" \
    TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT="$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" \
    TASK5_P0_ALIAS="$p0_alias" \
    TASK5_P5R1_ALIAS="$p5r1_alias" \
    TASK5_DRIVER_PATH="$task5_driver" \
    TASK5_DRIVER_SHA="$task5_driver_sha" \
    TASK5_PLAN_AUDITOR_PATH="$plan_auditor" \
    TASK5_PLAN_AUDITOR_SHA="$plan_auditor_sha" \
    TASK5_BOOTSTRAP_SHA="$task5_bootstrap_sha" \
    TASK5_CANONICAL_MUTATION_MANIFEST_SHA="$canonical_mutation_manifest_sha" \
    TASK5_DERIVATION_MANIFEST_SHA256="$derivation_manifest_sha" \
    TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256="$original_authority_sha" \
    TASK5_FAILURE_PACKAGE_SHA256="$failure_package_sha" \
    TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT="$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" \
    TASK5_AUTHORITY_BUNDLE_ROOT="$authority_bundle_root" \
    TASK5_AUTHORITY_BUNDLE_SHA="$authority_bundle_sha" \
    TASK5_PRELAUNCH_VERIFIER_PATH="$prelaunch_verifier_path" \
    TASK5_PRELAUNCH_VERIFIER_SHA256="$prelaunch_verifier_sha256" \
    TASK5_PRELAUNCH_COMMITTED_BUNDLE_ROOT="$prelaunch_committed_bundle_root" \
    TASK5_PRELAUNCH_COMMITTED_ROOT_RECEIPT_SHA256="$prelaunch_committed_root_receipt_sha256" \
    TASK5_IMPLEMENTATION_ACTOR_REFERENCE="$task5_implementation_actor_reference" \
    TASK5_REVIEW_PACKAGES_ROOT="$review_packages_root" \
    TASK5_REVIEW_INBOX_ROOT="$review_inbox_root" \
    TASK5_REVIEW_RESPONSES_ROOT="$review_responses_root" \
    TASK5_STATE_ROOT="$state_root" \
    TASK5_REPORT_GATES_ROOT="$report_gates_root" \
    TASK5_EXPECTED_BRANCH="$TASK5_EXPECTED_BRANCH" \
    TASK5_EXPECTED_PARENT="$TASK5_EXPECTED_PARENT" \
    TASK5_EXPECTED_SUBJECT="$TASK5_EXPECTED_SUBJECT" \
      /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "$task5_driver" "$@" \
      > "$task5_stdout_path" 2> "$task5_stderr_path"; then
    task5_child_status=0
  else
    task5_child_status=$?
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$task5_child_status" > "$task5_exit_path" || return 1
  task5_bootstrap_capture_repo_state "$execution_root" \
    "$task5_entry/after" || return 1
  cat "$task5_stdout_path" || return 1
  cat "$task5_stderr_path" >&2 || return 1

  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_manifest_path" || return 1
  : > "$task5_manifest_path" || return 1
  for task5_manifest_file in argv.q stdout stderr exit controller.identity \
      before.porcelain before.identity after.porcelain after.identity; do
    task5_manifest_file_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
      "$task5_entry/$task5_manifest_file" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
    printf '%s  %s\n' \
      "$task5_manifest_file_sha" "$task5_manifest_file" \
      >> "$task5_manifest_path" || return 1
  done
  find "$task5_action_dir" -type f -print | LC_ALL=C sort | \
    while IFS= read -r task5_artifact_file; do
      task5_artifact_relative="${task5_artifact_file#"$task5_entry/"}"
      task5_artifact_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_artifact_file" | \
        awk '{print $1}')" || exit 1
      printf '%s  %s\n' \
        "$task5_artifact_sha" "$task5_artifact_relative" \
        >> "$task5_manifest_path" || exit 1
    done || return 1
  find "$task5_entry" -type f -print | while IFS= read -r task5_file; do
    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_file" || exit 1
  done || return 1
  find "$task5_entry" -type f -print0 | \
    while IFS= read -r -d '' task5_chmod_file; do
      chmod 400 "$task5_chmod_file" || exit 1
    done || return 1
  find "$task5_entry" -depth -type d -print0 | \
    while IFS= read -r -d '' task5_chmod_directory; do
      chmod 500 "$task5_chmod_directory" || exit 1
    done || return 1
  task5_manifest_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_manifest_path" | \
    awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
  task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$task5_entry" \
    "$task5_manifest_path" "$task5_manifest_sha" || return 1

  task5_bootstrap_update_review_tuple "$task5_action" \
    "$task5_child_status" "${2-}" "${3-}" "${4-}" || return 1
  task5_bootstrap_write_ledger_link "$task5_ordinal_name" "$task5_action" \
    "$task5_manifest_sha" "$task5_entry_chain_before" \
    "$task5_entry_previous_manifest_sha" || return 1

  if test "$task5_action" = final-audit && test "$task5_child_status" = 0; then
    test "$task5_ordinal" = 148 || return 1
    task5_bootstrap_audit_ledger 148 "$task5_ledger_head_sha256" \
      "$task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256" || return 1
    task5_bootstrap_publish_finalized_receipt \
      "$task5_ordinal_name" || return 1
  fi
  if test "$task5_child_status" -ne 0; then
    task5_bootstrap_retire_namespace "$task5_child_status" "$task5_action" \
      "${task5_entry##*/}" || return 1
  fi
  if test "$task5_child_status" = 0; then
    task5_abort_context_action=bootstrap
    task5_abort_context_ordinal=000000
  fi
  return "$task5_child_status"
}

task5_clean_call() {
  task5_clean_call_status=0
  task5_bootstrap_clean_call_body "$@" || task5_clean_call_status=$?
  case "$task5_clean_call_status" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) task5_clean_call_status=1 ;;
  esac
  if test "$task5_clean_call_status" = 0; then
    return 0
  fi
  if test -e "$retired_path" || test -L "$retired_path"; then
    return "$task5_clean_call_status"
  fi
  if test "${task5_finalized_guard_reported-0}" = 1; then
    return "$task5_clean_call_status"
  fi
  task5_bootstrap_retire_namespace "$task5_clean_call_status" \
    "${task5_abort_context_action-bootstrap}" \
    "${task5_abort_context_ordinal-000000}" || return 1
  return "$task5_clean_call_status"
}

+task5_bootstrap_emit_retired_directories() (
+  set -euo pipefail
+  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
+  task5_emit_root="$1"
+  task5_emit_mode_source="$2"
+  task5_emit_initial_root_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_emit_root")" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$task5_emit_root" \
+    "$task5_emit_initial_root_mode" || return 1
+  task5_emit_expected_owner="$(id -u)" || return 1
+  task5_emit_root_owner="$(stat -f '%u' "$task5_emit_root")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_emit_root_owner" = \
+    "$task5_emit_expected_owner" || return 1
+  case "$task5_emit_mode_source" in
+    expected) task5_emit_root_mode=500 ;;
+    actual)
+      task5_emit_root_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_emit_root")" || return 1
+      test "$task5_emit_root_mode" = 500 || return 1
+      ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  printf '.|mode=%s|owner=%s\n' "$task5_emit_root_mode" \
+    "$task5_emit_root_owner" || return 1
+  find "$task5_emit_root" -mindepth 1 -type d -print | LC_ALL=C sort | \
+    while IFS= read -r task5_emit_dir; do
+      task5_emit_relative="${task5_emit_dir#"$task5_emit_root/"}"
+      test "$task5_emit_relative" != "$task5_emit_dir" || exit 1
+      case "$task5_emit_relative" in
+        ''|/*|..|../*|*/..|*/../*|*//*|*/|\
+        *[!0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._/-]*)
+          exit 1 ;;
+      esac
+      test ! -L "$task5_emit_dir" || exit 1
+      task5_emit_dir_owner="$(stat -f '%u' "$task5_emit_dir")" || exit 1
+      test "$task5_emit_dir_owner" = \
+        "$task5_emit_expected_owner" || exit 1
+      case "$task5_emit_mode_source" in
+        expected) task5_emit_mode=500 ;;
+        actual)
+          task5_emit_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_emit_dir")" || exit 1
+          test "$task5_emit_mode" = 500 || exit 1
+          ;;
+      esac
+      printf '%s|mode=%s|owner=%s\n' "$task5_emit_relative" \
+        "$task5_emit_mode" "$task5_emit_dir_owner" || exit 1
+    done || return 1
+  return 0
+)

+task5_bootstrap_verify_retired_namespace() (
+  set -euo pipefail
+  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
+  task5_retired_root="$1"
+  task5_retired_manifest="$2"
+  task5_retired_expected_sha="$3"
+  task5_retired_directories="$4"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$task5_retired_root" 500 || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_retired_manifest" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_retired_manifest_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
+    "$task5_retired_manifest")" || return 1
+  task5_retired_manifest_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
+    "$task5_retired_manifest")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_manifest_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_manifest_links" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file \
+    "$task5_retired_manifest" || return 1
+  task5_retired_manifest_cr_count="$(awk \
+    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_retired_manifest")" || return 1
+  task5_retired_manifest_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 \
+    "$task5_retired_manifest" | od -An -tu1 | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_manifest_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_manifest_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_retired_directories" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_retired_directories_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
+    "$task5_retired_directories")" || return 1
+  task5_retired_directories_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
+    "$task5_retired_directories")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_directories_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_directories_links" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file \
+    "$task5_retired_directories" || return 1
+  task5_retired_directories_cr_count="$(awk \
+    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_retired_directories")" || return 1
+  task5_retired_directories_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 \
+    "$task5_retired_directories" | od -An -tu1 | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_directories_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_directories_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_retired_expected_sha" || return 1
+  task5_retired_manifest_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_retired_manifest" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_manifest_sha" = "$task5_retired_expected_sha" || \
+    return 1
+  case "$task5_retired_manifest" in
+    "$task5_retired_root"/*)
+      task5_retired_manifest_relative="${task5_retired_manifest#"$task5_retired_root/"}" ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  case "$task5_retired_directories" in
+    "$task5_retired_root"/*)
+      task5_retired_directories_relative="${task5_retired_directories#"$task5_retired_root/"}" ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_retired_manifest_state="$(awk '
+    {
+      separator = index($0, "  ")
+      if (!separator) {bad = 1; next}
+      digest = substr($0, 1, separator - 1)
+      relative = substr($0, separator + 2)
+      if (length(digest) != 64 || digest !~ /^[0-9a-f]+$/) {
+        bad = 1
+        next
+      }
+      if (relative == "" || relative ~ /^\// || relative ~ /^\.\// ||
+          relative == "." || relative == ".." || relative ~ /^\.\.\// ||
+          relative ~ /\/\.\// || relative ~ /\/\.$/ ||
+          relative ~ /\/\.\.\// || relative ~ /\/\.\.$/ ||
+          relative ~ /\/\// || relative ~ /\/$/ ||
+          relative ~ /[^0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._\/-]/) {
+        bad = 1
+        next
+      }
+      folded = tolower(relative)
+      if (seen[folded]++) bad = 1
+    }
+    END {print bad ? "INVALID" : "VALID"}
+  ' "$task5_retired_manifest")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_manifest_state" = VALID || return 1
+  task5_retired_link_count="$(find "$task5_retired_root" -type l -print | \
+    awk 'END {print NR + 0}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_link_count" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_retired_special_count="$(find "$task5_retired_root" \
+    ! -type d ! -type f -print | awk 'END {print NR + 0}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_special_count" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_retired_entries=0
+  while IFS='  ' read -r task5_retired_file_sha \
+      task5_retired_relative; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_retired_file_sha" || return 1
+    test -n "$task5_retired_relative" || return 1
+    test "$task5_retired_relative" != \
+      "$task5_retired_manifest_relative" || return 1
+    case "$task5_retired_relative" in
+      /*|..|../*|*/..|*/../*) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    task5_retired_path="$task5_retired_root/$task5_retired_relative"
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_retired_path" || return 1
+    task5_retired_path_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_retired_path")" || \
+      return 1
+    task5_retired_path_links="$(stat -f '%l' "$task5_retired_path")" || \
+      return 1
+    task5_retired_path_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_retired_path" | \
+      awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+    test "$task5_retired_path_mode" = 400 || return 1
+    test "$task5_retired_path_links" = 1 || return 1
+    test "$task5_retired_path_sha" = "$task5_retired_file_sha" || return 1
+    task5_retired_entries=$((task5_retired_entries + 1))
+  done < "$task5_retired_manifest"
+  test "$task5_retired_entries" -gt 0 || return 1
+  task5_retired_file_count="$(find "$task5_retired_root" -type f | \
+    wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_file_count" = "$((task5_retired_entries + 1))" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_retired_directory_auth_count="$(awk -v \
+    wanted="$task5_retired_directories_relative" '
+    {
+      separator = index($0, "  ")
+      relative = substr($0, separator + 2)
+      if (separator && relative == wanted) n++
+    }
+    END {print n + 0}
+  ' "$task5_retired_manifest")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_directory_auth_count" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_retired_directories" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_retired_directories" | od -An -tu1 | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_retired_directories_cr_count="$(awk \
+    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_retired_directories")" || return 1
+  case "$task5_retired_directories_cr_count" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_retired_directories_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_retired_expected_owner="$(id -u)" || return 1
+  task5_retired_directory_state="$(awk -F '|' \
+    -v owner="$task5_retired_expected_owner" '
+    {
+      if (NF != 3 || $2 != "mode=500" || $3 != "owner=" owner) {
+        bad = 1
+        next
+      }
+      relative = $1
+      if (relative == ".") {
+        roots++
+      } else if (relative == "" || relative ~ /^\// ||
+          relative == ".." || relative ~ /^\.\.\// ||
+          relative ~ /\/\.\// || relative ~ /\/\.$/ ||
+          relative ~ /\/\.\.\// || relative ~ /\/\.\.$/ ||
+          relative ~ /\/\// || relative ~ /\/$/ ||
+          relative ~ /[^0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._\/-]/) {
+        bad = 1
+      }
+      folded = tolower(relative)
+      if (seen[folded]++) bad = 1
+    }
+    END {
+      if (roots != 1 || NR == 0) bad = 1
+      print bad ? "INVALID" : "VALID"
+    }
+  ' "$task5_retired_directories")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_retired_directory_state" = VALID || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_emit_retired_directories "$task5_retired_root" actual | \
+    cmp -s - "$task5_retired_directories" || return 1
+  return 0
+)
