+task5_bootstrap_require_exact_schema() {
+  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_schema_file="$1"
+  task5_schema_lines="$2"
+  task5_schema_keys="$3"
+  case "$task5_schema_lines" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_schema_file" || return 1
+  task5_schema_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_schema_file")" || return 1
+  task5_schema_links="$(stat -f '%l' "$task5_schema_file")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_schema_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_schema_links" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_schema_cr_count="$(awk \
+    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_schema_file")" || return 1
+  task5_schema_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_schema_file" | \
+    od -An -tu1 | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_schema_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+  test "$task5_schema_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_schema_state="$(awk -v expected="$task5_schema_keys" \
+      -v expected_lines="$task5_schema_lines" '
+    BEGIN {key_count = split(expected, keys, "[|]")}
+    {
+      separator = index($0, "=")
+      if (separator < 2) bad = 1
+      key = substr($0, 1, separator - 1)
+      if (NR > key_count || key != keys[NR] || seen[key]++) bad = 1
+    }
+    END {
+      if (NR != expected_lines || key_count != expected_lines) bad = 1
+      print bad ? "INVALID" : "VALID"
+    }
+  ' "$task5_schema_file")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_schema_state" = VALID || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_recovery_authority_receipt_schema() {
+  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_authority_receipt_keys='version|P0|D5R1|P5R1|source-plan-path|plan-path|source-plan-sha256|plan-sha256|checker-sha256|bootstrap-sha256|runtime-sha256|derivation-manifest-sha256|core-manifest-sha256|canonical-mutation-manifest-sha256|failure-package-manifest-sha256|original-authority-manifest-sha256|review-package-sha256|spec-response-sha256|quality-response-sha256|approval-text-sha256|approval-reference-sha256|implementation-actor-reference|spec-reviewer-reference|quality-reviewer-reference|amendment|prelaunch-verifier-command-sha256|candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256|candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256|candidate-launch-identity-sha256|committed-root-receipt-file-sha256|committed-bundle-manifest-sha256|committed-launch-identity-sha256'
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_schema "$1" 32 \
+    "$task5_authority_receipt_keys" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256() {
+  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_sha_output="$({ set -o pipefail; \
+    shasum -a 256 "$1" | \
+    awk 'NF == 2 {print $1; rows++} END {if (rows != 1) exit 1}'; \
+  })" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_sha_output" || return 1
+  printf '%s\n' "$task5_prelaunch_sha_output" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_manifest_rows() {
+  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_manifest_file="$1"
+  task5_prelaunch_manifest_paths="$2"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_file" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_manifest_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_file")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_manifest_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_file")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_links" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_manifest_cr_count="$(awk \
+    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_file")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_manifest_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_file" | od -An -tu1 | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_manifest_state="$(awk \
+      -v expected="$task5_prelaunch_manifest_paths" '
+    BEGIN {path_count = split(expected, paths, "[|]")}
+    {
+      if (NR > path_count || length($0) != 66 + length(paths[NR]) ||
+          substr($0, 65, 2) != "  " ||
+          substr($0, 67) != paths[NR]) bad = 1
+      digest = substr($0, 1, 64)
+      if (length(digest) != 64 || digest ~ /[^0-9a-f]/) bad = 1
+    }
+    END {
+      if (NR != path_count) bad = 1
+      print bad ? "INVALID" : "VALID"
+    }
+  ' "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_file")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_manifest_state" = VALID || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_bundle_shape() {
+  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_bundle_mode="$1"
+  task5_prelaunch_bundle_root="$2"
+  task5_prelaunch_bundle_p5r1="$3"
+  test "${#task5_prelaunch_bundle_p5r1}" = 40 || return 1
+  case "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_p5r1" in
+    *[!0123456789abcdef]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root" 500 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/source" 500 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/reviews" 500 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_candidate_topology='.
+./bundle.manifest.sha256
+./prelaunch.receipt
+./reviews
+./reviews/protocol.assignment
+./reviews/protocol.response
+./reviews/protocol.response.identity
+./reviews/shell.assignment
+./reviews/shell.response
+./reviews/shell.response.identity
+./root.receipt.sha256
+./source
+./source.manifest.sha256
+./source/bootstrap.delta
+./source/bootstrap.sh
+./source/checker.delta
+./source/checker.sh
+./source/derivation.manifest
+./source/launcher.sh
+./source/plan.md
+./source/runtime.delta
+./source/runtime.sh
+./verifier.command'
+  task5_prelaunch_committed_topology='.
+./binding
+./binding/P5R1
+./binding/candidate-audit.identity
+./binding/candidate-bundle.manifest.sha256
+./binding/candidate-core.manifest
+./binding/candidate-launch.identity
+./binding/candidate-root.receipt.sha256
+./bundle.manifest.sha256
+./prelaunch.receipt
+./reviews
+./reviews/protocol.assignment
+./reviews/protocol.response
+./reviews/protocol.response.identity
+./reviews/shell.assignment
+./reviews/shell.response
+./reviews/shell.response.identity
+./root.receipt.sha256
+./source
+./source.manifest.sha256
+./source/bootstrap.delta
+./source/bootstrap.sh
+./source/checker.delta
+./source/checker.sh
+./source/derivation.manifest
+./source/launcher.sh
+./source/plan.md
+./source/runtime.delta
+./source/runtime.sh
+./verifier.command'
+  task5_prelaunch_source_manifest_paths='source/bootstrap.delta|source/bootstrap.sh|source/checker.delta|source/checker.sh|source/derivation.manifest|source/launcher.sh|source/plan.md|source/runtime.delta|source/runtime.sh'
+  task5_prelaunch_candidate_manifest_paths='prelaunch.receipt|reviews/protocol.assignment|reviews/protocol.response|reviews/protocol.response.identity|reviews/shell.assignment|reviews/shell.response|reviews/shell.response.identity|source.manifest.sha256|verifier.command'
+  task5_prelaunch_committed_manifest_paths='binding/P5R1|binding/candidate-audit.identity|binding/candidate-bundle.manifest.sha256|binding/candidate-core.manifest|binding/candidate-launch.identity|binding/candidate-root.receipt.sha256|prelaunch.receipt|reviews/protocol.assignment|reviews/protocol.response|reviews/protocol.response.identity|reviews/shell.assignment|reviews/shell.response|reviews/shell.response.identity|source.manifest.sha256|verifier.command'
+  task5_prelaunch_candidate_receipt_keys='format|mode|D5R1|P5R1|plan-path|source-manifest-sha256|plan-sha256|checker-sha256|bootstrap-sha256|runtime-sha256|launcher-sha256|checker-delta-sha256|bootstrap-delta-sha256|runtime-delta-sha256|derivation-manifest-sha256|verifier-command-sha256|protocol-reviewer-reference|protocol-assignment-sha256|protocol-response-sha256|protocol-response-identity-sha256|shell-reviewer-reference|shell-assignment-sha256|shell-response-sha256|shell-response-identity-sha256|decision'
+  task5_prelaunch_committed_receipt_keys='format|mode|D5R1|P5R1|P5R1-tree|P5R1-plan-blob|plan-path|source-manifest-sha256|plan-sha256|checker-sha256|bootstrap-sha256|runtime-sha256|launcher-sha256|checker-delta-sha256|bootstrap-delta-sha256|runtime-delta-sha256|derivation-manifest-sha256|verifier-command-sha256|protocol-reviewer-reference|protocol-assignment-sha256|protocol-response-sha256|protocol-response-identity-sha256|shell-reviewer-reference|shell-assignment-sha256|shell-response-sha256|shell-response-identity-sha256|candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256|candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256|candidate-launch-identity-sha256|candidate-audit-identity-sha256|candidate-core-manifest-sha256|source-bytes-vs-candidate|decision'
+  case "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_mode" in
+    candidate)
+      task5_prelaunch_expected_topology="$task5_prelaunch_candidate_topology"
+      task5_prelaunch_bundle_manifest_paths="$task5_prelaunch_candidate_manifest_paths"
+      task5_prelaunch_receipt_lines=25
+      task5_prelaunch_receipt_keys="$task5_prelaunch_candidate_receipt_keys"
+      ;;
+    committed)
+      task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+        "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/binding" 500 || return 1
+      task5_prelaunch_expected_topology="$task5_prelaunch_committed_topology"
+      task5_prelaunch_bundle_manifest_paths="$task5_prelaunch_committed_manifest_paths"
+      task5_prelaunch_receipt_lines=33
+      task5_prelaunch_receipt_keys="$task5_prelaunch_committed_receipt_keys"
+      ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_prelaunch_actual_topology="$({
+    set -o pipefail
+    cd "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root" && \
+      find . -print | LC_ALL=C sort
+  })" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_actual_topology" = \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_expected_topology" || return 1
+  while IFS= read -r task5_prelaunch_topology_path; do
+    case "$task5_prelaunch_topology_path" in
+      .|./source|./reviews|./binding) ;;
+      *)
+        task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular \
+          "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/${task5_prelaunch_topology_path#./}" || \
+          return 1
+        task5_prelaunch_file_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
+          "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/${task5_prelaunch_topology_path#./}")" || \
+          return 1
+        task5_prelaunch_file_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
+          "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/${task5_prelaunch_topology_path#./}")" || \
+          return 1
+        test "$task5_prelaunch_file_mode" = 400 || return 1
+        test "$task5_prelaunch_file_links" = 1 || return 1
+        ;;
+    esac
+  done <<TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_TOPOLOGY
+$task5_prelaunch_expected_topology
+TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_TOPOLOGY
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_manifest_rows \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/root.receipt.sha256" \
+    bundle.manifest.sha256 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_manifest_rows \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/bundle.manifest.sha256" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_manifest_paths" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_manifest_rows \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/source.manifest.sha256" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_source_manifest_paths" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_schema \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/prelaunch.receipt" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_receipt_lines" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_receipt_keys" || return 1
+  (
+    cd "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root" || exit 1
+    shasum -a 256 -c root.receipt.sha256 >/dev/null || exit 1
+    shasum -a 256 -c bundle.manifest.sha256 >/dev/null || exit 1
+    shasum -a 256 -c source.manifest.sha256 >/dev/null || exit 1
+  ) || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_receipt="$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/prelaunch.receipt"
+  task5_prelaunch_source_manifest_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/source.manifest.sha256")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_verifier_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/verifier.command")" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" D5R1 \
+    "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" plan-path \
+    "$TASK5_EXPECTED_PLAN_PATH" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" \
+    source-manifest-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_source_manifest_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" \
+    verifier-command-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_verifier_sha" || return 1
+  while IFS='|' read -r task5_prelaunch_source_key \
+      task5_prelaunch_source_relative; do
+    task5_prelaunch_source_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/source/$task5_prelaunch_source_relative")" || \
+      return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_source_key" "$task5_prelaunch_source_sha" || return 1
+  done <<'TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE_ROWS'
+plan-sha256|plan.md
+checker-sha256|checker.sh
+bootstrap-sha256|bootstrap.sh
+runtime-sha256|runtime.sh
+launcher-sha256|launcher.sh
+checker-delta-sha256|checker.delta
+bootstrap-delta-sha256|bootstrap.delta
+runtime-delta-sha256|runtime.delta
+derivation-manifest-sha256|derivation.manifest
+TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_SOURCE_ROWS
+  case "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_mode" in
+    candidate)
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" format \
+        task5r1-prelaunch-candidate-receipt-v1 || return 1
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" mode \
+        candidate || return 1
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" P5R1 \
+        UNRESOLVED || return 1
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" decision \
+        APPROVE-CANDIDATE-CHECKER-ONLY || return 1
+      ;;
+    committed)
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" format \
+        task5r1-prelaunch-committed-receipt-v1 || return 1
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" mode \
+        committed || return 1
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" P5R1 \
+        "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_p5r1" || return 1
+      for task5_prelaunch_oid_field in P5R1-tree P5R1-plan-blob; do
+        task5_prelaunch_oid_value="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+          "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" "$task5_prelaunch_oid_field")" || return 1
+        test "${#task5_prelaunch_oid_value}" = 40 || return 1
+        case "$task5_prelaunch_oid_value" in
+          *[!0123456789abcdef]*) return 1 ;;
+        esac
+      done
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" \
+        source-bytes-vs-candidate IDENTICAL || return 1
+      task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_receipt" decision \
+        APPROVE-COMMITTED-CHECKER-ONLY || return 1
+      task5_prelaunch_binding_p5r1="$(cat \
+        "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/P5R1")" || return 1
+      test "$task5_prelaunch_binding_p5r1" = \
+        "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_p5r1" || return 1
+      ;;
+  esac
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy() {
+  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$1" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$2" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_left_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$1")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_right_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$2")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_left_links="$(stat -f '%l' "$1")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_right_links="$(stat -f '%l' "$2")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_left_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_right_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_left_links" = 1 || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_right_links" = 1 || return 1
+  cmp -s "$1" "$2" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_left_identity="$(stat -f '%d:%i' "$1")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_right_identity="$(stat -f '%d:%i' "$2")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_left_identity" != \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_right_identity" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_tree_copy() {
+  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$1" 500 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$2" 500 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_tree_files="$({
+    set -o pipefail
+    cd "$1" && find . -type f -print | LC_ALL=C sort
+  })" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_tree_other_files="$({
+    set -o pipefail
+    cd "$2" && find . -type f -print | LC_ALL=C sort
+  })" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_tree_files" = \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_tree_other_files" || return 1
+  while IFS= read -r task5_prelaunch_tree_relative; do
+    test -n "$task5_prelaunch_tree_relative" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+      "$1/${task5_prelaunch_tree_relative#./}" \
+      "$2/${task5_prelaunch_tree_relative#./}" || return 1
+  done <<TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_TREE_FILES
+$task5_prelaunch_tree_files
+TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_TREE_FILES
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_launch_identity() {
+  test "$#" = 9 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_file="$1"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_mode="$2"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_root_sha="$3"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_bundle_sha="$4"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_source_sha="$5"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_verifier_sha="$6"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_checker_sha="$7"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_audit_sha="$8"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_expected_sha="$9"
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_keys='format|mode|root-receipt-file-sha256|bundle-manifest-sha256|source-manifest-sha256|verifier-command-sha256|checker-sha256|checker-audit-identity-sha256|checker-output-sha256|checker-output-bytes|exit-status'
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_schema "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" 11 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_launch_keys" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_actual_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_launch_actual_sha" = \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_launch_expected_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" format \
+    task5r1-prelaunch-checker-launch-v1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" mode \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_launch_mode" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" \
+    root-receipt-file-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_launch_root_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" \
+    bundle-manifest-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_launch_bundle_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" \
+    source-manifest-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_launch_source_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" \
+    verifier-command-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_launch_verifier_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" \
+    checker-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_launch_checker_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" \
+    checker-audit-identity-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_launch_audit_sha" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_output_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" checker-output-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_launch_output_sha" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_launch_output_bytes="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" checker-output-bytes)" || return 1
+  case "$task5_prelaunch_launch_output_bytes" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_launch_file" \
+    exit-status 0 || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_authority_bridge() {
+  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_authority_root="$1"
+  task5_prelaunch_authority_receipt="$2"
+  task5_prelaunch_formal_package="$3"
+  task5_prelaunch_authority_p5r1="$4"
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_authority_receipt" = \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_authority_root/authority.receipt" || return 1
+  test "$task5_prelaunch_formal_package" = \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_authority_root/P5R1-review-package" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_recovery_authority_receipt_schema \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_authority_receipt" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_top_candidate="$task5_prelaunch_authority_root/prelaunch-candidate"
+  task5_prelaunch_top_committed="$task5_prelaunch_authority_root/prelaunch-committed"
+  task5_prelaunch_nested_candidate="$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/prelaunch-candidate"
+  task5_prelaunch_nested_committed="$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/prelaunch-committed"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_bundle_shape candidate \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate" "$task5_prelaunch_authority_p5r1" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_bundle_shape committed \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed" "$task5_prelaunch_authority_p5r1" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_bundle_shape candidate \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_nested_candidate" "$task5_prelaunch_authority_p5r1" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_bundle_shape committed \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_nested_committed" "$task5_prelaunch_authority_p5r1" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_tree_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_nested_candidate" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_tree_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_nested_committed" || return 1
+  for task5_prelaunch_common_relative in source/bootstrap.delta \
+      source/bootstrap.sh source/checker.delta source/checker.sh \
+      source/derivation.manifest source/launcher.sh source/plan.md \
+      source/runtime.delta source/runtime.sh source.manifest.sha256 \
+      verifier.command reviews/protocol.assignment reviews/protocol.response \
+      reviews/protocol.response.identity reviews/shell.assignment \
+      reviews/shell.response reviews/shell.response.identity; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/$task5_prelaunch_common_relative" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/$task5_prelaunch_common_relative" || \
+      return 1
+  done
+  while IFS='|' read -r task5_prelaunch_reviewed_source \
+      task5_prelaunch_reviewed_package; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/source/$task5_prelaunch_reviewed_source" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/$task5_prelaunch_reviewed_package" || \
+      return 1
+  done <<'TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_FORMAL_SOURCE_ROWS'
+plan.md|plan.md
+checker.sh|checker.sh
+bootstrap.sh|bootstrap.sh
+runtime.sh|runtime.sh
+launcher.sh|launcher.sh
+checker.delta|checker.delta
+bootstrap.delta|bootstrap.delta
+runtime.delta|runtime.delta
+derivation.manifest|derivation.manifest
+TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_FORMAL_SOURCE_ROWS
+  task5_prelaunch_top_verifier="$task5_prelaunch_authority_root/prelaunch-verifier.command"
+  task5_prelaunch_nested_verifier="$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/prelaunch-verifier.command"
+  task5_prelaunch_top_candidate_launch="$task5_prelaunch_authority_root/prelaunch-candidate-launch.identity"
+  task5_prelaunch_nested_candidate_launch="$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/prelaunch-candidate-launch.identity"
+  task5_prelaunch_top_committed_launch="$task5_prelaunch_authority_root/prelaunch-committed-launch.identity"
+  task5_prelaunch_nested_committed_launch="$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/prelaunch-committed-launch.identity"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy "$task5_prelaunch_top_verifier" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_nested_verifier" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate_launch" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_nested_candidate_launch" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed_launch" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_nested_committed_launch" || return 1
+  for task5_prelaunch_bundle_verifier in \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/verifier.command" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/verifier.command" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_nested_candidate/verifier.command" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_nested_committed/verifier.command"; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy "$task5_prelaunch_top_verifier" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_bundle_verifier" || return 1
+  done
+  task5_prelaunch_candidate_root_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/root.receipt.sha256")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_candidate_bundle_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/bundle.manifest.sha256")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_candidate_launch_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate_launch")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_committed_root_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/root.receipt.sha256")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_committed_bundle_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/bundle.manifest.sha256")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_committed_launch_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed_launch")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_verifier_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_verifier")" || return 1
+  while IFS='|' read -r task5_prelaunch_authority_key \
+      task5_prelaunch_authority_value; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_authority_receipt" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_authority_key" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_authority_value" || return 1
+  done <<TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_AUTHORITY_VALUES
+prelaunch-verifier-command-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_verifier_sha
+candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_candidate_root_sha
+candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_candidate_bundle_sha
+candidate-launch-identity-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_candidate_launch_sha
+committed-root-receipt-file-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_committed_root_sha
+committed-bundle-manifest-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_committed_bundle_sha
+committed-launch-identity-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_committed_launch_sha
+TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_AUTHORITY_VALUES
+  task5_prelaunch_formal_core="$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/core.manifest"
+  task5_prelaunch_formal_candidate_audit="$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/candidate-audit.identity"
+  task5_prelaunch_formal_committed_audit="$task5_prelaunch_formal_package/committed-audit.identity"
+  task5_prelaunch_formal_core_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_formal_core")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_formal_candidate_audit_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_formal_candidate_audit")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_formal_committed_audit_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_formal_committed_audit")" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_authority_receipt" \
+    core-manifest-sha256 "$task5_prelaunch_formal_core_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/binding/candidate-core.manifest" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_formal_core" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/binding/candidate-audit.identity" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_formal_candidate_audit" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/binding/candidate-launch.identity" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate_launch" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/binding/candidate-root.receipt.sha256" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/root.receipt.sha256" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_distinct_file_copy \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/binding/candidate-bundle.manifest.sha256" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/bundle.manifest.sha256" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_committed_receipt="$task5_prelaunch_top_committed/prelaunch.receipt"
+  while IFS='|' read -r task5_prelaunch_binding_key \
+      task5_prelaunch_binding_value; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_prelaunch_committed_receipt" \
+      "$task5_prelaunch_binding_key" "$task5_prelaunch_binding_value" || \
+      return 1
+  done <<TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_BINDING_VALUES
+candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_candidate_root_sha
+candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_candidate_bundle_sha
+candidate-launch-identity-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_candidate_launch_sha
+candidate-audit-identity-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_formal_candidate_audit_sha
+candidate-core-manifest-sha256|$task5_prelaunch_formal_core_sha
+TASK5_PRELAUNCH_BOOTSTRAP_BINDING_VALUES
+  task5_prelaunch_source_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/source.manifest.sha256")" || return 1
+  task5_prelaunch_checker_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_prelaunch_sha256 \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate/source/checker.sh")" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_launch_identity \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_candidate_launch" candidate \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_candidate_root_sha" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_candidate_bundle_sha" "$task5_prelaunch_source_sha" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_verifier_sha" "$task5_prelaunch_checker_sha" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_formal_candidate_audit_sha" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_candidate_launch_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_launch_identity \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_top_committed_launch" committed \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_committed_root_sha" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_committed_bundle_sha" "$task5_prelaunch_source_sha" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_verifier_sha" "$task5_prelaunch_checker_sha" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_formal_committed_audit_sha" \
+    "$task5_prelaunch_committed_launch_sha" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line() {
+  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_exact_line_value="$(sed -n "$2"p "$1")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_exact_line_value" = "$3" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value() {
+  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_exact_receipt_value="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$1" "$2")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_exact_receipt_value" = "$3" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_matching_receipt_value() {
+  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_matching_left="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$1" "$3")" || return 1
+  task5_matching_right="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$2" "$3")" || return 1
+  test -n "$task5_matching_left" || return 1
+  test -n "$task5_matching_right" || return 1
+  test "$task5_matching_left" = "$task5_matching_right" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt() {
+  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_file_receipt_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$1" | \
+    awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_expected_receipt_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$2" "$3")" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_file_receipt_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_expected_receipt_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_file_receipt_sha" = \
+    "$task5_expected_receipt_sha" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_extract_fence() {
+  test "$#" = 6 || return 1
+  task5_extract_source="$1"
+  task5_extract_begin="$2"
+  task5_extract_end="$3"
+  task5_extract_open="$4"
+  task5_extract_close="$5"
+  task5_extract_output="$6"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_extract_output" || return 1
+  task5_extract_begin_count="$(awk -v wanted="$task5_extract_begin" \
+    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_extract_source")" || return 1
+  task5_extract_end_count="$(awk -v wanted="$task5_extract_end" \
+    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_extract_source")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_extract_begin_count" = 1 || return 1
+  test "$task5_extract_end_count" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_extract_first="$(awk -v wanted="$task5_extract_begin" \
+    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$task5_extract_source")" || return 1
+  task5_extract_last="$(awk -v wanted="$task5_extract_end" \
+    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$task5_extract_source")" || return 1
+  case "$task5_extract_first:$task5_extract_last" in
+    *[!0123456789:]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_extract_first" -lt "$task5_extract_last" || return 1
+  task5_extract_actual_open="$(sed -n \
+    "$((task5_extract_first + 1))p" \
+    "$task5_extract_source")" || return 1
+  task5_extract_actual_close="$(sed -n \
+    "$((task5_extract_last - 1))p" \
+    "$task5_extract_source")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_extract_actual_open" = "$task5_extract_open" || return 1
+  test "$task5_extract_actual_close" = "$task5_extract_close" || return 1
+  awk -v first="$((task5_extract_first + 1))" \
+    -v last="$((task5_extract_last - 1))" \
+    'NR > first && NR < last {print}' "$task5_extract_source" \
+    > "$task5_extract_output" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_extract_output" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_derivation_row() {
+  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
+  awk -F '|' -v wanted="$1" \
+    '$1 == wanted {n++; row=$0} END {if (n != 1) exit 1; print row}' \
+    "$derivation_manifest"
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_validate_delta() {
+  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
+  task5_delta_path="$1"
+  task5_delta_name="$2"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_delta_path" || return 1
+  task5_delta_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_delta_path" | \
+    od -An -tu1 | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_delta_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_delta_diff_header_count="$(grep -Fxc \
+    "diff --git a/$task5_delta_name b/$task5_delta_name" \
+    "$task5_delta_path")" || return 1
+  task5_delta_old_header_count="$(grep -Fxc -- \
+    "--- a/$task5_delta_name" "$task5_delta_path")" || return 1
+  task5_delta_new_header_count="$(grep -Fxc \
+    "+++ b/$task5_delta_name" "$task5_delta_path")" || return 1
+  task5_delta_total_header_count="$(grep -Ec \
+    '^diff --git |^--- |^\+\+\+ ' "$task5_delta_path")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_delta_diff_header_count" = 1 || return 1
+  test "$task5_delta_old_header_count" = 1 || return 1
+  test "$task5_delta_new_header_count" = 1 || return 1
+  test "$task5_delta_total_header_count" = 3 || return 1
+  if grep -E '^(new file mode|deleted file mode|old mode|new mode|rename from|rename to|copy from|copy to|GIT binary patch|Binary files )' \
+      "$task5_delta_path" >/dev/null; then
     return 1
-  awk -F= -v key="$2" '$1 == key {sub(/^[^=]*=/, ""); print}' "$1"
+  else
+    task5_delta_grep_status=$?
+  fi
+  test "$task5_delta_grep_status" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_delta_numstat_name="$(git apply --numstat \
+    "$task5_delta_path" | awk '{print $3}')" || return 1
+  task5_delta_numstat_lines="$(git apply --numstat \
+    "$task5_delta_path" | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_delta_numstat_name" = "$task5_delta_name" || return 1
+  test "$task5_delta_numstat_lines" = 1 || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_apply_derivation() {
+  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
+  task5_derive_kind="$1"
+  task5_derive_source="$2"
+  task5_derive_delta="$3"
+  task5_derive_result="$4"
+  task5_derive_row="$(task5_bootstrap_derivation_row \
+    "$task5_derive_kind")" || return 1
+  task5_derive_row_fields="$(printf '%s\n' "$task5_derive_row" | \
+    awk -F '|' '{print NF}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_row_fields" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_derive_saved_ifs=$IFS
+  IFS='|' read -r task5_derive_row_kind task5_derive_source_sha \
+    task5_derive_source_lines task5_derive_source_bytes \
+    task5_derive_delta_sha task5_derive_delta_lines \
+    task5_derive_delta_bytes task5_derive_result_sha \
+    task5_derive_result_lines task5_derive_result_bytes <<TASK5_DERIVATION_ROW
+$task5_derive_row
+TASK5_DERIVATION_ROW
+  task5_derive_read_status=$?
+  IFS=$task5_derive_saved_ifs
+  test "$task5_derive_read_status" = 0 || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_row_kind" = "$task5_derive_kind" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_derive_source_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_derive_delta_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_derive_result_sha" || return 1
+  for task5_derive_count in "$task5_derive_source_lines" \
+      "$task5_derive_source_bytes" "$task5_derive_delta_lines" \
+      "$task5_derive_delta_bytes" "$task5_derive_result_lines" \
+      "$task5_derive_result_bytes"; do
+    case "$task5_derive_count" in
+      ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+  done
+  task5_derive_actual_source_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_derive_source" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_derive_actual_source_lines="$(wc -l < \
+    "$task5_derive_source" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_derive_actual_source_bytes="$(wc -c < \
+    "$task5_derive_source" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_derive_actual_delta_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_derive_delta" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_derive_actual_delta_lines="$(wc -l < \
+    "$task5_derive_delta" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_derive_actual_delta_bytes="$(wc -c < \
+    "$task5_derive_delta" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_source_sha" = \
+    "$task5_derive_source_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_source_lines" = \
+    "$task5_derive_source_lines" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_source_bytes" = \
+    "$task5_derive_source_bytes" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_delta_sha" = \
+    "$task5_derive_delta_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_delta_lines" = \
+    "$task5_derive_delta_lines" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_delta_bytes" = \
+    "$task5_derive_delta_bytes" || return 1
+  task5_derive_name="$task5_derive_kind.sh"
+  task5_bootstrap_validate_delta \
+    "$task5_derive_delta" "$task5_derive_name" || return 1
+  task5_derive_root="$task5_evidence_root/derive-$task5_derive_kind"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_derive_root" || return 1
+  mkdir -m 700 "$task5_derive_root" || return 1
+  cp "$task5_derive_source" \
+    "$task5_derive_root/$task5_derive_name" || return 1
+  chmod 600 "$task5_derive_root/$task5_derive_name" || return 1
+  (
+    cd "$task5_derive_root" || exit 1
+    git apply --no-index --check --whitespace=error-all \
+      "$task5_derive_delta" || exit 1
+    git apply --no-index --whitespace=error-all \
+      "$task5_derive_delta" || exit 1
+  ) || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_derive_result" || return 1
+  cp "$task5_derive_root/$task5_derive_name" \
+    "$task5_derive_result" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_derive_result" || return 1
+  task5_derive_result_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 \
+    "$task5_derive_result" | od -An -tu1 | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_derive_actual_result_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_derive_result" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_derive_actual_result_lines="$(wc -l < \
+    "$task5_derive_result" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_derive_actual_result_bytes="$(wc -c < \
+    "$task5_derive_result" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_result_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_result_sha" = \
+    "$task5_derive_result_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_result_lines" = \
+    "$task5_derive_result_lines" || return 1
+  test "$task5_derive_actual_result_bytes" = \
+    "$task5_derive_result_bytes" || return 1
+  (
+    cd "$task5_derive_root" || exit 1
+    git apply --no-index --reverse --check --whitespace=error-all \
+      "$task5_derive_delta" || exit 1
+    git apply --no-index --reverse --whitespace=error-all \
+      "$task5_derive_delta" || exit 1
+  ) || return 1
+  cmp -s "$task5_derive_source" \
+    "$task5_derive_root/$task5_derive_name" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_fence_sha256() {
+  test "$#" = 5 || return 1
+  task5_fence_source="$1"
+  task5_fence_begin="$2"
+  task5_fence_end="$3"
+  task5_fence_open="$4"
+  task5_fence_close="$5"
+  task5_fence_begin_count="$(awk -v wanted="$task5_fence_begin" \
+    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_fence_source")" || return 1
+  task5_fence_end_count="$(awk -v wanted="$task5_fence_end" \
+    '$0 == wanted {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_fence_source")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_fence_begin_count" = 1 || return 1
+  test "$task5_fence_end_count" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_fence_first="$(awk -v wanted="$task5_fence_begin" \
+    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$task5_fence_source")" || return 1
+  task5_fence_last="$(awk -v wanted="$task5_fence_end" \
+    '$0 == wanted {print NR}' "$task5_fence_source")" || return 1
+  case "$task5_fence_first:$task5_fence_last" in
+    *[!0123456789:]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_fence_first" -lt "$task5_fence_last" || return 1
+  task5_fence_actual_open="$(sed -n \
+    "$((task5_fence_first + 1))p" \
+    "$task5_fence_source")" || return 1
+  task5_fence_actual_close="$(sed -n \
+    "$((task5_fence_last - 1))p" \
+    "$task5_fence_source")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_fence_actual_open" = "$task5_fence_open" || return 1
+  test "$task5_fence_actual_close" = "$task5_fence_close" || return 1
+  task5_fence_hash="$({ set -o pipefail; \
+    awk -v first="$((task5_fence_first + 1))" \
+      -v last="$((task5_fence_last - 1))" \
+      'NR > first && NR < last {print}' "$task5_fence_source" | \
+      shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'; })" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_fence_hash" || return 1
+  printf '%s\n' "$task5_fence_hash" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_validate_recovery_authority() {
+  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_validate_authority_root="$1"
+  task5_validate_authority_sha="$2"
+  task5_validate_p5r1="$3"
+  task5_validate_receipt="$task5_validate_authority_root/authority.receipt"
+  task5_validate_approval="$task5_validate_authority_root/implementation-approval.txt"
+  task5_validate_approval_reference="$task5_validate_authority_root/implementation-approval.reference"
+  task5_validate_package="$task5_validate_authority_root/P5R1-review-package"
+  task5_validate_package_manifest="$task5_validate_package/manifest.sha256"
+  task5_validate_package_identity="$task5_validate_package/package.identity"
+  task5_validate_plan="$task5_validate_package/plan.md"
+  task5_validate_checker="$task5_validate_package/checker.sh"
+  task5_validate_bootstrap="$task5_validate_package/bootstrap.sh"
+  task5_validate_runtime="$task5_validate_package/runtime.sh"
+  task5_validate_launcher="$task5_validate_package/launcher.sh"

+  task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$task5_validate_authority_root" \
+    "$task5_validate_authority_root/manifest.sha256" \
+    "$task5_validate_authority_sha" || return 1
+  for task5_validate_file in "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+      "$task5_validate_approval" "$task5_validate_approval_reference" \
+      "$task5_validate_package_manifest" "$task5_validate_package_identity" \
+      "$task5_validate_package/design.md" "$task5_validate_plan" \
+      "$task5_validate_checker" "$task5_validate_bootstrap" \
+      "$task5_validate_runtime" "$task5_validate_launcher" \
+      "$task5_validate_package/checker.delta" \
+      "$task5_validate_package/bootstrap.delta" \
+      "$task5_validate_package/runtime.delta" "$task5_validate_derivation" \
+      "$task5_validate_core" "$task5_validate_package/candidate-audit.identity" \
+      "$task5_validate_package/committed-audit.identity" \
+      "$task5_validate_package/P0-provenance.identity" \
+      "$task5_validate_authority_root/P5R1.spec.response.md" \
+      "$task5_validate_authority_root/P5R1.spec.identity" \
+      "$task5_validate_authority_root/P5R1.quality.response.md" \
+      "$task5_validate_authority_root/P5R1.quality.identity"; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_validate_file" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_validate_file")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 400 || return 1
+  done
+  task5_bootstrap_require_recovery_authority_receipt_schema \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    version)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = task5-recovery-authority-v1 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" P0)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_COMMIT" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" D5R1)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" P5R1)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$task5_validate_p5r1" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    source-plan-path)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_PATH" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    plan-path)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_EXPECTED_PLAN_PATH" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    amendment)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || return 1
+  for task5_validate_sha_field in source-plan-sha256 plan-sha256 \
+      checker-sha256 bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 \
+      derivation-manifest-sha256 core-manifest-sha256 \
+      canonical-mutation-manifest-sha256 failure-package-manifest-sha256 \
+      original-authority-manifest-sha256 review-package-sha256 \
+      spec-response-sha256 quality-response-sha256 approval-text-sha256 \
+      approval-reference-sha256 prelaunch-verifier-command-sha256 \
+      candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256 \
+      candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256 candidate-launch-identity-sha256 \
+      committed-root-receipt-file-sha256 \
+      committed-bundle-manifest-sha256 \
+      committed-launch-identity-sha256; do
+    task5_validate_sha_value="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+      "$task5_validate_receipt" "$task5_validate_sha_field")" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_sha_value" || return 1
+  done
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    source-plan-sha256)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    af1b536f268f11bfe9abaf2a30fe49fcfe06bbc225df774c49a6b443515650a3 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    canonical-mutation-manifest-sha256)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    b9c740421824b9cdd0e482ee63ad2baf1da9f83d8c43e89dbb37094699342b92 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    original-authority-manifest-sha256)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    failure-package-manifest-sha256)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_FAILURE_PACKAGE_SHA256" || return 1
+  task5_validate_package_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" review-package-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_package_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$task5_validate_package" \
+    "$task5_validate_package_manifest" "$task5_validate_package_sha" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_prelaunch_authority_bridge \
+    "$task5_validate_authority_root" "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    "$task5_validate_package" "$task5_validate_p5r1" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$task5_validate_p0_authority" \
+    "$task5_validate_p0_authority/manifest.sha256" \
+    "$TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$task5_validate_failure" \
+    "$task5_validate_failure/manifest.sha256" \
+    "$TASK5_FAILURE_PACKAGE_SHA256" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(find "$task5_validate_failure" -type d | wc -l | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(find "$task5_validate_failure" -type f | wc -l | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 5 || return 1
+  for task5_validate_failure_file in environment-order-proof.txt \
+      failure.identity launch.txt manifest.sha256 unified-output.bin; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular \
+      "$task5_validate_failure/$task5_validate_failure_file" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(stat -f '%l' \
+      "$task5_validate_failure/$task5_validate_failure_file")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+  done
+  task5_command_output="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_validate_failure/failure.identity" | \
+    awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    c1e639f0ba66c3e21dfaed5febc2bb206eee47356f1cbdfc75663255b0566335 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_validate_failure/failure.identity" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 32 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(wc -c < "$task5_validate_failure/failure.identity" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 1671 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_validate_failure/launch.txt" | \
+    awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    f3c73c0ac7d992c01faf4291f2498b671443e8d3810d8fbc64661f4544a1e9fa || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_validate_failure/launch.txt" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 35 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(wc -c < "$task5_validate_failure/launch.txt" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 2126 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_validate_failure/launch.txt" | od -An -tu1 | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 39 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_validate_failure/environment-order-proof.txt" | \
+    awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    3965c0e2dc311c4c9b0b13b588fb9297bb06b1bc6a01aff07389fcf660e4d2be || return 1
+  task5_validate_unified_output_bytes="$(wc -c < \
+    "$task5_validate_failure/unified-output.bin" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  case "$task5_validate_unified_output_bytes" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_validate_unified_output_bytes" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_validate_package_identity" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 20 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_package_identity" \
+    format)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = task5-recovery-plan-review-v1 || return 1
+  for task5_validate_identity_field in P0 D5R1 P5R1 source-plan-path \
+      plan-path source-plan-sha256 plan-sha256 checker-sha256 \
+      bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 derivation-manifest-sha256 \
+      core-manifest-sha256 canonical-mutation-manifest-sha256 \
+      failure-package-manifest-sha256 original-authority-manifest-sha256 \
+      amendment implementation-actor-reference spec-reviewer-reference \
+      quality-reviewer-reference; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_matching_receipt_value \
+      "$task5_validate_package_identity" "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+      "$task5_validate_identity_field" || return 1
+  done
+  task5_validate_committed_design_sha="$({ set -o pipefail; \
+    git -C "$TASK5_EXPECTED_EXECUTION_ROOT" show \
+      "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT:docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-10-task-5-bootstrap-recovery-design.md" | \
+      shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'; })" || return 1
+  task5_validate_packaged_design_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_validate_package/design.md" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_committed_design_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_packaged_design_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_validate_committed_design_sha" = \
+    "$task5_validate_packaged_design_sha" || return 1
+  task5_validate_committed_plan_sha="$({ set -o pipefail; \
+    git -C "$TASK5_EXPECTED_EXECUTION_ROOT" show \
+      "$task5_validate_p5r1:$TASK5_EXPECTED_PLAN_PATH" | \
+      shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}'; })" || return 1
+  task5_validate_receipt_plan_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" plan-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_committed_plan_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt_plan_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_validate_committed_plan_sha" = \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt_plan_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$task5_validate_plan" \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" plan-sha256 || return 1
+  for task5_validate_artifact in checker bootstrap runtime; do
+    case "$task5_validate_artifact" in
+      checker) task5_validate_artifact_path="$task5_validate_checker" ;;
+      bootstrap) task5_validate_artifact_path="$task5_validate_bootstrap" ;;
+      runtime) task5_validate_artifact_path="$task5_validate_runtime" ;;
+      *) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt \
+      "$task5_validate_artifact_path" "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+      "$task5_validate_artifact-sha256" || return 1
+  done
+  task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$task5_validate_derivation" \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" derivation-manifest-sha256 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$task5_validate_core" \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" core-manifest-sha256 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_derivation" \
+    format)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = task5-recovery-derivation-v1 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_derivation" P0)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_COMMIT" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_derivation" D5R1)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_validate_derivation" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 9 || return 1
+  for task5_validate_kind in checker bootstrap runtime; do
+    task5_validate_row="$(awk -F '|' -v wanted="$task5_validate_kind" \
+      '$1 == wanted {n++; row=$0} END {if (n != 1) exit 1; print row}' \
+      "$task5_validate_derivation")" || return 1
+    task5_validate_row_fields="$(printf '%s\n' \
+      "$task5_validate_row" | awk -F '|' '{print NF}')" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_row_fields" = 10 || return 1
+    task5_validate_saved_ifs=$IFS
+    IFS='|' read -r task5_validate_row_kind task5_validate_source_sha \
+      task5_validate_source_lines task5_validate_source_bytes \
+      task5_validate_delta_sha task5_validate_delta_lines \
+      task5_validate_delta_bytes task5_validate_result_sha \
+      task5_validate_result_lines task5_validate_result_bytes <<TASK5_VALIDATE_ROW
+$task5_validate_row
+TASK5_VALIDATE_ROW
+    task5_validate_read_status=$?
+    IFS=$task5_validate_saved_ifs
+    test "$task5_validate_read_status" = 0 || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_row_kind" = "$task5_validate_kind" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_source_sha" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_delta_sha" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_result_sha" || return 1
+    for task5_validate_count in "$task5_validate_source_lines" \
+        "$task5_validate_source_bytes" "$task5_validate_delta_lines" \
+        "$task5_validate_delta_bytes" "$task5_validate_result_lines" \
+        "$task5_validate_result_bytes"; do
+      case "$task5_validate_count" in
+        ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+      esac
+    done
+    case "$task5_validate_kind" in
+      checker)
+        task5_validate_source_artifact="$task5_validate_p0_authority/P-review-package/checker.sh"
+        task5_validate_result_artifact="$task5_validate_checker" ;;
+      bootstrap)
+        task5_validate_source_artifact="$task5_validate_p0_authority/P-review-package/bootstrap.sh"
+        task5_validate_result_artifact="$task5_validate_bootstrap" ;;
+      runtime)
+        task5_validate_source_artifact="$task5_validate_p0_authority/P-review-package/runtime.sh"
+        task5_validate_result_artifact="$task5_validate_runtime" ;;
+      *) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    task5_validate_delta_artifact="$task5_validate_package/$task5_validate_kind.delta"
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular \
+      "$task5_validate_source_artifact" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_source_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+      "$task5_validate_source_artifact" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_source_lines="$(wc -l < \
+      "$task5_validate_source_artifact" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_source_bytes="$(wc -c < \
+      "$task5_validate_source_artifact" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_delta_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+      "$task5_validate_delta_artifact" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_delta_lines="$(wc -l < \
+      "$task5_validate_delta_artifact" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_delta_bytes="$(wc -c < \
+      "$task5_validate_delta_artifact" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_receipt_result_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+      "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+      "$task5_validate_kind-sha256")" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_result_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+      "$task5_validate_result_artifact" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_result_lines="$(wc -l < \
+      "$task5_validate_result_artifact" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_actual_result_bytes="$(wc -c < \
+      "$task5_validate_result_artifact" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_source_sha" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_delta_sha" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+      "$task5_validate_receipt_result_sha" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_result_sha" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_source_sha" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_source_sha" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_source_lines" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_source_lines" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_source_bytes" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_source_bytes" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_delta_sha" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_delta_sha" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_delta_lines" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_delta_lines" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_delta_bytes" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_delta_bytes" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_result_sha" = \
+      "$task5_validate_receipt_result_sha" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_result_sha" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_result_sha" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_result_lines" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_result_lines" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_result_bytes" = \
+      "$task5_validate_actual_result_bytes" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_validate_delta "$task5_validate_delta_artifact" \
+      "$task5_validate_kind.sh" || return 1
+    /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -n \
+      "$task5_validate_result_artifact" || return 1
+  done
+  task5_validate_checker_fence_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_fence_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_plan" \
+    '<!-- TASK5R1-PLAN-AUDIT-BEGIN -->' \
+    '<!-- TASK5R1-PLAN-AUDIT-END -->' '```bash' '```')" || return 1
+  task5_validate_checker_receipt_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" checker-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_checker_fence_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_checker_receipt_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_validate_checker_fence_sha" = \
+    "$task5_validate_checker_receipt_sha" || return 1
+  task5_validate_bootstrap_fence_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_fence_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_plan" \
+    '<!-- TASK5R1-BOOTSTRAP-BEGIN -->' '<!-- TASK5R1-BOOTSTRAP-END -->' \
+    '```bash' '```')" || return 1
+  task5_validate_bootstrap_receipt_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" bootstrap-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_bootstrap_fence_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_validate_bootstrap_receipt_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_validate_bootstrap_fence_sha" = \
+    "$task5_validate_bootstrap_receipt_sha" || return 1
+  for task5_validate_mode in candidate committed; do
+    task5_validate_audit="$task5_validate_package/$task5_validate_mode-audit.identity"
+    task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_validate_audit" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 19 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" \
+      format)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = task5-recovery-plan-audit-v1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" mode)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "$task5_validate_mode" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" P0)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "$TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_COMMIT" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" D5R1)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || return 1
+    if test "$task5_validate_mode" = candidate; then
+      task5_validate_audit_p5r1=UNRESOLVED
+    else
+      task5_validate_audit_p5r1="$task5_validate_p5r1"
+    fi
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" P5R1)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "$task5_validate_audit_p5r1" || return 1
+    for task5_validate_audit_sha in plan-sha256 checker-sha256 \
+        bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 derivation-manifest-sha256 \
+        core-manifest-sha256 original-authority-manifest-sha256 \
+        failure-package-manifest-sha256; do
+      task5_bootstrap_require_matching_receipt_value \
+        "$task5_validate_audit" "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+        "$task5_validate_audit_sha" || return 1
+    done
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" \
+      amendment)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" launch)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "$TASK5_RECOVERY_LAUNCH_IDENTITY" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" \
+      controller-invocations)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_INVOCATIONS_IDENTITY" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" \
+      sequence-pre-final)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_PRE_FINAL_IDENTITY" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" \
+      sequence-pre-report)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_PRE_REPORT_IDENTITY" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_audit" \
+      sequence-post-report)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$TASK5_RECOVERY_POST_REPORT_IDENTITY" || return 1
+  done
+  task5_command_output="$(wc -l < \
+    "$task5_validate_package/P0-provenance.identity" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_package/P0-provenance.identity" format)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    task5-recovery-P0-provenance-v1 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_package/P0-provenance.identity" P0)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_COMMIT" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_package/P0-provenance.identity" \
+    original-authority-manifest-sha256)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_p0_authority/authority.receipt" P)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$TASK5_SOURCE_PLAN_COMMIT" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_failure/failure.identity" namespace)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = UNALLOCATED || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_failure/failure.identity" retired-manifest)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = ABSENT || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_failure/failure.identity" prelaunch-inventory)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    UNAVAILABLE || return 1
+  task5_validate_actor="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" implementation-actor-reference)" || return 1
+  task5_validate_spec="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" spec-reviewer-reference)" || return 1
+  task5_validate_quality="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" quality-reviewer-reference)" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_independent_reviewer_references \
+    "$task5_validate_actor" "$task5_validate_spec" \
+    "$task5_validate_quality" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_validate_approval" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_validate_approval" || return 1
+  task5_validate_approval_cr_count="$(awk \
+    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  case "$task5_validate_approval_cr_count" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_validate_approval_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_validate_approval" | od -An -tu1 | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || return 1
+  task5_validate_plan_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" plan-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_validate_spec_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" spec-response-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_validate_quality_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" quality-response-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_plan_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_spec_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_quality_sha" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '1p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    format=task5r1-implementation-approval-v1 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '2p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "P5R1=$task5_validate_p5r1" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '3p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "P5R1-PLAN-SHA256=$task5_validate_plan_sha" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '4p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "P5R1-REVIEW-PACKAGE-SHA256=$task5_validate_package_sha" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '5p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "P5R1-SPEC-RESPONSE-SHA256=$task5_validate_spec_sha" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '6p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "P5R1-QUALITY-RESPONSE-SHA256=$task5_validate_quality_sha" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '7p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "IMPLEMENTATION-ACTOR-REFERENCE=$task5_validate_actor" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '8p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "USER-APPROVAL-VERBATIM=APPROVE P5R1 $task5_validate_p5r1 PLAN $task5_validate_plan_sha PACKAGE $task5_validate_package_sha SPEC $task5_validate_spec_sha QUALITY $task5_validate_quality_sha AMENDMENT $TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '9p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "AMENDMENT=$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(sed -n '10p' "$task5_validate_approval")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = DECISION=APPROVE || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt "$task5_validate_approval" \
+    "$task5_validate_receipt" approval-text-sha256 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_file_sha_receipt \
+    "$task5_validate_approval_reference" "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+    approval-reference-sha256 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_read_coordination_reference_file \
+    "$task5_validate_approval_reference" >/dev/null || return 1
+  for task5_validate_lane in spec quality; do
+    task5_validate_response="$task5_validate_authority_root/P5R1.$task5_validate_lane.response.md"
+    task5_validate_identity="$task5_validate_authority_root/P5R1.$task5_validate_lane.identity"
+    task5_validate_response_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_validate_response" | \
+      awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+    task5_validate_expected_response_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+      "$task5_validate_receipt" \
+      "$task5_validate_lane-response-sha256")" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_validate_response_sha" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+      "$task5_validate_expected_response_sha" || return 1
+    test "$task5_validate_response_sha" = \
+      "$task5_validate_expected_response_sha" || return 1
+    if test "$task5_validate_lane" = spec; then
+      task5_validate_reviewer="$task5_validate_spec"
+    else
+      task5_validate_reviewer="$task5_validate_quality"
+    fi
+    task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_validate_response" || return 1
+    task5_validate_response_cr_count="$(awk \
+      'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+      "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    case "$task5_validate_response_cr_count" in
+      ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    test "$task5_validate_response_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_validate_response" | od -An -tu1 | \
+      tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec '^PACKAGE-SHA256:' \
+      "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec '^REVIEWER-REFERENCE:' \
+      "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec '^IMPLEMENTATION-ACTOR-REFERENCE:' \
+      "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec '^VERDICT:' "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(grep -Fxc "PACKAGE-SHA256: $task5_validate_package_sha" \
+      "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(grep -Fxc "REVIEWER-REFERENCE: $task5_validate_reviewer" \
+      "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(grep -Fxc "IMPLEMENTATION-ACTOR-REFERENCE: $task5_validate_actor" \
+      "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(grep -Ec \
+      '^VERDICT: APPROVE CRITICAL=0 IMPORTANT=0 MINOR=[0-9]+$' \
+      "$task5_validate_response")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_minor_dispositions \
+      "$task5_validate_response" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(wc -l < "$task5_validate_identity" | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 6 || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_validate_identity" || return 1
+    task5_validate_identity_cr_count="$(awk \
+      'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+      "$task5_validate_identity")" || return 1
+    case "$task5_validate_identity_cr_count" in
+      ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    test "$task5_validate_identity_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_validate_identity" | od -An -tu1 | \
+      tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = 10 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(sed -n '1p' "$task5_validate_identity")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = checkpoint=P5R1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(sed -n '2p' "$task5_validate_identity")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "lane=$task5_validate_lane" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(sed -n '3p' "$task5_validate_identity")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "package-sha256=$task5_validate_package_sha" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(sed -n '4p' "$task5_validate_identity")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "response-sha256=$task5_validate_response_sha" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(sed -n '5p' "$task5_validate_identity")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "reviewer-reference=$task5_validate_reviewer" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(sed -n '6p' "$task5_validate_identity")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "implementation-actor-reference=$task5_validate_actor" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_identity" \
+      checkpoint)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = P5R1 || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_identity" lane)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = \
+      "$task5_validate_lane" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_identity" \
+      package-sha256)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_validate_package_sha" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_identity" \
+      response-sha256)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_validate_response_sha" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_identity" \
+      reviewer-reference)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_validate_reviewer" || return 1
+    task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value "$task5_validate_identity" \
+      implementation-actor-reference)" || return 1
+    test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_validate_actor" || return 1
+  done
+  return 0
 }
 
 task5_bootstrap_capture_repo_state() {
-  test "$#" = 2

   task5_capture_root="$1"

   task5_capture_identity="$task5_capture_prefix.identity"

   git -C "$task5_capture_root" status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all \

   task5_capture_porcelain_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_capture_porcelain" | \

   printf 'HEAD=%s\nindex-tree=%s\nbranch=%s\nporcelain-sha256=%s\n' \

+    "$task5_capture_head" "$task5_capture_tree" "$task5_capture_branch" \

+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_capture_identity" || return 1
