+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_review_package_sha() {
+  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_review_checkpoint="$1"
+  case "$task5_review_checkpoint" in
+    C51|C52|C53|C53C1|C53C2|FINAL|R) ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_review_package_root="$review_packages_root/$task5_review_checkpoint"
+  task5_review_package_manifest="$task5_review_package_root/manifest.sha256"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$task5_review_package_root" 500 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular \
+    "$task5_review_package_manifest" || return 1
+  task5_review_package_manifest_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
+    "$task5_review_package_manifest")" || return 1
+  task5_review_package_manifest_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
+    "$task5_review_package_manifest")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_review_package_manifest_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_review_package_manifest_links" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_review_package_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_review_package_manifest" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_review_package_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$task5_review_package_root" \
+    "$task5_review_package_manifest" "$task5_review_package_sha" || return 1
+  printf '%s\n' "$task5_review_package_sha"
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_review_response() {
+  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
+  task5_review_checkpoint="$1"
+  task5_review_lane="$2"
+  task5_review_expected_response_sha="$3"
+  task5_review_expected_package_sha="$4"
+  case "$task5_review_checkpoint" in
+    C51|C52|C53|C53C1|C53C2|FINAL|R) ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  case "$task5_review_lane" in
+    spec|quality) ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_review_expected_response_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_review_expected_package_sha" || return 1
+  task5_review_response_root="$review_responses_root/$task5_review_checkpoint"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$task5_review_response_root" 700 || \
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+      "$task5_review_response_root" 500 || return 1
+  task5_review_response="$task5_review_response_root/$task5_review_lane.response.md"
+  task5_review_identity="$task5_review_response_root/$task5_review_lane.identity"
+  for task5_review_file in "$task5_review_response" "$task5_review_identity"; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_review_file" || return 1
+    task5_review_file_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_review_file")" || return 1
+    task5_review_file_links="$(stat -f '%l' "$task5_review_file")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_review_file_mode" = 400 || return 1
+    test "$task5_review_file_links" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_review_file" || return 1
+  done
+  task5_review_response_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_review_response" | \
+    awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_review_response_sha" = \
+    "$task5_review_expected_response_sha" || return 1
+  task5_review_identity_lines="$(wc -l < "$task5_review_identity" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_review_identity_lines" = 6 || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_review_identity" checkpoint)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$task5_review_checkpoint" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_review_identity" lane)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = "$task5_review_lane" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_review_identity" package-sha256)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$task5_review_expected_package_sha" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_review_identity" response-sha256)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$task5_review_expected_response_sha" || return 1
+  task5_command_output="$(task5_bootstrap_receipt_value \
+    "$task5_review_identity" implementation-actor-reference)" || return 1
+  test "$task5_command_output" = \
+    "$task5_implementation_actor_reference" || return 1
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_write_ledger_genesis() {
+  test "$#" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$task5_ledger_chain_root" 700 || return 1
+  task5_ledger_genesis_path="$task5_ledger_chain_root/genesis.identity"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_ledger_genesis_path" || return 1
+  printf 'format=task5-recovery-ledger-genesis-v1\nP0=%s\nD5R1=%s\nP5R1=%s\nauthority-bundle-manifest-sha256=%s\naccepted-review-package-sha256=ABSENT\naccepted-spec-response-sha256=ABSENT\naccepted-quality-response-sha256=ABSENT\n' \
+    "$source_plan_commit" "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" "$plan_commit" \
+    "$authority_bundle_sha" > "$task5_ledger_genesis_path" || return 1
+  chmod 400 "$task5_ledger_genesis_path" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular \
+    "$task5_ledger_genesis_path" || return 1
+  task5_ledger_genesis_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
+    "$task5_ledger_genesis_path")" || return 1
+  task5_ledger_genesis_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
+    "$task5_ledger_genesis_path")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_ledger_genesis_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_ledger_genesis_links" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_ledger_genesis_path" || return 1
+  task5_ledger_genesis_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_ledger_genesis_path" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_ledger_genesis_sha" || return 1
+  task5_ledger_entry_count=0
+  task5_ledger_head_sha256="$task5_ledger_genesis_sha"
+  task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256="$task5_ledger_genesis_sha"
+  task5_accepted_review_checkpoint=ABSENT
+  task5_accepted_review_package_sha256=ABSENT
+  task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256=ABSENT
+  task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256=ABSENT
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_update_review_tuple() {
+  test "$#" = 5 || return 1
+  task5_review_action="$1"
+  task5_review_child_status="$2"
+  task5_review_arg1="$3"
+  task5_review_arg2="$4"
+  task5_review_arg3="$5"
+  case "$task5_review_child_status" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  if test "$task5_review_child_status" != 0; then
+    return 0
+  fi
+  if test "$task5_review_action" = recovery-postcommit; then
+    test "$task5_ledger_entry_count" = 0 || return 1
+    test "$task5_accepted_review_checkpoint" = ABSENT || return 1
+    test "$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" = ABSENT || return 1
+    test "$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" = ABSENT || return 1
+    test "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" = ABSENT || return 1
+    test "$task5_review_arg1" = "$approval_plan_sha" || return 1
+    test "$task5_review_arg2" = "$plan_auditor_sha" || return 1
+    test "$task5_review_arg3" = "$authority_bundle_sha" || return 1
+    for task5_review_sha in "$recovery_review_package_sha" \
+        "$approval_spec_sha" "$approval_quality_sha"; do
+      task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_review_sha" || return 1
+    done
+    task5_accepted_review_checkpoint=P5R1
+    task5_accepted_review_package_sha256="$recovery_review_package_sha"
+    task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256="$approval_spec_sha"
+    task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256="$approval_quality_sha"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  if test "$task5_review_action" != seal-review-response; then
+    return 0
+  fi
+  task5_review_package_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_review_package_sha \
+    "$task5_review_arg1")" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_review_response "$task5_review_arg1" \
+    "$task5_review_arg2" "$task5_review_arg3" \
+    "$task5_review_package_sha" || return 1
+  if test "$task5_review_arg2" = spec; then
+    test "$task5_accepted_review_checkpoint" != "$task5_review_arg1" || \
+      return 1
+    test "$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" != ABSENT || return 1
+    test "$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" != ABSENT || return 1
+    test "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" != ABSENT || return 1
+    task5_accepted_review_checkpoint="$task5_review_arg1"
+    task5_accepted_review_package_sha256="$task5_review_package_sha"
+    task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256="$task5_review_arg3"
+    task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256=ABSENT
+    return 0
+  fi
+  test "$task5_review_arg2" = quality || return 1
+  test "$task5_accepted_review_checkpoint" = "$task5_review_arg1" || return 1
+  test "$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" = \
+    "$task5_review_package_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" || return 1
+  test "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" = ABSENT || return 1
+  task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256="$task5_review_arg3"
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_write_ledger_link() {
+  test "$#" = 5 || return 1
+  task5_link_ordinal="$1"
+  task5_link_action="$2"
+  task5_link_entry_manifest_sha="$3"
+  task5_link_chain_before="$4"
+  task5_link_previous_manifest_sha="$5"
+  task5_link_expected_ordinal="$(printf '%06d' \
+    "$((task5_ledger_entry_count + 1))")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_link_ordinal" = "$task5_link_expected_ordinal" || return 1
+  case "$task5_link_action" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._-]*) \
+      return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  for task5_link_sha in "$task5_link_entry_manifest_sha" \
+      "$task5_link_chain_before" "$task5_link_previous_manifest_sha"; do
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_link_sha" || return 1
+  done
+  test "$task5_link_chain_before" = "$task5_ledger_head_sha256" || return 1
+  test "$task5_link_previous_manifest_sha" = \
+    "$task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256" || return 1
+  task5_link_entry="$commands_root/$task5_link_ordinal"
+  task5_link_manifest="$task5_link_entry/manifest.sha256"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$task5_link_entry" 500 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$task5_link_entry" \
+    "$task5_link_manifest" "$task5_link_entry_manifest_sha" || return 1
+  task5_link_argv_lines="$(wc -l < "$task5_link_entry/argv.q" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_link_argv_action="$(awk 'NR == 1 {print $5}' \
+    "$task5_link_entry/argv.q")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_link_argv_lines" = 1 || return 1
+  test "$task5_link_argv_action" = "$task5_link_action" || return 1
+  case "$task5_accepted_review_checkpoint" in
+    ABSENT)
+      test "$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" = ABSENT || return 1
+      test "$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" = ABSENT || return 1
+      test "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" = ABSENT || return 1 ;;
+    P5R1|C51|C52|C53|C53C1|C53C2|FINAL|R)
+      task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+        "$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" || return 1
+      task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+        "$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" || return 1
+      if test "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" != ABSENT; then
+        task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+          "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" || return 1
+      fi ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_link_path="$task5_ledger_chain_root/$task5_link_ordinal.identity"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$task5_link_path" || return 1
+  printf 'format=task5-recovery-ledger-link-v1\nordinal=%s\naction=%s\nprevious-entry-manifest-sha256=%s\nledger-chain-before=%s\nentry-manifest-sha256=%s\naccepted-review-checkpoint=%s\naccepted-review-package-sha256=%s\naccepted-spec-response-sha256=%s\naccepted-quality-response-sha256=%s\n' \
+    "$task5_link_ordinal" "$task5_link_action" \
+    "$task5_link_previous_manifest_sha" "$task5_link_chain_before" \
+    "$task5_link_entry_manifest_sha" "$task5_accepted_review_checkpoint" \
+    "$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" \
+    "$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" \
+    "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" > "$task5_link_path" || return 1
+  chmod 400 "$task5_link_path" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_link_path" || return 1
+  task5_link_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_link_path")" || return 1
+  task5_link_links="$(stat -f '%l' "$task5_link_path")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_link_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_link_links" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_link_path" || return 1
+  task5_link_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_link_path" | \
+    awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_link_sha" || return 1
+  task5_ledger_entry_count=$((task5_ledger_entry_count + 1))
+  task5_ledger_head_sha256="$task5_link_sha"
+  task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256="$task5_link_entry_manifest_sha"
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_require_action_ordinal() {
+  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
+  task5_latch_action="$1"
+  task5_latch_ordinal="$2"
+  task5_latch_prior_count="$3"
+  task5_latch_argument_count="$4"
+  case "$task5_latch_action" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._-]*) \
+      return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  case "$task5_latch_ordinal:$task5_latch_prior_count:$task5_latch_argument_count" in
+    *[!0123456789:]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_latch_prior_count" -lt 148 || return 1
+  test "$task5_latch_ordinal" = \
+    "$((task5_latch_prior_count + 1))" || return 1
+  if test "$task5_latch_ordinal" = 148; then
+    test "$task5_latch_action" = final-audit || return 1
+    test "$task5_latch_argument_count" = 1 || return 1
+  else
+    test "$task5_latch_action" != final-audit || return 1
+  fi
+  if test "$task5_latch_ordinal" = 1; then
+    test "$task5_latch_action" = recovery-postcommit || return 1
+    test "$task5_latch_argument_count" = 4 || return 1
+  else
+    test "$task5_latch_action" != recovery-postcommit || return 1
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_set_abort_context() {
+  task5_abort_context_action=bootstrap
+  task5_abort_context_ordinal=000000
+  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
+  task5_attempt_argument_count="$1"
+  task5_attempt_action="$2"
+  case "$task5_attempt_argument_count" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_attempt_argument_count" -ge 1 || return 1
+  case "${task5_ledger_entry_count-}" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  case "$task5_attempt_action" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._-]*) \
+      return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_attempt_ordinal=$((task5_ledger_entry_count + 1))
+  task5_attempt_ordinal_name="$(printf '%06d' \
+    "$task5_attempt_ordinal")" || return 1
+  task5_abort_context_action="$task5_attempt_action"
+  task5_abort_context_ordinal="$task5_attempt_ordinal_name"
+  return 0
+}
+
+task5_bootstrap_verify_finalized_receipt() {
+  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_verify_finalized="$1"
+  case "$task5_verify_finalized" in
+    "${finalized_path-}"|"${finalized_pending_path-}") ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular \
+    "$task5_verify_finalized" || return 1
+  task5_verify_finalized_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
+    "$task5_verify_finalized")" || return 1
+  task5_verify_finalized_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
+    "$task5_verify_finalized")" || return 1
+  task5_verify_finalized_lines="$(wc -l < "$task5_verify_finalized" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_verify_finalized_bytes="$(wc -c < "$task5_verify_finalized" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_verify_finalized_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 \
+    "$task5_verify_finalized" | od -An -tu1 | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_verify_finalized_cr_count="$(awk \
+    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_verify_finalized")" || return 1
+  task5_verify_finalized_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$task5_verify_finalized" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_verify_finalized_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_verify_finalized_links" = 1 || return 1
+  test "$task5_verify_finalized_lines" = 21 || return 1
+  case "$task5_verify_finalized_bytes" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_verify_finalized_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+  test "$task5_verify_finalized_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file \
+    "$task5_verify_finalized" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_verify_finalized_sha" || return 1
+  if test -n "${task5_finalized_sha-}"; then
+    test "$task5_verify_finalized_sha" = \
+      "$task5_finalized_sha" || return 1
+  fi
+  if test -n "${task5_finalized_bytes-}"; then
+    test "$task5_verify_finalized_bytes" = \
+      "$task5_finalized_bytes" || return 1
+  fi
+  test "${task5_ledger_entry_count-}" = 148 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "${task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "${task5_ledger_head_sha256-}" || return 1
+  test "${task5_accepted_review_checkpoint-}" = R || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "${task5_accepted_review_package_sha256-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "${task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "${task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "${commands_root-}" 500 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "${task5_ledger_chain_root-}" 500 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 1 \
+    format=task5-recovery-finalized-v1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 2 \
+    final-entry=000148 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 3 \
+    ledger-entry-count=148 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 4 \
+    "final-entry-manifest-sha256=$task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 5 \
+    "final-ledger-head-sha256=$task5_ledger_head_sha256" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 6 \
+    accepted-review-checkpoint=R || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 7 \
+    "accepted-review-package-sha256=$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 8 \
+    "accepted-spec-response-sha256=$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 9 \
+    "accepted-quality-response-sha256=$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 10 \
+    "controller-sha256=${task5_driver_sha-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 11 \
+    "plan-auditor-sha256=${plan_auditor_sha-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 12 \
+    "bootstrap-sha256=${task5_bootstrap_sha-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 13 \
+    "derivation-manifest-sha256=${derivation_manifest_sha-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 14 \
+    "original-authority-manifest-sha256=${original_authority_sha-}" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 15 \
+    "failure-package-manifest-sha256=${failure_package_sha-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 16 \
+    "authority-bundle-manifest-sha256=${authority_bundle_sha-}" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 17 \
+    "implementation-actor-reference=${task5_implementation_actor_reference-}" || \
+    return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 18 \
+    "P0=${source_plan_commit-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 19 \
+    "D5R1=${TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 20 \
+    "P5R1=${plan_commit-}" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_verify_finalized" 21 \
+    "amendment=${TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT-}" || return 1
+  return 0
 }
 
+task5_bootstrap_publish_finalized_receipt() {
+  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_publish_final_ordinal="$1"
+  test "$task5_publish_final_ordinal" = 000148 || return 1
+  test "${task5_finalized_externalized-0}" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$finalized_path" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path \
+    "$finalized_pending_path" || return 1
+  chmod 500 "$commands_root" "$task5_ledger_chain_root" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$commands_root" 500 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$task5_ledger_chain_root" 500 || return 1
+  printf 'format=task5-recovery-finalized-v1\nfinal-entry=%s\nledger-entry-count=148\nfinal-entry-manifest-sha256=%s\nfinal-ledger-head-sha256=%s\naccepted-review-checkpoint=%s\naccepted-review-package-sha256=%s\naccepted-spec-response-sha256=%s\naccepted-quality-response-sha256=%s\ncontroller-sha256=%s\nplan-auditor-sha256=%s\nbootstrap-sha256=%s\nderivation-manifest-sha256=%s\noriginal-authority-manifest-sha256=%s\nfailure-package-manifest-sha256=%s\nauthority-bundle-manifest-sha256=%s\nimplementation-actor-reference=%s\nP0=%s\nD5R1=%s\nP5R1=%s\namendment=%s\n' \
+    "$task5_publish_final_ordinal" \
+    "$task5_ledger_previous_manifest_sha256" \
+    "$task5_ledger_head_sha256" "$task5_accepted_review_checkpoint" \
+    "$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" \
+    "$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" \
+    "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" \
+    "$task5_driver_sha" "$plan_auditor_sha" \
+    "$task5_bootstrap_sha" "$derivation_manifest_sha" \
+    "$original_authority_sha" "$failure_package_sha" \
+    "$authority_bundle_sha" "$task5_implementation_actor_reference" \
+    "$source_plan_commit" "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" "$plan_commit" \
+    "$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" \
+    > "$finalized_pending_path" || return 1
+  chmod 400 "$finalized_pending_path" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_verify_finalized_receipt \
+    "$finalized_pending_path" || return 1
+  task5_publish_final_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$finalized_pending_path" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_publish_final_bytes="$(wc -c < "$finalized_pending_path" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_publish_final_sha" || return 1
+  case "$task5_publish_final_bytes" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path "$finalized_path" || return 1
+  /bin/mv "$finalized_pending_path" "$finalized_path" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_absent_path \
+    "$finalized_pending_path" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_verify_finalized_receipt "$finalized_path" || return 1
+  task5_publish_committed_sha="$(shasum -a 256 \
+    "$finalized_path" | awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_publish_committed_bytes="$(wc -c < "$finalized_path" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  test "$task5_publish_committed_sha" = \
+    "$task5_publish_final_sha" || return 1
+  test "$task5_publish_committed_bytes" = \
+    "$task5_publish_final_bytes" || return 1
+  task5_finalized_sha="$task5_publish_final_sha"
+  task5_finalized_bytes="$task5_publish_final_bytes"
+  readonly task5_finalized_sha task5_finalized_bytes
+  cat "$finalized_path" || return 1
+  printf 'finalized-receipt-sha256=%s bytes=%s\n' \
+    "$task5_finalized_sha" "$task5_finalized_bytes" || return 1
+  task5_finalized_externalized=1
+  readonly task5_finalized_externalized
+  return 0
+}

+task5_bootstrap_audit_ledger() (
+  set -euo pipefail
+  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
+  task5_audit_expected_count="$1"
+  task5_audit_expected_head="$2"
+  task5_audit_expected_previous_manifest="$3"
+  case "$task5_audit_expected_count" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$task5_audit_expected_count" -le 148 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_audit_expected_head" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+    "$task5_audit_expected_previous_manifest" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory "$commands_root" 700 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+    "$task5_ledger_chain_root" 700 || return 1
+  task5_audit_genesis="$task5_ledger_chain_root/genesis.identity"
+  task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_audit_genesis" || return 1
+  task5_audit_genesis_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' \
+    "$task5_audit_genesis")" || return 1
+  task5_audit_genesis_links="$(stat -f '%l' \
+    "$task5_audit_genesis")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_genesis_mode" = 400 || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_genesis_links" = 1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_audit_genesis" || return 1
+  task5_audit_genesis_lines="$(wc -l < "$task5_audit_genesis" | \
+    tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_audit_genesis_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_audit_genesis" | \
+    od -An -tu1 | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+  task5_audit_genesis_cr_count="$(awk \
+    'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+    "$task5_audit_genesis")" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_genesis_lines" = 8 || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_genesis_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_genesis_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_genesis" 1 \
+    format=task5-recovery-ledger-genesis-v1 || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_genesis" 2 \
+    "P0=$source_plan_commit" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_genesis" 3 \
+    "D5R1=$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_genesis" 4 \
+    "P5R1=$plan_commit" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_genesis" 5 \
+    "authority-bundle-manifest-sha256=$authority_bundle_sha" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_genesis" 6 \
+    accepted-review-package-sha256=ABSENT || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_genesis" 7 \
+    accepted-spec-response-sha256=ABSENT || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_genesis" 8 \
+    accepted-quality-response-sha256=ABSENT || return 1
+  task5_audit_head="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_audit_genesis" | \
+    awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+  task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_audit_head" || return 1
+  task5_audit_previous_manifest="$task5_audit_head"
+  task5_audit_accepted_checkpoint=ABSENT
+  task5_audit_accepted_package=ABSENT
+  task5_audit_accepted_spec=ABSENT
+  task5_audit_accepted_quality=ABSENT
+  task5_audit_command_dir_count="$({ set -o pipefail; \
+    find "$commands_root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -print | \
+      wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]'; })" || return 1
+  task5_audit_command_other_count="$({ set -o pipefail; \
+    find "$commands_root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -type d -print | \
+      wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]'; })" || return 1
+  task5_audit_chain_file_count="$({ set -o pipefail; \
+    find "$task5_ledger_chain_root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | \
+      wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]'; })" || return 1
+  task5_audit_chain_other_count="$({ set -o pipefail; \
+    find "$task5_ledger_chain_root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -type f -print | \
+      wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]'; })" || return 1
+  for task5_audit_count in "$task5_audit_command_dir_count" \
+      "$task5_audit_command_other_count" "$task5_audit_chain_file_count" \
+      "$task5_audit_chain_other_count"; do
+    case "$task5_audit_count" in
+      ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+  done
+  test "$task5_audit_command_dir_count" = \
+    "$task5_audit_expected_count" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_command_other_count" = 0 || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_chain_file_count" = \
+    "$((task5_audit_expected_count + 1))" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_chain_other_count" = 0 || return 1
+  task5_audit_ordinal=1
+  while test "$task5_audit_ordinal" -le "$task5_audit_expected_count"; do
+    task5_audit_name="$(printf '%06d' "$task5_audit_ordinal")" || return 1
+    task5_audit_entry="$commands_root/$task5_audit_name"
+    task5_audit_manifest="$task5_audit_entry/manifest.sha256"
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_directory \
+      "$task5_audit_entry" 500 || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular \
+      "$task5_audit_manifest" || return 1
+    task5_audit_manifest_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_audit_manifest" | \
+      awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_audit_manifest_sha" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_verify_manifest_root "$task5_audit_entry" \
+      "$task5_audit_manifest" "$task5_audit_manifest_sha" || return 1
+    task5_audit_exit_value="$(cat "$task5_audit_entry/exit")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_exit_value" = 0 || return 1
+    task5_audit_controller="$task5_audit_entry/controller.identity"
+    task5_audit_controller_lines="$(wc -l < "$task5_audit_controller" | \
+      tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_controller_lines" = 17 || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" \
+      implementation-actor-reference \
+      "$task5_implementation_actor_reference" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" P0 \
+      "$source_plan_commit" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" D5R1 \
+      "$TASK5_D5R1_COMMIT" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" P5R1 \
+      "$plan_commit" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" \
+      source-plan-path "$source_plan_path" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" \
+      plan-path "$plan_path" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" \
+      amendment "$TASK5_RECOVERY_AMENDMENT" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" \
+      ledger-chain-before "$task5_audit_head" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_receipt_value "$task5_audit_controller" \
+      previous-entry-manifest-sha256 \
+      "$task5_audit_previous_manifest" || return 1
+    task5_audit_argv="$task5_audit_entry/argv.q"
+    task5_audit_argv_lines="$(wc -l < "$task5_audit_argv" | \
+      tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_audit_argv_fields="$(awk \
+      'NR == 1 {fields=NF} END {if (NR != 1) exit 1; print fields}' \
+      "$task5_audit_argv")" || return 1
+    case "$task5_audit_argv_fields" in
+      ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    test "$task5_audit_argv_lines" = 1 || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_argv_fields" -ge 5 || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_argv_fields" -le 8 || return 1
+    task5_audit_argv_prefix="$(awk \
+      'NR == 1 {print $1 " " $2 " " $3 " " $4}' \
+      "$task5_audit_argv")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_argv_prefix" = \
+      "/bin/bash --noprofile --norc $task5_driver" || return 1
+    task5_audit_action="$(awk 'NR == 1 {print $5}' \
+      "$task5_audit_argv")" || return 1
+    task5_audit_arg1="$(awk 'NR == 1 {print $6}' \
+      "$task5_audit_argv")" || return 1
+    task5_audit_arg2="$(awk 'NR == 1 {print $7}' \
+      "$task5_audit_argv")" || return 1
+    task5_audit_arg3="$(awk 'NR == 1 {print $8}' \
+      "$task5_audit_argv")" || return 1
+    if test "$task5_audit_action" = recovery-postcommit; then
+      test "$task5_audit_ordinal" = 1 || return 1
+      test "$task5_audit_argv_fields" = 8 || return 1
+      test "$task5_audit_arg1" = "$approval_plan_sha" || return 1
+      test "$task5_audit_arg2" = "$plan_auditor_sha" || return 1
+      test "$task5_audit_arg3" = "$authority_bundle_sha" || return 1
+      test "$task5_audit_accepted_checkpoint" = ABSENT || return 1
+      task5_audit_accepted_checkpoint=P5R1
+      task5_audit_accepted_package="$recovery_review_package_sha"
+      task5_audit_accepted_spec="$approval_spec_sha"
+      task5_audit_accepted_quality="$approval_quality_sha"
+    elif test "$task5_audit_action" = seal-review-response; then
+      test "$task5_audit_argv_fields" = 8 || return 1
+      task5_audit_package_sha="$(task5_bootstrap_review_package_sha \
+        "$task5_audit_arg1")" || return 1
+      task5_bootstrap_require_review_response "$task5_audit_arg1" \
+        "$task5_audit_arg2" "$task5_audit_arg3" \
+        "$task5_audit_package_sha" || return 1
+      if test "$task5_audit_arg2" = spec; then
+        test "$task5_audit_accepted_checkpoint" != \
+          "$task5_audit_arg1" || return 1
+        test "$task5_audit_accepted_quality" != ABSENT || return 1
+        task5_audit_accepted_checkpoint="$task5_audit_arg1"
+        task5_audit_accepted_package="$task5_audit_package_sha"
+        task5_audit_accepted_spec="$task5_audit_arg3"
+        task5_audit_accepted_quality=ABSENT
+      else
+        test "$task5_audit_arg2" = quality || return 1
+        test "$task5_audit_accepted_checkpoint" = \
+          "$task5_audit_arg1" || return 1
+        test "$task5_audit_accepted_package" = \
+          "$task5_audit_package_sha" || return 1
+        task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 \
+          "$task5_audit_accepted_spec" || return 1
+        test "$task5_audit_accepted_quality" = ABSENT || return 1
+        task5_audit_accepted_quality="$task5_audit_arg3"
+      fi
+    fi
+    task5_audit_link="$task5_ledger_chain_root/$task5_audit_name.identity"
+    task5_bootstrap_require_owned_regular "$task5_audit_link" || return 1
+    task5_audit_link_mode="$(stat -f '%Lp' "$task5_audit_link")" || return 1
+    task5_audit_link_links="$(stat -f '%l' "$task5_audit_link")" || return 1
+    task5_audit_link_lines="$(wc -l < "$task5_audit_link" | \
+      tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_audit_link_last_byte="$(tail -c 1 "$task5_audit_link" | \
+      od -An -tu1 | tr -d '[:space:]')" || return 1
+    task5_audit_link_cr_count="$(awk \
+      'index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {n++} END {print n + 0}' \
+      "$task5_audit_link")" || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_link_mode" = 400 || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_link_links" = 1 || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_link_lines" = 10 || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_link_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
+    test "$task5_audit_link_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_no_nul_file "$task5_audit_link" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 1 \
+      format=task5-recovery-ledger-link-v1 || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 2 \
+      "ordinal=$task5_audit_name" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 3 \
+      "action=$task5_audit_action" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 4 \
+      "previous-entry-manifest-sha256=$task5_audit_previous_manifest" || \
+      return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 5 \
+      "ledger-chain-before=$task5_audit_head" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 6 \
+      "entry-manifest-sha256=$task5_audit_manifest_sha" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 7 \
+      "accepted-review-checkpoint=$task5_audit_accepted_checkpoint" || \
+      return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 8 \
+      "accepted-review-package-sha256=$task5_audit_accepted_package" || \
+      return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 9 \
+      "accepted-spec-response-sha256=$task5_audit_accepted_spec" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_exact_line "$task5_audit_link" 10 \
+      "accepted-quality-response-sha256=$task5_audit_accepted_quality" || \
+      return 1
+    task5_audit_head="$(shasum -a 256 "$task5_audit_link" | \
+      awk '{print $1}')" || return 1
+    task5_bootstrap_require_sha256 "$task5_audit_head" || return 1
+    task5_audit_previous_manifest="$task5_audit_manifest_sha"
+    task5_audit_ordinal=$((task5_audit_ordinal + 1))
+  done
+  test "$task5_audit_head" = "$task5_audit_expected_head" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_previous_manifest" = \
+    "$task5_audit_expected_previous_manifest" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_accepted_checkpoint" = \
+    "$task5_accepted_review_checkpoint" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_accepted_package" = \
+    "$task5_accepted_review_package_sha256" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_accepted_spec" = \
+    "$task5_accepted_spec_response_sha256" || return 1
+  test "$task5_audit_accepted_quality" = \
+    "$task5_accepted_quality_response_sha256" || return 1
+  return 0

+    "${task5_abort_context_action-bootstrap}" \

+  return "$task5_clean_call_status"

~~~diff
+  ordinal=1
+  while test "$ordinal" -le "$expected_count"; do
+    ordinal_name="$(printf '%06d' "$ordinal")" || return 1
+    entry="$ledger_commands_root/$ordinal_name"
+    task5_require_owned_directory "$entry" 500 || return 1
+    manifest="$entry/manifest.sha256"
+    task5_require_owned_regular "$manifest" 400 || return 1
+    entry_manifest_sha="$(task5_sha256 "$manifest")" || return 1
+    task5_verify_manifest_root "$entry" "$manifest" \
+      "$entry_manifest_sha" || return 1
+    task5_require_ledger_controller_identity "$entry/controller.identity" \
+      "$chain_head" "$previous_manifest" || return 1
+    task5_require_owned_regular "$entry/argv.q" 400 || return 1
+    task5_require_owned_regular "$entry/exit" 400 || return 1
+    test "$(task5_regular_line_count "$entry/argv.q")" = 1 || return 1
+    test "$(task5_regular_line_count "$entry/exit")" = 1 || return 1
+    task5_require_status_file "$entry/exit" 0 || return 1
+    argv_content="$(cat "$entry/argv.q")" || return 1
+    case "$argv_content" in
+      ''|*[!0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._/:\ -]*)
+        return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    set -- $argv_content
+    test "${1-}" = /bin/bash || return 1
+    test "${2-}" = --noprofile || return 1
+    test "${3-}" = --norc || return 1
+    test "${4-}" = "$TASK5_DRIVER_PATH" || return 1
+    action="${5-}"
+    test -n "$action" || return 1
+    action_arity="$(( $# - 5 ))"
+    test "$action_arity" -ge 0 || return 1
+    action_arg1="${6-}"
+    action_arg2="${7-}"
+    action_arg3="${8-}"
+
+    next_review_checkpoint="$review_checkpoint"
+    next_review_package="$review_package"
+    next_spec_response="$spec_response"
+    next_quality_response="$quality_response"
+    if test "$ordinal" = 1; then
+      test "$action" = recovery-postcommit || return 1
+      test "$action_arity" = 3 || return 1
+      test "$review_checkpoint" = ABSENT || return 1
+      authority_receipt="$TASK5_AUTHORITY_BUNDLE_ROOT/authority.receipt"
+      next_review_checkpoint=P5R1
+      next_review_package="$(task5_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
+        review-package-sha256)" || return 1
+      next_spec_response="$(task5_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
+        spec-response-sha256)" || return 1
+      next_quality_response="$(task5_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
+        quality-response-sha256)" || return 1
+    elif test "$action" = recovery-postcommit; then
+      return 1
+    elif test "$action" = seal-review-response; then
+      test "$action_arity" = 3 || return 1
+      task5_require_review_target "$action_arg1" || return 1
+      task5_require_review_lane "$action_arg2" || return 1
+      task5_require_sha256 "$action_arg3" || return 1
+      transition_package_manifest="$TASK5_REVIEW_PACKAGES_ROOT/$action_arg1/manifest.sha256"
+      task5_require_owned_regular "$transition_package_manifest" 400 || \
+        return 1
+      transition_package_sha="$(task5_sha256 \
+        "$transition_package_manifest")" || return 1
+      if test "$action_arg2" = spec; then
+        test "$review_checkpoint" != ABSENT || return 1
+        test "$review_checkpoint" != "$action_arg1" || return 1
+        task5_require_sha256 "$review_package" || return 1
+        task5_require_sha256 "$spec_response" || return 1
+        task5_require_sha256 "$quality_response" || return 1
+        next_review_checkpoint="$action_arg1"
+        next_review_package="$transition_package_sha"
+        next_spec_response="$action_arg3"
+        next_quality_response=ABSENT
+      else
+        test "$review_checkpoint" = "$action_arg1" || return 1
+        test "$review_package" = "$transition_package_sha" || return 1
+        task5_require_sha256 "$spec_response" || return 1
+        test "$quality_response" = ABSENT || return 1
+        next_quality_response="$action_arg3"
+      fi
+    fi
+    task5_require_review_tuple_shape "$next_review_checkpoint" \
+      "$next_review_package" "$next_spec_response" \
+      "$next_quality_response" || return 1
+
+    link="$ledger_chain_root/$ordinal_name.identity"
+    task5_require_owned_regular "$link" 400 || return 1
+    link_count="$(stat -f '%l' "$link")" || return 1
+    test "$link_count" = 1 || return 1
+    link_lines="$(task5_regular_line_count "$link")" || return 1
+    test "$link_lines" = 10 || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" format)" = \
+      task5-recovery-ledger-link-v1 || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" ordinal)" = \
+      "$ordinal_name" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" action)" = "$action" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" \
+      previous-entry-manifest-sha256)" = "$previous_manifest" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" ledger-chain-before)" = \
+      "$chain_head" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" entry-manifest-sha256)" = \
+      "$entry_manifest_sha" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" accepted-review-checkpoint)" = \
+      "$next_review_checkpoint" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" \
+      accepted-review-package-sha256)" = \
+      "$next_review_package" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" \
+      accepted-spec-response-sha256)" = "$next_spec_response" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$link" \
+      accepted-quality-response-sha256)" = \
+      "$next_quality_response" || return 1
+    chain_head="$(task5_sha256 "$link")" || return 1
+    previous_manifest="$entry_manifest_sha"
+    review_checkpoint="$next_review_checkpoint"
+    review_package="$next_review_package"
+    spec_response="$next_spec_response"
+    quality_response="$next_quality_response"
+    ordinal=$((ordinal + 1))
+  done
+  test "$chain_head" = "$expected_head" || return 1
+  test "$previous_manifest" = "$expected_last_manifest" || return 1
+  test "$review_checkpoint" = "$expected_review_checkpoint" || return 1
+  test "$review_package" = "$expected_review_package" || return 1
+  test "$spec_response" = "$expected_spec_response" || return 1
+  test "$quality_response" = "$expected_quality_response" || return 1
+)

+task5_require_review_package_ledger_prefix() (
+  set -euo pipefail
+  export LC_ALL=C
+  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
+  ledger_package_root="$1"
+  expected_package_sha="$2"
+  task5_require_sha256 "$expected_package_sha" || return 1
+  task5_verify_manifest_root "$ledger_package_root" \
+    "$ledger_package_root/manifest.sha256" "$expected_package_sha" || \
+    return 1
+  prefix_identity="$ledger_package_root/ledger-prefix.identity"
+  task5_require_owned_regular "$prefix_identity" 400 || return 1
+  prefix_link_count="$(stat -f '%l' "$prefix_identity")" || return 1
+  test "$prefix_link_count" = 1 || return 1
+  prefix_lines="$(task5_regular_line_count "$prefix_identity")" || return 1
+  test "$prefix_lines" = 9 || return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" format)" = \
+    task5-recovery-ledger-prefix-v1 || return 1
+  prefix_count="$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" entry-count)" || \
+    return 1
+  case "$prefix_count" in
+    [1-9]|[1-9][0-9]*) ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$prefix_count" -gt 0 || return 1
+  expected_last_ordinal="$(printf '%06d' "$prefix_count")" || return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" last-ordinal)" = \
+    "$expected_last_ordinal" || return 1
+  prefix_last_manifest="$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" \
+    last-entry-manifest-sha256)" || return 1
+  prefix_head="$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" \
+    ledger-head-sha256)" || return 1
+  prefix_review_checkpoint="$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" \
+    accepted-review-checkpoint)" || return 1
+  prefix_review_package="$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" \
+    accepted-review-package-sha256)" || return 1
+  prefix_spec_response="$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" \
+    accepted-spec-response-sha256)" || return 1
+  prefix_quality_response="$(task5_receipt_value "$prefix_identity" \
+    accepted-quality-response-sha256)" || return 1
+  task5_require_sha256 "$prefix_last_manifest" || return 1
+  task5_require_sha256 "$prefix_head" || return 1
+  task5_require_review_tuple_shape "$prefix_review_checkpoint" \
+    "$prefix_review_package" "$prefix_spec_response" \
+    "$prefix_quality_response" || return 1
+  test "$prefix_quality_response" != ABSENT || return 1
+  task5_require_ledger_prefix_tree \
+    "$ledger_package_root/commands" 500 \
+    "$ledger_package_root/ledger-chain" 500 \
+    "$prefix_count" ABSENT "$prefix_head" "$prefix_last_manifest" \
+    "$prefix_review_checkpoint" "$prefix_review_package" \
+    "$prefix_spec_response" "$prefix_quality_response" || return 1
+  ordinal=1
+  while test "$ordinal" -le "$prefix_count"; do
+    ordinal_name="$(printf '%06d' "$ordinal")" || return 1
+    diff -r "$ledger_package_root/commands/$ordinal_name" \
+      "$TASK5_COMMANDS_ROOT/$ordinal_name" >/dev/null || return 1
+    cmp -s "$ledger_package_root/ledger-chain/$ordinal_name.identity" \
+      "$TASK5_LEDGER_CHAIN_ROOT/$ordinal_name.identity" || return 1
+    ordinal=$((ordinal + 1))
+  done
+  cmp -s "$ledger_package_root/ledger-chain/genesis.identity" \
+    "$TASK5_LEDGER_CHAIN_ROOT/genesis.identity" || return 1
+)

+task5_require_external_review_tuple() (
+  set -euo pipefail
+  export LC_ALL=C
+  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
+  review_checkpoint="$1"
+  review_package_sha="$2"
+  spec_response_sha="$3"
+  quality_response_sha="$4"
+  task5_require_review_tuple_shape "$review_checkpoint" \
+    "$review_package_sha" "$spec_response_sha" \
+    "$quality_response_sha" || return 1
+  if test "$review_checkpoint" = ABSENT; then
+    return 0
+  fi
+  if test "$review_checkpoint" = P5R1; then
+    authority_receipt="$TASK5_AUTHORITY_BUNDLE_ROOT/authority.receipt"
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
+      review-package-sha256)" = "$review_package_sha" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
+      spec-response-sha256)" = "$spec_response_sha" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$authority_receipt" \
+      quality-response-sha256)" = "$quality_response_sha" || return 1
+    return 0
+  fi
+  package_root="$TASK5_REVIEW_PACKAGES_ROOT/$review_checkpoint"
+  package_identity="$package_root/checkpoint.identity"
+  task5_require_review_package_ledger_prefix "$package_root" \
+    "$review_package_sha" || return 1
+  task5_require_owned_regular "$package_identity" 400 || return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$package_identity" checkpoint)" = \
+    "$review_checkpoint" || return 1
+  implementation_actor_reference="$(task5_receipt_value \
+    "$package_identity" implementation-actor-reference)" || return 1
+  spec_reviewer_reference="$(task5_receipt_value "$package_identity" \
+    spec-reviewer-reference)" || return 1
+  quality_reviewer_reference="$(task5_receipt_value "$package_identity" \
+    quality-reviewer-reference)" || return 1
+  test "$implementation_actor_reference" = \
+    "$TASK5_IMPLEMENTATION_ACTOR_REFERENCE" || return 1
+  task5_require_independent_reviewer_references \
+    "$implementation_actor_reference" "$spec_reviewer_reference" \
+    "$quality_reviewer_reference" || return 1
+  response_root="$TASK5_REVIEW_RESPONSES_ROOT/$review_checkpoint"
+  if test "$quality_response_sha" = ABSENT; then
+    task5_require_owned_directory "$response_root" 700 || return 1
+  else
+    task5_require_owned_directory "$response_root" 500 || return 1
+  fi
+  spec_response="$response_root/spec.response.md"
+  spec_identity="$response_root/spec.identity"
+  task5_require_owned_regular "$spec_response" 400 || return 1
+  task5_require_owned_regular "$spec_identity" 400 || return 1
+  test "$(task5_sha256 "$spec_response")" = "$spec_response_sha" || \
+    return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$spec_identity" checkpoint)" = \
+    "$review_checkpoint" || return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$spec_identity" lane)" = spec || return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$spec_identity" package-sha256)" = \
+    "$review_package_sha" || return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$spec_identity" response-sha256)" = \
+    "$spec_response_sha" || return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$spec_identity" reviewer-reference)" = \
+    "$spec_reviewer_reference" || return 1
+  test "$(task5_receipt_value "$spec_identity" \
+    implementation-actor-reference)" = \
+    "$implementation_actor_reference" || return 1
+  if test "$quality_response_sha" = ABSENT; then
+    task5_require_absent_path "$response_root/quality.response.md" || return 1
+    task5_require_absent_path "$response_root/quality.identity" || return 1
+  else
+    quality_response="$response_root/quality.response.md"
+    quality_identity="$response_root/quality.identity"
+    task5_require_owned_regular "$quality_response" 400 || return 1
+    task5_require_owned_regular "$quality_identity" 400 || return 1
+    test "$(task5_sha256 "$quality_response")" = \
+      "$quality_response_sha" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$quality_identity" checkpoint)" = \
+      "$review_checkpoint" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$quality_identity" lane)" = quality || \
+      return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$quality_identity" package-sha256)" = \
+      "$review_package_sha" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$quality_identity" response-sha256)" = \
+      "$quality_response_sha" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$quality_identity" \
+      reviewer-reference)" = "$quality_reviewer_reference" || return 1
+    test "$(task5_receipt_value "$quality_identity" \
+      implementation-actor-reference)" = \
+      "$implementation_actor_reference" || return 1

+task5_require_current_ledger_prefix() (
+  set -euo pipefail
+  export LC_ALL=C
+  test "$#" = 0 || return 1
+  test "${TASK5_LEDGER_CHAIN_ROOT-}" = \
+    "$TASK5_EVIDENCE_ROOT/ledger-chain" || return 1
+  task5_require_sha256 "${TASK5_LEDGER_CHAIN_BEFORE-}" || return 1
+  task5_require_sha256 \
+    "${TASK5_LEDGER_PREVIOUS_MANIFEST_SHA256-}" || return 1
+  task5_require_review_tuple_shape \
+    "${TASK5_ACCEPTED_REVIEW_CHECKPOINT-}" \
+    "${TASK5_ACCEPTED_REVIEW_PACKAGE_SHA256-}" \
+    "${TASK5_ACCEPTED_SPEC_RESPONSE_SHA256-}" \
+    "${TASK5_ACCEPTED_QUALITY_RESPONSE_SHA256-}" || return 1
+  action_entry="${TASK5_ACTION_DIR%/artifacts}"
+  test "$TASK5_ACTION_DIR" = "$action_entry/artifacts" || return 1
+  test "${action_entry%/*}" = "$TASK5_COMMANDS_ROOT" || return 1
+  active_entry_name="${action_entry##*/}"
+  case "$active_entry_name" in
+    [0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]) ;;
+    *) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  active_ordinal="$((10#$active_entry_name))"
+  test "$active_ordinal" -gt 0 || return 1
+  prefix_count="$((active_ordinal - 1))"
+  task5_require_ledger_prefix_tree \
+    "$TASK5_COMMANDS_ROOT" 700 "$TASK5_LEDGER_CHAIN_ROOT" 700 \
+    "$prefix_count" "$active_entry_name" "$TASK5_LEDGER_CHAIN_BEFORE" \
+    "$TASK5_LEDGER_PREVIOUS_MANIFEST_SHA256" \
+    "$TASK5_ACCEPTED_REVIEW_CHECKPOINT" \
+    "$TASK5_ACCEPTED_REVIEW_PACKAGE_SHA256" \
+    "$TASK5_ACCEPTED_SPEC_RESPONSE_SHA256" \
+    "$TASK5_ACCEPTED_QUALITY_RESPONSE_SHA256" || return 1
+  task5_require_external_review_tuple \
+    "$TASK5_ACCEPTED_REVIEW_CHECKPOINT" \
+    "$TASK5_ACCEPTED_REVIEW_PACKAGE_SHA256" \
+    "$TASK5_ACCEPTED_SPEC_RESPONSE_SHA256" \
+    "$TASK5_ACCEPTED_QUALITY_RESPONSE_SHA256" || return 1

+    task5_fail "$compiler_red_checkpoint RED contains a forbidden diagnostic"

+  fi

+task5_require_report_p0_provenance_file() (
+  set -euo pipefail
+  set -f
+  export LC_ALL=C
+  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
+  record_path="$1"
+  task5_require_owned_regular "$record_path" 400 || return 1
+  task5_require_exact_lf_rows "$record_path" 3 || return 1
+  p0_header="$(sed -n '1p' "$record_path")" || return 1

+  set -- $p0_header
+  test "$#" = 15 || return 1
+  test "$1" = P0-PROVENANCE || return 1
+  p0_value="${2#P0=}"
+  plan_sha_value="${3#plan-sha256=}"
+  package_sha_value="${4#review-package-sha256=}"
+  authority_sha_value="${5#original-authority-manifest-sha256=}"
+  approval_text_sha_value="${6#approval-text-sha256=}"
+  approval_reference_sha_value="${7#approval-reference-sha256=}"
+  approval_text_bytes_value="${8#approval-text-bytes=}"
+  approval_reference_bytes_value="${9#approval-reference-bytes=}"
+  actor_reference_value="${10#implementation-actor-reference=}"
+  spec_reference_value="${11#spec-reviewer-reference=}"
+  quality_reference_value="${12#quality-reviewer-reference=}"
+  approval_text_hex_value="${13#approval-text-hex=}"
+  approval_reference_hex_value="${14#approval-reference-hex=}"
+  recovery_amendment_value="${15#recovery-amendment=}"
+  test "$2" = "P0=$p0_value" || return 1
+  test "$3" = "plan-sha256=$plan_sha_value" || return 1
+  test "$4" = "review-package-sha256=$package_sha_value" || return 1
+  test "$5" = \
+    "original-authority-manifest-sha256=$authority_sha_value" || return 1
+  test "$6" = "approval-text-sha256=$approval_text_sha_value" || return 1
+  test "$7" = \
+    "approval-reference-sha256=$approval_reference_sha_value" || return 1
+  test "$8" = "approval-text-bytes=$approval_text_bytes_value" || return 1
+  test "$9" = \
+    "approval-reference-bytes=$approval_reference_bytes_value" || return 1
+  test "${10}" = \
+    "implementation-actor-reference=$actor_reference_value" || return 1
+  test "${11}" = "spec-reviewer-reference=$spec_reference_value" || return 1
+  test "${12}" = \
+    "quality-reviewer-reference=$quality_reference_value" || return 1
+  test "${13}" = "approval-text-hex=$approval_text_hex_value" || return 1
+  test "${14}" = \
+    "approval-reference-hex=$approval_reference_hex_value" || return 1
+  test "${15}" = \
+    "recovery-amendment=$recovery_amendment_value" || return 1
+  test "$recovery_amendment_value" = U-T5R1-UNIFIED-OUTPUT-01 || return 1
+  test "$p0_value" = 13305954d2b6a42a02ef0eae4aa6843a2f18c46e || \
+    return 1
+  test "$plan_sha_value" = \
+    af1b536f268f11bfe9abaf2a30fe49fcfe06bbc225df774c49a6b443515650a3 || \
+    return 1
+  for provenance_sha in "$package_sha_value" "$authority_sha_value" \

+    task5_require_sha256 "$provenance_sha" || return 1
+  done
+  test "$authority_sha_value" = "${TASK5_ORIGINAL_AUTHORITY_SHA256-}" || \
+    return 1
+  case "$approval_text_bytes_value:$approval_reference_bytes_value" in
+    *[!0123456789:]*|*:*:*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "$approval_text_bytes_value" -gt 0 || return 1
+  test "$approval_reference_bytes_value" -gt 0 || return 1
+  task5_require_independent_reviewer_references "$actor_reference_value" \
+    "$spec_reference_value" "$quality_reference_value" || return 1
+  case "$approval_text_hex_value$approval_reference_hex_value" in
+    ''|*[!0123456789abcdef]*) return 1 ;;
+  esac
+  test "${#approval_text_hex_value}" = \
+    "$((approval_text_bytes_value * 2))" || return 1
+  test "${#approval_reference_hex_value}" = \
+    "$((approval_reference_bytes_value * 2))" || return 1
+  provenance_count=0
+  provenance_rows="$(sed -n '2,3p' "$record_path")" || return 1
+  parsed_provenance_rows=0
+  while IFS=' ' read -r record_label \
+      lane_field package_field response_field identity_field \
+      response_bytes_field identity_bytes_field response_hex_field \
+      identity_hex_field extra_field; do
+    test "$record_label" = P0-REVIEW-RESPONSE-HEX || return 1
+    test -z "$extra_field" || return 1
+    lane_value="${lane_field#lane=}"
+    package_value="${package_field#package-sha256=}"
+    response_value="${response_field#response-sha256=}"
+    identity_value="${identity_field#identity-sha256=}"
+    response_bytes_value="${response_bytes_field#response-bytes=}"
+    identity_bytes_value="${identity_bytes_field#identity-bytes=}"
+    response_hex_value="${response_hex_field#response-hex=}"
+    identity_hex_value="${identity_hex_field#identity-hex=}"
+    test "$lane_field" = "lane=$lane_value" || return 1
+    test "$package_field" = "package-sha256=$package_value" || return 1
+    test "$response_field" = "response-sha256=$response_value" || return 1
+    test "$identity_field" = "identity-sha256=$identity_value" || return 1
+    test "$response_bytes_field" = \
+      "response-bytes=$response_bytes_value" || return 1
+    test "$identity_bytes_field" = \
+      "identity-bytes=$identity_bytes_value" || return 1
+    test "$response_hex_field" = \
+      "response-hex=$response_hex_value" || return 1
+    test "$identity_hex_field" = \
+      "identity-hex=$identity_hex_value" || return 1
+    case "$lane_value" in spec|quality) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
+    test "$package_value" = "$package_sha_value" || return 1
+    task5_require_sha256 "$response_value" || return 1
+    task5_require_sha256 "$identity_value" || return 1
+    case "$response_bytes_value:$identity_bytes_value" in
+      *[!0123456789:]*|*:*:*) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    test "$response_bytes_value" -gt 0 || return 1
+    test "$identity_bytes_value" -gt 0 || return 1
+    case "$response_hex_value$identity_hex_value" in
+      ''|*[!0123456789abcdef]*) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+    test "${#response_hex_value}" = \
+      "$((response_bytes_value * 2))" || return 1
+    test "${#identity_hex_value}" = \
+      "$((identity_bytes_value * 2))" || return 1
+    parsed_provenance_rows=$((parsed_provenance_rows + 1))
+  done <<< "$provenance_rows" || return 1
+  test "$parsed_provenance_rows" = 2 || return 1
+  for provenance_lane in spec quality; do
+    task5_require_extended_grep_count "$record_path" \
+      "^P0-REVIEW-RESPONSE-HEX lane=$provenance_lane " 1 || return 1
+    provenance_count=$((provenance_count + 1))
+  done
+  test "$provenance_count" = 2 || return 1
+)
~~~

# Task 5 recovery detached prelaunch gate — exact schema handoff

This handoff is plan-authoring input. It authorizes only the build-free,
test-free, probe-free structural checker. It does not authorize the recovery
bootstrap, controller, or Task 5 implementation.

All structured files are ASCII, NUL-free, CR-free, LF-terminated, and use the
exact key order shown. Unknown or duplicate keys are invalid. `<h>` is exactly
64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, `<oid>` is exactly 40 lowercase
hexadecimal characters, and `<n>` is an unsigned decimal integer.

## 1. Mode-neutral source package

The immutable package contains exactly these nine source paths:

```text
source/bootstrap.delta
source/bootstrap.sh
source/checker.delta
source/checker.sh
source/derivation.manifest
source/launcher.sh
source/plan.md
source/runtime.delta
source/runtime.sh
```

`source.manifest.sha256` contains exactly nine headerless, C-sorted rows:

```text
<h>  source/bootstrap.delta
<h>  source/bootstrap.sh
<h>  source/checker.delta
<h>  source/checker.sh
<h>  source/derivation.manifest
<h>  source/launcher.sh
<h>  source/plan.md
<h>  source/runtime.delta
<h>  source/runtime.sh
```

The root and directories are canonical, owner-matched, nonsymlink, mode 0500.
Every file is canonical, owner-matched, regular, nonsymlink, nlink 1, mode
0400. The source package contains no P5R1 OID and no receipt hash.

Bundle locations are closed. Candidate mode permits only
`/private/tmp/ssr-task5-prelaunch-candidate.<safe-suffix>`. Committed mode
permits only `/private/tmp/ssr-task5-prelaunch-committed.<safe-suffix>` or the
exact imported path
`/private/tmp/ssr-task5-recovery-evidence.<safe-suffix>/authority-bundle/prelaunch-committed`.
Each safe suffix is nonempty, contains only ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_`,
or `-`, and contains no `..`. External bundle roots have physical parent
`/private/tmp`. The imported root has the exact fixed tail shown; its active
evidence root is owner-matched mode 0700 and its `authority-bundle` parent is
owner-matched mode 0500. Every other location is invalid.

`verifier.command` is a tenth reviewed file outside `source/`; both reviewer
lanes receive identical bytes for it and its SHA is bound everywhere below.

## 11. Predecessor verifier requirements

`verifier.command` is a complete tiny Bash program inspected by both lanes. It:

1. validates clean environment and exact candidate/committed argument schema;
2. validates the exact mode-specific closed bundle location above, canonical
   bundle/source paths, owner, modes, nonsymlink status, file nlink 1, and a
   closed bundle topology;
3. hashes `root.receipt.sha256` against the external pin;
4. from the bundle root runs exact checks of `root.receipt.sha256`,
   `bundle.manifest.sha256`, and `source.manifest.sha256` with absolute
   `/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 -c`;
5. validates the exact receipt/review/identity schemas and decisions;
6. candidate mode immediately byte-compares `source/plan.md` with the live
   plan; committed mode uses replacement-disabled, lazy-fetch-disabled
   raw-object semantics, rejects a shallow repository, legacy grafts, and
   `refs/replace`, and requires `binding/P5R1` to name an object whose raw type
   is exactly `commit`. Every Git invocation uses both global options
   `--no-replace-objects` and `--no-lazy-fetch`, so a missing promised object
   fails closed without network access or object-store mutation. The verifier
   recomputes the raw commit object hash; counts every raw `tree ` and `parent `
   header before validating its value; rejects any such value that is not
   exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters; requires exactly one raw tree
   and exactly one raw parent equal to D5R1; recomputes the referenced raw tree
   and blob hashes; resolves the exact mode-100644 plan blob from the raw tree;
   byte-compares the raw blob with `source/plan.md`; and hash/byte-compares the
   candidate-core bindings;
7. repeats all source-manifest checks and critical stat/cmp latches immediately
   before exec; and
8. execs the exact inner checker command shown below.

The predecessor invocation is exactly:

```text
/usr/bin/env -i \
  PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin LC_ALL=C LANG=C \
  HOME=/private/tmp TMPDIR=/private/tmp \
  GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 \
  /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "$prelaunch_verifier" \
  <candidate-or-committed arguments>
```

Its final candidate exec tail is exactly:

```text
exec /usr/bin/env -i \
  PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin LC_ALL=C LANG=C \
  HOME=/private/tmp TMPDIR=/private/tmp \
  GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 \
  /bin/bash --noprofile --norc "$candidate_checker" candidate "$plan_path"
```

Its committed tail is the existing committed checker env-i command verbatim.

Non-shell coordination must not blindly source the bundle copy of
`verifier.command`. It separately preserves the reviewed verifier bytes/hash,
uses absolute `/usr/bin/cmp` and `/usr/bin/shasum` to compare them with the
bundle copy, then passes the preserved canonical verifier path to `/bin/bash`.

## 12. Explicit trust and TOCTOU boundary

The prelaunch claim assumes SHA-256 collision/preimage resistance; trusted
kernel and absolute OS tools; trusted non-shell coordination carrying the
external root pin and preserved verifier bytes; independent reviewer judgment;
and no malicious same-UID/root concurrent writer between final hash/cmp and
exec. Modes and nlink reduce accidents but do not defeat a malicious same-UID
writer. The checker early/final byte comparisons are secondary latches and do
not retroactively authenticate commands already executed.

## 13. Required ordering and plan/checker amendments

R0 ordering is exact: materialize all nine final source files and verifier;
freeze source package; obtain both read-only reviews; seal candidate bundle and
external root pin; run predecessor; run candidate checker; seal the 11-line
launch identity.

R1 after committing unchanged plan bytes: construct committed binding bundle;
prove all reviewed bytes identical; seal committed external root pin; run the
same predecessor in committed mode.

R2: copy both prelaunch bundles, the separately preserved verifier, and both
launch identities by value into the later formal P5R1 review package at the
exact relative paths `prelaunch-candidate/`, `prelaunch-committed/`,
`prelaunch-verifier.command`, `prelaunch-candidate-launch.identity`, and
`prelaunch-committed-launch.identity`. They are provenance only. Fresh formal
P5R1 reviews, exact user approval, authority bundle, postapproval launch, and
first `recovery-postcommit` action remain mandatory and unchanged.

Any source or verifier edit invalidates both source-review responses and the
candidate bundle. Prelaunch receipt hashes stay outside the plan-dependent core
so candidate and committed core bytes remain identical. No controller ordinal
and no `/private/tmp/ssr-task5-recovery-evidence.*` namespace is added.

## 14. Downstream formal authority integration

The later recovery authority receipt grows from 25 to exactly 32 ordered
fields. Preserve its existing first 25 fields. Immediately after its existing
`amendment` field append exactly:

```text
prelaunch-verifier-command-sha256=<h>
candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256=<h>
candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256=<h>
candidate-launch-identity-sha256=<h>
committed-root-receipt-file-sha256=<h>
committed-bundle-manifest-sha256=<h>
committed-launch-identity-sha256=<h>
```

The root-receipt fields are hashes of the complete one-line
`root.receipt.sha256` files, not the bundle-manifest values written inside
those files. The formal authority imports both complete prelaunch bundles,
both external 11-line launch identities, and a separately preserved verifier.
It contains exact top-level execution copies at `prelaunch-candidate/`,
`prelaunch-committed/`, `prelaunch-verifier.command`,
`prelaunch-candidate-launch.identity`, and
`prelaunch-committed-launch.identity`, in addition to the corresponding nested
copies inside `P5R1-review-package/`. Every corresponding object is a distinct
inode, never a symlink or hard link, and byte-identical to its reviewed nested
copy. The formal review-package recursive manifest seals the nested copies;
the outer authority manifest and the seven appended receipt fields seal the
top-level copies. Bootstrap verifies both manifest closures before allocation,
byte-compares every corresponding authenticated file, requires distinct
inodes, and then connects the seven receipt hashes to the top-level execution
copies. The existing 20-line P5R1 `package.identity` schema does not grow: its
package-manifest binding plus these byte comparisons provide the transitive
review-to-execution bridge without duplicating the seven authority fields.
It requires the imported committed
`binding/candidate-core.manifest` to byte-equal the formal P5R1 review core and
to match `core-manifest-sha256`. The candidate and committed launch-identity
`checker-audit-identity-sha256` values must equal the hashes of the formal
candidate and committed audit identities respectively.

Only four prelaunch values enter the clean controller environment, all
readonly: verifier path, verifier SHA-256, exact imported committed bundle root
`$active/authority-bundle/prelaunch-committed`, and committed root-receipt file
SHA-256. Ordinal 1 retains public arity 3 and invokes the verifier's exact
three-argument committed interface. It contains no direct checker launch,
fallback, retry, `eval`, or indirect expansion. The existing five-line
`recovery-postcommit.audit-binding` remains unchanged because the verifier's
final operation is `exec` of the same committed checker interface.
<!-- TASK5R1-PRELAUNCH-SCHEMA-CORPUS-END -->

<!-- TASK5R1-PRELAUNCH-VERIFIER-BEGIN -->
```bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077

test -z "${BASH_ENV+x}"
test -z "${ENV+x}"
prelaunch_initial_function_bytes="$({ set -o pipefail; declare -F | \
  /usr/bin/wc -c | /usr/bin/tr -d '[:space:]'; })"
prelaunch_initial_alias_bytes="$({ set -o pipefail; alias -p | \
  /usr/bin/wc -c | /usr/bin/tr -d '[:space:]'; })"
case "$prelaunch_initial_function_bytes:$prelaunch_initial_alias_bytes" in
  *[!0123456789:]*) exit 1 ;;
esac
test "$prelaunch_initial_function_bytes" = 0
test "$prelaunch_initial_alias_bytes" = 0
test "${PATH-}" = /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
test "${LC_ALL-}" = C
test "${LANG-}" = C
test "${HOME-}" = /private/tmp
test "${TMPDIR-}" = /private/tmp
test "${GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM-}" = 1
test "${GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL-}" = /dev/null
test "${GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT-}" = 0
prelaunch_initial_environment_names="$({ set -o pipefail; /usr/bin/env | \
  /usr/bin/cut -d= -f1 | /usr/bin/sort; })"
test "$prelaunch_initial_environment_names" = \
'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL
GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT
HOME
LANG
LC_ALL
PATH
PWD
SHLVL
TMPDIR
_'

case "${1-}:$#" in
  candidate:3) prelaunch_mode=candidate ;;
  committed:3) prelaunch_mode=committed ;;
  *) exit 64 ;;
esac
prelaunch_bundle_root="$2"
prelaunch_external_root_receipt_sha256="$3"

prelaunch_fail() {
  printf 'Task 5 prelaunch verification failure: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

prelaunch_require_decimal() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  case "$1" in
    ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_sha256() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  test "${#1}" = 64 || return 1
  case "$1" in
    *[!0123456789abcdef]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_oid() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  test "${#1}" = 40 || return 1
  case "$1" in
    *[!0123456789abcdef]*) return 1 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

prelaunch_sha256() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  prelaunch_sha_output="$({ set -o pipefail; \
    /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 "$1" | \
    /usr/bin/awk 'NF == 2 {print $1; rows++} END {if (rows != 1) exit 1}'; \
  })" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_sha256 "$prelaunch_sha_output" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$prelaunch_sha_output" || return 1
}

prelaunch_line_count() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  prelaunch_count_output="$({ set -o pipefail; /usr/bin/wc -l < "$1" | \
    /usr/bin/tr -d '[:space:]'; })" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_count_output" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$prelaunch_count_output" || return 1
}

prelaunch_byte_count() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  prelaunch_count_output="$({ set -o pipefail; /usr/bin/wc -c < "$1" | \
    /usr/bin/tr -d '[:space:]'; })" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_count_output" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$prelaunch_count_output" || return 1
}

prelaunch_require_owned_directory() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  prelaunch_directory_path="$1"
  prelaunch_directory_expected_mode="$2"
  test -d "$prelaunch_directory_path" || return 1
  test ! -L "$prelaunch_directory_path" || return 1
  prelaunch_directory_owner="$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%u' \
    "$prelaunch_directory_path")" || return 1
  prelaunch_directory_mode="$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' \
    "$prelaunch_directory_path")" || return 1
  prelaunch_current_owner="$(/usr/bin/id -u)" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_directory_owner" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_directory_mode" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_current_owner" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_directory_owner" = "$prelaunch_current_owner" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_directory_mode" = \
    "$prelaunch_directory_expected_mode" || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_owned_file() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  prelaunch_file_path="$1"
  prelaunch_file_expected_mode="$2"
  test -f "$prelaunch_file_path" || return 1
  test ! -L "$prelaunch_file_path" || return 1
  prelaunch_file_owner="$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%u' \
    "$prelaunch_file_path")" || return 1
  prelaunch_file_mode="$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' \
    "$prelaunch_file_path")" || return 1
  prelaunch_file_links="$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%l' \
    "$prelaunch_file_path")" || return 1
  prelaunch_current_owner="$(/usr/bin/id -u)" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_file_owner" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_file_mode" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_file_links" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_current_owner" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_file_owner" = "$prelaunch_current_owner" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_file_mode" = "$prelaunch_file_expected_mode" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_file_links" = 1 || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_text_file() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_owned_file "$1" 400 || return 1
  prelaunch_text_nul_state="$({ set -o pipefail; \
    /usr/bin/od -An -tu1 -v "$1" | /usr/bin/awk '
      {
        for (field = 1; field <= NF; field++)
          if ($field == 0 || $field > 127) found = 1
      }
      END {print found ? "NONASCII" : "SAFE"}
    '; })" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_text_nul_state" = SAFE || return 1
  prelaunch_text_cr_count="$(/usr/bin/awk '
    index($0, sprintf("%c", 13)) {rows++}
    END {print rows + 0}
  ' "$1")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_text_cr_count" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_text_cr_count" = 0 || return 1
  prelaunch_text_last_byte="$({ set -o pipefail; \
    /usr/bin/tail -c 1 "$1" | /usr/bin/od -An -tu1 | \
    /usr/bin/tr -d '[:space:]'; })" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_text_last_byte" = 10 || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_canonical_path() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  case "$1" in
    /*/*) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  prelaunch_path_parent="${1%/*}"
  prelaunch_path_basename="${1##*/}"
  test -n "$prelaunch_path_basename" || return 1
  prelaunch_path_physical_parent="$(cd "$prelaunch_path_parent" && \
    /bin/pwd -P)" || return 1
  test "$1" = \
    "$prelaunch_path_physical_parent/$prelaunch_path_basename" || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_safe_suffix() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  case "$1" in
    ''|*..*|*[!0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._-]*) \
      return 1 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_bundle_location() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  prelaunch_location_mode="$1"
  prelaunch_location_root="$2"
  case "$prelaunch_location_mode" in
    candidate)
      case "$prelaunch_location_root" in
        /private/tmp/ssr-task5-prelaunch-candidate.*)
          prelaunch_location_suffix="${prelaunch_location_root#/private/tmp/ssr-task5-prelaunch-candidate.}"
          prelaunch_require_safe_suffix "$prelaunch_location_suffix" || return 1
          test "${prelaunch_location_root%/*}" = /private/tmp || return 1
          ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
      esac
      ;;
    committed)
      case "$prelaunch_location_root" in
        /private/tmp/ssr-task5-prelaunch-committed.*)
          prelaunch_location_suffix="${prelaunch_location_root#/private/tmp/ssr-task5-prelaunch-committed.}"
          prelaunch_require_safe_suffix "$prelaunch_location_suffix" || return 1
          test "${prelaunch_location_root%/*}" = /private/tmp || return 1
          ;;
        /private/tmp/ssr-task5-recovery-evidence.*/authority-bundle/prelaunch-committed)
          prelaunch_location_active="${prelaunch_location_root%/authority-bundle/prelaunch-committed}"
          prelaunch_location_suffix="${prelaunch_location_active#/private/tmp/ssr-task5-recovery-evidence.}"
          prelaunch_require_safe_suffix "$prelaunch_location_suffix" || return 1
          prelaunch_require_owned_directory "$prelaunch_location_active" 700 || \
            return 1
          prelaunch_require_owned_directory \
            "$prelaunch_location_active/authority-bundle" 500 || return 1
          ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
      esac
      ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_schema() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  prelaunch_schema_file="$1"
  prelaunch_schema_lines="$2"
  prelaunch_schema_keys="$3"
  prelaunch_require_text_file "$prelaunch_schema_file" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_schema_lines" || return 1
  prelaunch_schema_state="$(/usr/bin/awk -v expected="$prelaunch_schema_keys" \
      -v expected_lines="$prelaunch_schema_lines" '
    BEGIN {key_count = split(expected, keys, "[|]")}
    {
      separator = index($0, "=")
      if (separator < 2) bad = 1
      key = substr($0, 1, separator - 1)
      if (NR > key_count || key != keys[NR] || seen[key]++) bad = 1
    }
    END {
      if (NR != expected_lines || key_count != expected_lines) bad = 1
      print bad ? "INVALID" : "VALID"
    }
  ' "$prelaunch_schema_file")" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_schema_state" = VALID || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_receipt_value() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  prelaunch_value_output="$(/usr/bin/awk -v key="$2" '
    index($0, "=") > 1 && substr($0, 1, index($0, "=") - 1) == key {
      print substr($0, index($0, "=") + 1)
      rows++
    }
    END {if (rows != 1) exit 1}
  ' "$1")" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$prelaunch_value_output" || return 1
}

prelaunch_require_value() {
  test "$#" = 3 || return 1
  prelaunch_required_value="$(prelaunch_receipt_value "$1" "$2")" || \
    return 1
  test "$prelaunch_required_value" = "$3" || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_reference() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  test -n "$1" || return 1
  case "$1" in
    *[!0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz._:/-]*) \
      return 1 ;;
  esac
  prelaunch_reference_state="$({ set -o pipefail; \
    printf '%s\n' "$1" | /usr/bin/awk '
    {
      lower = tolower($0)
      if (lower ~ /(^|[^a-z0-9])r([^a-z0-9]|$)/) found = 1
    }
    END {print found ? "UNSAFE" : "SAFE"}
  '; })" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_reference_state" = SAFE || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_require_manifest_rows() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  prelaunch_manifest_file="$1"
  prelaunch_manifest_paths="$2"
  prelaunch_require_text_file "$prelaunch_manifest_file" || return 1
  prelaunch_manifest_state="$(/usr/bin/awk -v expected="$prelaunch_manifest_paths" '
    BEGIN {path_count = split(expected, paths, "[|]")}
    {
      if (NR > path_count || length($0) != 66 + length(paths[NR]) ||
          substr($0, 65, 2) != "  " ||
          substr($0, 67) != paths[NR]) bad = 1
      digest = substr($0, 1, 64)
      if (length(digest) != 64 || digest ~ /[^0-9a-f]/) bad = 1
    }
    END {
      if (NR != path_count) bad = 1
      print bad ? "INVALID" : "VALID"
    }
  ' "$prelaunch_manifest_file")" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_manifest_state" = VALID || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_manifest_digest() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  prelaunch_manifest_digest_value="$(/usr/bin/awk -v path="$2" '
    length($0) >= 67 && substr($0, 67) == path {
      print substr($0, 1, 64)
      rows++
    }
    END {if (rows != 1) exit 1}
  ' "$1")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_sha256 "$prelaunch_manifest_digest_value" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$prelaunch_manifest_digest_value" || return 1
}

prelaunch_run_manifest_check() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  (
    cd "$1" || exit 1
    /usr/bin/shasum -a 256 -c "$2" >/dev/null
  ) || return 1
  return 0
}
```
