prelaunch_validate_topology() {
  test "$#" = 1 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_canonical_path "$prelaunch_bundle_root" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_bundle_location "$1" "$prelaunch_bundle_root" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_owned_directory "$prelaunch_bundle_root" 500 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_owned_directory "$prelaunch_bundle_root/source" 500 || \
    return 1
  prelaunch_require_owned_directory "$prelaunch_bundle_root/reviews" 500 || \
    return 1
  if test "$1" = committed; then
    prelaunch_require_owned_directory "$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding" 500 || \
      return 1
    prelaunch_expected_topology="$prelaunch_committed_bundle_paths"
  else
    prelaunch_expected_topology="$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_paths"
  fi
  prelaunch_actual_topology="$({
    set -o pipefail
    cd "$prelaunch_bundle_root" && /usr/bin/find . -print | \
      LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/sort
  })" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_actual_topology" = "$prelaunch_expected_topology" || \
    return 1
  while IFS= read -r prelaunch_topology_path; do
    case "$prelaunch_topology_path" in
      .|./source|./reviews|./binding) ;;
      *) prelaunch_require_owned_file \
          "$prelaunch_bundle_root/${prelaunch_topology_path#./}" 400 || \
          return 1 ;;
    esac
  done <<TASK5R1_PRELAUNCH_TOPOLOGY
$prelaunch_expected_topology
TASK5R1_PRELAUNCH_TOPOLOGY
  return 0
}

prelaunch_validate_review_lane() {
  test "$#" = 4 || return 1
  prelaunch_lane="$1"
  prelaunch_lane_reference="$2"
  prelaunch_lane_source_sha="$3"
  prelaunch_lane_verifier_sha="$4"
  prelaunch_lane_assignment="$prelaunch_bundle_root/reviews/$prelaunch_lane.assignment"
  prelaunch_lane_response="$prelaunch_bundle_root/reviews/$prelaunch_lane.response"
  prelaunch_lane_identity="$prelaunch_bundle_root/reviews/$prelaunch_lane.response.identity"
  prelaunch_require_schema "$prelaunch_lane_assignment" 9 \
    "$prelaunch_assignment_keys" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_schema "$prelaunch_lane_response" 14 \
    "$prelaunch_response_keys" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_schema "$prelaunch_lane_identity" 9 \
    "$prelaunch_response_identity_keys" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_reference "$prelaunch_lane_reference" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_assignment" format \
    task5r1-prelaunch-source-assignment-v1 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_assignment" lane \
    "$prelaunch_lane" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_assignment" reviewer-reference \
    "$prelaunch_lane_reference" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_assignment" D5R1 \

  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_assignment" \

  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_assignment" \

    read-only-no-source-execution || return 1

  prelaunch_lane_assignment_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_lane_assignment")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" \

  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_response" format \

  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_response" source-manifest-sha256 \

  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_response" \
    checker-preauthentication-effects READ-ONLY-ONLY || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_response" \
    verifier-preexec-effects READ-ONLY-THEN-EXACT-CHECKER-EXEC || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_response" \
    forbidden-preapproval-effects ABSENT || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_response" verdict APPROVE || \
    return 1
  for prelaunch_lane_count_key in critical important minor; do
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_response" \
      "$prelaunch_lane_count_key" 0 || return 1
  done
  prelaunch_lane_response_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_lane_response")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" \
    "$prelaunch_lane-response-sha256" "$prelaunch_lane_response_sha" || \
    return 1

  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" format \
    task5r1-prelaunch-source-response-identity-v1 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" lane \
    "$prelaunch_lane" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" assignment-sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_lane_assignment_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" reviewer-reference \
    "$prelaunch_lane_reference" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" source-manifest-sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_lane_source_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" response-sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_lane_response_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" response-lines 14 || \
    return 1
  prelaunch_lane_response_bytes="$(prelaunch_byte_count \
    "$prelaunch_lane_response")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" response-bytes \
    "$prelaunch_lane_response_bytes" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_lane_identity" verdict APPROVE || \
    return 1
  prelaunch_lane_identity_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_lane_identity")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" \
    "$prelaunch_lane-response-identity-sha256" \
    "$prelaunch_lane_identity_sha" || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_validate_common_receipt() {
  test "$#" = 2 || return 1
  prelaunch_common_source_sha="$1"
  prelaunch_common_verifier_sha="$2"
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" D5R1 \
    bdecba6ece4a47db46f7398add21aa09c22e1057 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" plan-path \
    docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-10-task-5-bootstrap-recovery.md || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" source-manifest-sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_common_source_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" verifier-command-sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_common_verifier_sha" || return 1
  while IFS='|' read -r prelaunch_receipt_key prelaunch_source_relative; do
    prelaunch_source_digest="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
      "$prelaunch_bundle_root/source/$prelaunch_source_relative")" || return 1
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" "$prelaunch_receipt_key" \
      "$prelaunch_source_digest" || return 1
  done <<'TASK5R1_PRELAUNCH_SOURCE_RECEIPT_ROWS'
plan-sha256|plan.md
checker-sha256|checker.sh
bootstrap-sha256|bootstrap.sh
runtime-sha256|runtime.sh
launcher-sha256|launcher.sh
checker-delta-sha256|checker.delta
bootstrap-delta-sha256|bootstrap.delta
runtime-delta-sha256|runtime.delta
derivation-manifest-sha256|derivation.manifest
TASK5R1_PRELAUNCH_SOURCE_RECEIPT_ROWS
  prelaunch_protocol_reference="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
    "$prelaunch_receipt" protocol-reviewer-reference)" || return 1
  prelaunch_shell_reference="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
    "$prelaunch_receipt" shell-reviewer-reference)" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_reference "$prelaunch_protocol_reference" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_reference "$prelaunch_shell_reference" || return 1
  prelaunch_protocol_reference_folded="$({ set -o pipefail; printf '%s\n' \
    "$prelaunch_protocol_reference" | /usr/bin/tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'; })" || \
    return 1
  prelaunch_shell_reference_folded="$({ set -o pipefail; printf '%s\n' \
    "$prelaunch_shell_reference" | /usr/bin/tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'; })" || \
    return 1
  test "$prelaunch_protocol_reference_folded" != \
    "$prelaunch_shell_reference_folded" || return 1
  prelaunch_validate_review_lane protocol "$prelaunch_protocol_reference" \
    "$prelaunch_common_source_sha" "$prelaunch_common_verifier_sha" || \
    return 1
  prelaunch_validate_review_lane shell "$prelaunch_shell_reference" \
    "$prelaunch_common_source_sha" "$prelaunch_common_verifier_sha" || \
    return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_validate_candidate_bindings() {
  test "$#" = 0 || return 1
  prelaunch_candidate_root_receipt="$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/candidate-root.receipt.sha256"
  prelaunch_candidate_bundle_manifest="$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/candidate-bundle.manifest.sha256"
  prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity="$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/candidate-launch.identity"
  prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity="$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/candidate-audit.identity"
  prelaunch_candidate_core="$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/candidate-core.manifest"
  prelaunch_require_manifest_rows "$prelaunch_candidate_root_receipt" \
    bundle.manifest.sha256 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_manifest_rows "$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_manifest" \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_manifest_paths" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_schema "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" 11 \
    "$prelaunch_launch_identity_keys" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_schema "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity" 19 \
    "$prelaunch_audit_identity_keys" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_text_file "$prelaunch_candidate_core" || return 1

  prelaunch_candidate_bundle_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_manifest")" || return 1
  prelaunch_candidate_root_expected="$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_sha  bundle.manifest.sha256"
  prelaunch_candidate_root_actual="$(/bin/cat \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_root_receipt")" || return 1
  test "$prelaunch_candidate_root_actual" = \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_root_expected" || return 1
  prelaunch_candidate_root_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_root_receipt")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" \
    candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_root_sha" || \
    return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" \
    candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_sha" || \
    return 1
  for prelaunch_candidate_relative in \
      reviews/protocol.assignment reviews/protocol.response \
      reviews/protocol.response.identity reviews/shell.assignment \
      reviews/shell.response reviews/shell.response.identity \
      source.manifest.sha256 verifier.command; do
    prelaunch_candidate_expected_digest="$(prelaunch_manifest_digest \
      "$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_manifest" \
      "$prelaunch_candidate_relative")" || return 1
    prelaunch_candidate_actual_digest="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
      "$prelaunch_bundle_root/$prelaunch_candidate_relative")" || return 1
    test "$prelaunch_candidate_expected_digest" = \
      "$prelaunch_candidate_actual_digest" || return 1
  done

  prelaunch_candidate_launch_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity")" || return 1
  prelaunch_candidate_audit_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity")" || return 1
  prelaunch_candidate_core_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_core")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" \
    candidate-launch-identity-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_sha" || \
    return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" \
    candidate-audit-identity-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_sha" || \
    return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" \
    candidate-core-manifest-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_core_sha" || \
    return 1

  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" format \
    task5r1-prelaunch-checker-launch-v1 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" mode \
    candidate || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" \
    root-receipt-file-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_root_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" \
    bundle-manifest-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_sha" || return 1
  for prelaunch_launch_hash_key in source-manifest-sha256 \
      verifier-command-sha256 checker-sha256 checker-audit-identity-sha256 \
      checker-output-sha256; do
    prelaunch_launch_hash_value="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
      "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" \
      "$prelaunch_launch_hash_key")" || return 1
    prelaunch_require_sha256 "$prelaunch_launch_hash_value" || return 1
  done
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" \
    source-manifest-sha256 "$prelaunch_source_manifest_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" \
    verifier-command-sha256 "$prelaunch_verifier_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_checker_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
    "$prelaunch_bundle_root/source/checker.sh")" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" \
    checker-sha256 "$prelaunch_checker_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" \
    checker-audit-identity-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_sha" || return 1
  prelaunch_candidate_output_bytes="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
    "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" checker-output-bytes)" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_decimal "$prelaunch_candidate_output_bytes" || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_launch_identity" \
    exit-status 0 || return 1

  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity" format \
    task5-recovery-plan-audit-v1 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity" mode \
    candidate || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity" D5R1 \
    bdecba6ece4a47db46f7398add21aa09c22e1057 || return 1
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity" P5R1 \
    UNRESOLVED || return 1
  for prelaunch_audit_hash_key in plan-sha256 checker-sha256 \
      bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 derivation-manifest-sha256 \
      core-manifest-sha256 original-authority-manifest-sha256 \
      failure-package-manifest-sha256; do
    prelaunch_audit_hash_value="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
      "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity" \
      "$prelaunch_audit_hash_key")" || return 1
    prelaunch_require_sha256 "$prelaunch_audit_hash_value" || return 1
  done
  for prelaunch_audit_source_key in plan-sha256 checker-sha256 \
      bootstrap-sha256 runtime-sha256 derivation-manifest-sha256; do
    prelaunch_audit_source_value="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
      "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity" \
      "$prelaunch_audit_source_key")" || return 1
    prelaunch_receipt_source_value="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
      "$prelaunch_receipt" "$prelaunch_audit_source_key")" || return 1
    test "$prelaunch_audit_source_value" = \
      "$prelaunch_receipt_source_value" || return 1
  done
  prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_candidate_audit_identity" \
    core-manifest-sha256 "$prelaunch_candidate_core_sha" || return 1
  return 0
}

prelaunch_repo_root=/Users/jlsor/Documents/Research/SSR/.worktrees/ssr-oracle-passive-trace
prelaunch_plan_relative=docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-10-task-5-bootstrap-recovery.md
prelaunch_plan_path="$prelaunch_repo_root/$prelaunch_plan_relative"
test "$PWD" = "$prelaunch_repo_root" || prelaunch_fail 'unexpected working directory'
prelaunch_require_sha256 "$prelaunch_external_root_receipt_sha256" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'invalid external root receipt pin'
prelaunch_require_canonical_path "$0" || prelaunch_fail 'unsafe verifier path'
prelaunch_require_owned_file "$0" 400 || prelaunch_fail 'unsafe verifier file'
prelaunch_verifier_parent="${0%/*}"
prelaunch_require_owned_directory "$prelaunch_verifier_parent" 500 || \
  prelaunch_fail 'unsafe verifier parent'
prelaunch_validate_topology "$prelaunch_mode" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'bundle topology mismatch'

prelaunch_root_receipt="$prelaunch_bundle_root/root.receipt.sha256"
prelaunch_bundle_manifest="$prelaunch_bundle_root/bundle.manifest.sha256"
prelaunch_source_manifest="$prelaunch_bundle_root/source.manifest.sha256"
prelaunch_bundle_verifier="$prelaunch_bundle_root/verifier.command"
prelaunch_receipt="$prelaunch_bundle_root/prelaunch.receipt"
prelaunch_root_receipt_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
  "$prelaunch_root_receipt")" || prelaunch_fail 'root receipt hash failed'
test "$prelaunch_root_receipt_sha" = \
  "$prelaunch_external_root_receipt_sha256" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'external root receipt pin mismatch'
prelaunch_require_manifest_rows "$prelaunch_root_receipt" \
  bundle.manifest.sha256 || prelaunch_fail 'root receipt schema'

case "$prelaunch_mode" in
  candidate)
    prelaunch_bundle_manifest_paths="$prelaunch_candidate_bundle_manifest_paths"
    prelaunch_receipt_lines=25
    prelaunch_receipt_keys="$prelaunch_candidate_receipt_keys" ;;
  committed)
    prelaunch_bundle_manifest_paths="$prelaunch_committed_bundle_manifest_paths"
    prelaunch_receipt_lines=33
    prelaunch_receipt_keys="$prelaunch_committed_receipt_keys" ;;
esac
prelaunch_require_manifest_rows "$prelaunch_bundle_manifest" \
  "$prelaunch_bundle_manifest_paths" || prelaunch_fail 'bundle manifest schema'
prelaunch_require_manifest_rows "$prelaunch_source_manifest" \
  "$prelaunch_source_manifest_paths" || prelaunch_fail 'source manifest schema'
prelaunch_root_expected="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
  "$prelaunch_bundle_manifest")  bundle.manifest.sha256" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'bundle manifest hash failed'
prelaunch_root_actual="$(/bin/cat "$prelaunch_root_receipt")" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'root receipt read failed'
test "$prelaunch_root_actual" = "$prelaunch_root_expected" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'root receipt content mismatch'
prelaunch_run_manifest_check "$prelaunch_bundle_root" \
  root.receipt.sha256 || prelaunch_fail 'root receipt check failed'
prelaunch_run_manifest_check "$prelaunch_bundle_root" \
  bundle.manifest.sha256 || prelaunch_fail 'bundle manifest check failed'
prelaunch_run_manifest_check "$prelaunch_bundle_root" \
  source.manifest.sha256 || prelaunch_fail 'source manifest check failed'
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$0" "$prelaunch_bundle_verifier" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'preserved verifier differs from reviewed bundle copy'

prelaunch_require_schema "$prelaunch_receipt" "$prelaunch_receipt_lines" \
  "$prelaunch_receipt_keys" || prelaunch_fail 'prelaunch receipt schema'
prelaunch_source_manifest_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
  "$prelaunch_source_manifest")" || prelaunch_fail 'source manifest hash failed'
prelaunch_verifier_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \
  "$prelaunch_bundle_verifier")" || prelaunch_fail 'verifier hash failed'
prelaunch_validate_common_receipt "$prelaunch_source_manifest_sha" \
  "$prelaunch_verifier_sha" || prelaunch_fail 'source review binding mismatch'

case "$prelaunch_mode" in
  candidate)
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" format \
      task5r1-prelaunch-candidate-receipt-v1 || \
      prelaunch_fail 'candidate receipt format'
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" mode candidate || \
      prelaunch_fail 'candidate receipt mode'
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" P5R1 UNRESOLVED || \
      prelaunch_fail 'candidate receipt P5R1'
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" decision \
      APPROVE-CANDIDATE-CHECKER-ONLY || \
      prelaunch_fail 'candidate receipt decision'
    prelaunch_require_owned_file "$prelaunch_plan_path" 644 || \
      prelaunch_fail 'live candidate plan metadata'
    /usr/bin/cmp -s "$prelaunch_bundle_root/source/plan.md" \
      "$prelaunch_plan_path" || prelaunch_fail 'live candidate plan mismatch'
    ;;
  committed)
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" format \
      task5r1-prelaunch-committed-receipt-v1 || \
      prelaunch_fail 'committed receipt format'
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" mode committed || \
      prelaunch_fail 'committed receipt mode'
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" source-bytes-vs-candidate \
      IDENTICAL || prelaunch_fail 'candidate source equality decision'
    prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" decision \
      APPROVE-COMMITTED-CHECKER-ONLY || \
      prelaunch_fail 'committed receipt decision'
    prelaunch_P5R1="$(prelaunch_receipt_value "$prelaunch_receipt" P5R1)" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'committed P5R1 read failed'
    prelaunch_P5R1_tree="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
      "$prelaunch_receipt" P5R1-tree)" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'committed tree read failed'
    prelaunch_P5R1_plan_blob="$(prelaunch_receipt_value \
      "$prelaunch_receipt" P5R1-plan-blob)" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'committed blob read failed'
    prelaunch_require_oid "$prelaunch_P5R1" || prelaunch_fail 'invalid P5R1'
    prelaunch_require_oid "$prelaunch_P5R1_tree" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'invalid P5R1 tree'
    prelaunch_require_oid "$prelaunch_P5R1_plan_blob" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'invalid P5R1 plan blob'
    prelaunch_require_text_file "$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/P5R1" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'binding P5R1 text closure failed'
    prelaunch_binding_P5R1_lines="$(prelaunch_line_count \
      "$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/P5R1")" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'binding P5R1 line count failed'
    test "$prelaunch_binding_P5R1_lines" = 1 || \
      prelaunch_fail 'binding P5R1 line count mismatch'
    prelaunch_binding_P5R1="$(/bin/cat \
      "$prelaunch_bundle_root/binding/P5R1")" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'binding P5R1 read failed'
    test "$prelaunch_binding_P5R1" = "$prelaunch_P5R1" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'binding P5R1 mismatch'
    prelaunch_git_shallow="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
      -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'repository shallow-state lookup failed'
    test "$prelaunch_git_shallow" = false || \
      prelaunch_fail 'shallow repository is not an authorized source'
    prelaunch_git_common_token="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
      -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" rev-parse --git-common-dir)" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'Git common-directory lookup failed'
    case "$prelaunch_git_common_token" in
      /*) prelaunch_git_common="$prelaunch_git_common_token" ;;
      *) prelaunch_git_common="$(cd "$prelaunch_repo_root" && \
          cd "$prelaunch_git_common_token" && /bin/pwd -P)" || \
          prelaunch_fail 'Git common-directory resolution failed' ;;
    esac
    test ! -e "$prelaunch_git_common/info/grafts" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'legacy Git grafts are not authorized'
    test ! -L "$prelaunch_git_common/info/grafts" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'legacy Git graft link is not authorized'
    test ! -e "$prelaunch_git_common/shallow" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'Git shallow boundary is not authorized'
    test ! -L "$prelaunch_git_common/shallow" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'Git shallow-boundary link is not authorized'
    prelaunch_git_replace_refs="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
      -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' \
      refs/replace)" || prelaunch_fail 'replacement-ref lookup failed'
    test -z "$prelaunch_git_replace_refs" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'Git replacement refs are not authorized'
    prelaunch_git_object_type="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
      -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" cat-file -t "$prelaunch_P5R1")" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 object-type lookup failed'
    test "$prelaunch_git_object_type" = commit || \
      prelaunch_fail 'P5R1 does not name a raw commit object'
    prelaunch_git_commit_hash="$({ set -o pipefail; \
      /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" \
        cat-file commit "$prelaunch_P5R1" | \
      /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" \
        hash-object -t commit --stdin; })" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 commit hash failed'
    test "$prelaunch_git_commit_hash" = "$prelaunch_P5R1" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 bytes do not hash to binding OID'
    prelaunch_git_tree="$({ set -o pipefail; \
      /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" \
        cat-file commit "$prelaunch_P5R1" | \
      /usr/bin/awk \
        -v expected_parent=bdecba6ece4a47db46f7398add21aa09c22e1057 '
        !body && index($0, "tree ") == 1 {
          tree_count++
          candidate_tree = substr($0, 6)
          if (length(candidate_tree) != 40 ||
              candidate_tree ~ /[^0-9a-f]/) malformed = 1
          else tree = candidate_tree
          next
        }
        !body && index($0, "parent ") == 1 {
          parent_count++
          candidate_parent = substr($0, 8)
          if (length(candidate_parent) != 40 ||
              candidate_parent ~ /[^0-9a-f]/) malformed = 1
          else parent = candidate_parent
          next
        }
        !body && $0 == "" {body = 1; next}
        END {
          if (malformed || length(tree) != 40 || tree ~ /[^0-9a-f]/ ||
              tree_count != 1 || parent_count != 1 ||
              parent != expected_parent) exit 1
          print tree
        }
      '; })" || prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 header closure failed'
    test "$prelaunch_git_tree" = "$prelaunch_P5R1_tree" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'P5R1 tree mismatch'
    prelaunch_git_tree_hash="$({ set -o pipefail; \
      /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" \
        cat-file tree "$prelaunch_git_tree" | \
      /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" \
        hash-object -t tree --stdin; })" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 tree hash failed'
    test "$prelaunch_git_tree_hash" = "$prelaunch_git_tree" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 tree bytes do not hash to receipt OID'
    prelaunch_git_tree_row="$(/usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
      -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" ls-tree "$prelaunch_git_tree" -- \
      "$prelaunch_plan_relative")" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 plan tree lookup failed'
    prelaunch_git_blob="$({ set -o pipefail; \
      printf '%s\n' "$prelaunch_git_tree_row" | \
      /usr/bin/awk -v path="$prelaunch_plan_relative" '
        $1 == "100644" && $2 == "blob" && length($3) == 40 &&
        $3 !~ /[^0-9a-f]/ && $4 == path {print $3; rows++}
        END {if (rows != 1) exit 1}
      '; })" || prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 plan tree row is invalid'
    test "$prelaunch_git_blob" = "$prelaunch_P5R1_plan_blob" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'P5R1 plan blob mismatch'
    prelaunch_git_blob_hash="$({ set -o pipefail; \
      /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" \
        cat-file blob "$prelaunch_git_blob" | \
      /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" \
        hash-object -t blob --stdin; })" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'raw P5R1 plan blob hash failed'
    test "$prelaunch_git_blob_hash" = "$prelaunch_git_blob" || \
      prelaunch_fail 'raw plan bytes do not hash to receipt blob OID'
    (set -o pipefail; /usr/bin/git --no-replace-objects --no-lazy-fetch \
      -C "$prelaunch_repo_root" cat-file blob "$prelaunch_git_blob" | \
      /usr/bin/cmp -s - "$prelaunch_bundle_root/source/plan.md") || \
      prelaunch_fail 'committed plan differs from reviewed raw blob'
    prelaunch_validate_candidate_bindings || \
      prelaunch_fail 'candidate binding package mismatch'
    while IFS= read -r prelaunch_source_relative; do
      if /usr/bin/grep -F -- "$prelaunch_P5R1" \
          "$prelaunch_bundle_root/$prelaunch_source_relative" >/dev/null; then
        prelaunch_fail 'reviewed source prospectively embeds P5R1'
      else
        prelaunch_grep_status=$?
      fi
      test "$prelaunch_grep_status" = 1 || \
        prelaunch_fail 'P5R1 source scan failed'
    done <<TASK5R1_PRELAUNCH_SOURCE_SCAN
$prelaunch_source_paths
TASK5R1_PRELAUNCH_SOURCE_SCAN
    ;;
esac

# Final metadata, hash, and byte latches immediately before the exact exec.
prelaunch_validate_topology "$prelaunch_mode" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'final bundle topology mismatch'
prelaunch_final_root_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 "$prelaunch_root_receipt")" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'final root receipt hash failed'
test "$prelaunch_final_root_sha" = \
  "$prelaunch_external_root_receipt_sha256" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'final external root receipt mismatch'
prelaunch_run_manifest_check "$prelaunch_bundle_root" \
  root.receipt.sha256 || prelaunch_fail 'final root check failed'
prelaunch_run_manifest_check "$prelaunch_bundle_root" \
  bundle.manifest.sha256 || prelaunch_fail 'final bundle check failed'
prelaunch_run_manifest_check "$prelaunch_bundle_root" \
  source.manifest.sha256 || prelaunch_fail 'final source check failed'
prelaunch_require_owned_file "$0" 400 || \
  prelaunch_fail 'final preserved verifier metadata mismatch'
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$0" "$prelaunch_bundle_verifier" || \
  prelaunch_fail 'final preserved verifier byte mismatch'
prelaunch_candidate_checker="$prelaunch_bundle_root/source/checker.sh"
prelaunch_require_owned_file "$prelaunch_candidate_checker" 400 || \

prelaunch_checker_final_sha="$(prelaunch_sha256 \

prelaunch_require_value "$prelaunch_receipt" checker-sha256 \

## Causal environment-order regression

Both audit modes must execute a nonallocating predicate harness under Apple Bash 3.2 and a literal `env -i` process boundary. The harness must:

1. capture the exact C-sorted variable-name bytes presented to the bootstrap;
2. prove the authenticated P0 literal rejects those bytes;
3. prove the corrected P5R1 literal accepts the identical bytes;
4. require exactly one `HISTFILE` line immediately before exactly one `HOME` line;
5. prove the two literals differ only by that adjacent swap;
6. reject missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, unsafe, CR-bearing, and NUL-bearing names; and
7. prove inherited `BASH_ENV`, `ENV`, aliases, functions, shell options, and Git configuration cannot cross the clean boundary.

The harness may extract the P0 comparison predicate as inert text. It must never source, launch, or use P0 bootstrap bytes as an rcfile and must never allocate an evidence namespace.

## Candidate and committed audit modes

Candidate mode requires HEAD exactly D5R1, an empty index and tracked diff, and this plan as the sole untracked path. Committed mode requires a clean HEAD exactly at P5R1, sole parent D5R1, exact author/committer/subject, and exact one-file added scope. In each mode, non-shell coordination authenticates the preserved predecessor verifier and external root-receipt file hash, then invokes the exact detached outer `env -i` command. The predecessor verifies the complete reviewed bundle before its sole state transition, an exact inner `exec` of the embedded checker. The checker must authenticate its own canonical path, owner, mode, link count, and extracted bytes before substantive work, then repeat the byte comparison as its final TOCTOU latch. The first recovered controller action later routes the separately authenticated nested committed-mode checker launch through the imported committed predecessor bundle; no direct checker fallback is authorized.

Each audit performs, in order:

1. clean-process, fixed-tool, fixed-path, branch, worktree, Git-config, and input-schema checks;
2. exact S4/D/P0/D5R1 graph, tree, subject, author/committer, path, blob, and byte checks;
3. P0 package, both responses, original approval envelope, old authority, and failed-attempt package verification;
4. exact P0 checker/bootstrap/runtime extraction and source-identity checks;
5. exact delta extraction, safe one-file check/apply/reverse, result comparison, and derivation-manifest checks;
6. causal environment-order RED/GREEN and hostile-environment regressions;
7. Apple Bash 3.2 syntax of every executable fence and concatenated runtime, called-versus-defined symbol closure, dispatcher arities, and closed action sequence;
8. exact 42-body catalog reconciliation and build/test/probe-free structural replay of 10 implementation, 28 canonical, two rejected, and the T5M28 hook in fresh no-hardlink disposable clones;
9. exact restoration of every disposable clone to the mode's authenticated docs-only source baseline—D5R1 source state in candidate mode and P5R1 source state in committed mode—with no alternates/remotes/hardlinks and identical cache bytes on distinct inodes; and
10. proof that the real HEAD/index/worktree and both evidence-root inventories remain unchanged.

The checker emits a canonical audit root containing the candidate or committed plan identity, complete derived bytes, derivation manifest, plan-dependent core manifest, structural-replay results, captured output/status for its negative and clone probes, and before/after repository and namespace identities. The core contains plan and derived-byte identities but no prospective commit field, so candidate and committed core bytes and SHA-256 must match exactly. Separate audit identities carry `mode=candidate,P5R1=UNRESOLVED` or `mode=committed,P5R1=<resolved OID>` and bind the identical core.

## Fresh P5R1 review and authority gate

After committed audit passes, non-shell coordination freezes one immutable P5R1 review package containing:

- D5R1 design, P5R1 plan, and exact Git identities;
- complete checker, corrected bootstrap, materialized runtime, exact postapproval launcher, all deltas, derivation manifest, and resolved core manifest;
- both complete detached prelaunch bundles, the separately preserved predecessor verifier, and both exact 11-line checker-launch identities at the fixed nested R2 paths;
- the complete failed-attempt package;
- P0 plan/package/responses/approval/authority provenance;
- exact 42-body catalog and structural replay report; and
- committed audit command/evidence.

Before dispatch, coordination freezes three report-safe references: one implementation actor, one specification reviewer, and one quality reviewer. All are pairwise distinct under ASCII case folding and none contains a standalone `R` token. Assignment files are exact single LF-terminated lines, mode `0400`, owner-matched, regular, nonsymlink, single-link, NUL/CR-free, and bound into the package manifest.

The two reviewers inspect the identical immutable package through separate non-shell lanes. Each response is sealed against its assignment, actor, package manifest, exact bytes, verdict, Critical/Important/Minor counts, and reviewer-derived Minor dispositions. Execution requires both verdicts `APPROVE`, `CRITICAL=0`, and `IMPORTANT=0`; Minor findings are allowed only when every exact finding has an explicit, reviewed disposition.

Only after both response/identity pairs are immutable may the user provide fresh explicit P5R1 implementation approval. Coordination preserves the exact approval bytes and report-safe reference in a closed structured envelope with exactly one occurrence of every required key:

```text
format=task5r1-implementation-approval-v1
P5R1=<resolved 40-character lowercase commit OID>
P5R1-PLAN-SHA256=<committed plan SHA-256>
P5R1-REVIEW-PACKAGE-SHA256=<fresh package manifest SHA-256>
P5R1-SPEC-RESPONSE-SHA256=<sealed spec response SHA-256>
P5R1-QUALITY-RESPONSE-SHA256=<sealed quality response SHA-256>
IMPLEMENTATION-ACTOR-REFERENCE=<fresh report-safe actor reference>
USER-APPROVAL-VERBATIM=APPROVE P5R1 <resolved OID> PLAN <plan SHA-256> PACKAGE <package SHA-256> SPEC <spec response SHA-256> QUALITY <quality response SHA-256> AMENDMENT U-T5R1-UNIFIED-OUTPUT-01
AMENDMENT=U-T5R1-UNIFIED-OUTPUT-01
DECISION=APPROVE
```

The user must send that exact computed one-line phrase after both response hashes and the committed package hash are known; a generic `approved` response is insufficient. The envelope's `USER-APPROVAL-VERBATIM` value must byte-equal the user message and must be recomputed from the other envelope fields, so it proves the approval is specific to the already sealed responses without relying on a fabricated timestamp. The separately sealed approval-reference file contains exactly one report-safe, LF-terminated reference line. The approval envelope must postdate both sealed responses and bind those existing bytes; it does not self-pin the not-yet-created authority bundle. The fresh authority bundle subsequently binds the complete approval envelope and reference. The fresh authority bundle must also bind:

- P0, D5R1, resolved P5R1, their plan/design bytes, and the final committed core;
- complete P5R1 package and both fresh response/identity pairs;
- fresh user approval envelope and actor/reviewer references;
- complete original P0 authority and review provenance by value; and
- exact failed-attempt package manifest `e70b38bbb8f7afdb486140bd94a49c9f5a122cfffedf6b9b543dcfdbfa6ff0c6`.

Its exact authority receipt has 32 ordered fields: the existing 25 fields,
followed immediately after `amendment` by
`prelaunch-verifier-command-sha256`,
`candidate-root-receipt-file-sha256`,
`candidate-bundle-manifest-sha256`,
`candidate-launch-identity-sha256`,
`committed-root-receipt-file-sha256`,
`committed-bundle-manifest-sha256`, and
`committed-launch-identity-sha256`. The authority contains by-value,
distinct-inode top-level execution copies at the exact five paths specified by
the detached schema, plus their reviewed nested package copies. Bootstrap must
authenticate both closures and their byte-equality bridge before allocating an
evidence namespace.

The fresh authority source path is exactly `/private/tmp/ssr-task5-recovery-authority-bundle`. It must be absent until the post-review user approval is sealed. The fresh bundle uses an exact closed schema, canonical case-fold-safe paths, no links or special files, one self-excluding C-sorted manifest, root mode `0500`, and files mode `0400`. Candidate audit must define the schema; committed audit must reproduce the bytes; bootstrap must verify it before allocation.

The postapproval launch uses only the exact P5R1 launcher and bootstrap extracted from committed P5R1, the exact fresh authority bundle, and the following single process-start clean-environment command. The outer `/usr/bin/env -i` is the trust boundary: coordination may substitute only the four named variables after their exact bytes exist, and may not add, remove, reorder, or inherit an environment assignment, shell option, or argument. The launcher authenticates the bootstrap and authority manifest before using the corrected bootstrap as its sole rcfile. It never references P0 bootstrap as an executable path.

## Controller state and lifecycle

The controller recognizes exactly these immutable checkpoints:

```text
S4 D P0 D5R1 P5R1 C51 C52 C53 C53C1 C53C2 FINAL R
```

`P0` is source-only. `P5R1` is the clean execution baseline and the required parent of C51. `FINAL` is a noncommit full-range review target. No generic `P` label is valid.

The first ordinal action authenticates and seals P5R1, the derivation artifacts, the failed-attempt package, both authority layers, and the fresh namespace. Thereafter the original Task 5 lifecycle remains closed and monotonic: Task 0 baseline/Task 4.2 closure, C51 RED/GREEN/review/commit, C52 RED/GREEN/review/commit, C53 RED/GREEN/review/commit, C53C1 hypothesis/stress/review/commit, C53C2 hypothesis/stress/T5M28 proof/review/commit, 28 canonical mutation transactions, two rejected-candidate reproductions, final T5M28 proof, final closure, FINAL full-range reviews, report candidate/stage/reviews/commit, and final audit.

The recovered runtime must regenerate and embed the exact action sequence, dispatcher arities, ordinal counts, and sequence hashes. `recovery-postcommit` replaces P0's `plan-postcommit` one-for-one: the closed lifecycle remains exactly 135 actions before FINAL, 138 before report work, 147 after report commit authentication, and `final-audit` at ordinal 148. Counts may not conceal missing, duplicated, or reordered actions. Every public prose invocation must match the closed dispatcher.

### Externally checkpointed ledger trust

The recovery ledger is process-immutable and externally checkpointed; it is not claimed to be OS-immutable against the account that owns its files. The independent coordination transcript is therefore part of the trust boundary. Coordination must preserve the exact P5R1 package, response, and approval hashes before launch; every later review package and response hash as it is produced; and the exact finalization or retirement receipt printed by bootstrap. A locally self-consistent rewrite is invalid whenever it disagrees with any preserved external identity.

The fresh namespace contains one exact eight-line ledger genesis, one exact 17-line controller identity per action, and one exact ten-line hash-chain link per finalized ordinal. Genesis has an `ABSENT` review tuple. Ordinal 1 binds the already accepted P5R1 package plus both P5R1 response hashes from the fresh authority bundle. Every later link binds its ordinal, action, entry-manifest SHA-256, prior entry-manifest SHA-256, prior chain head, and latest accepted checkpoint/package/spec/quality tuple. A spec-response link immediately records the new package and spec response with quality `ABSENT`; the corresponding quality-response link completes that tuple. No later checkpoint may begin from an incomplete tuple.

Before every child launch, bootstrap and runtime recompute the complete prior chain and byte-authenticate the live prefix. Every checkpoint review package copies that complete commands/chain prefix, records an exact nine-line prefix identity, seals the copy in its package manifest, and byte-compares the copy to the live prefix. The independent review response's externally preserved `PACKAGE-SHA256` pins that package; later links incorporate the sealed response SHA-256 values. The report authorization record and tracked report bind the completed ordinal-138 FINAL prefix; the R package independently binds the staged-report prefix through ordinal 141.

Only `final-audit` may occupy ordinal 148, and it may occupy no earlier ordinal. After that child succeeds, bootstrap recomputes all 148 entries and emits an exact 21-line finalized receipt followed by its SHA-256 and byte count for external preservation. A postallocation failure instead seals the entire namespace and emits an exact seven-line retirement receipt containing the namespace, action, ordinal, status, and retired-manifest SHA-256/byte count before the generic abort diagnostic. Missing, malformed, or externally unpreserved receipts do not establish completion or trustworthy failure evidence.
